Explanation:- sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'as/when' ka use hoga kyunki 'although' ka use contradiction dikhaane ke liye hota hai, lekin sentence mein aage reason batana hai sentence ka matlab hai 'cyclone Idai ne 157 log maare jab yeh southern Africa mein tabaahi macha raha tha', toh 'jab' waale meaning ke liye yahan 'as/when' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.
Note:- 'as' ka ek meaning 'jab' wala bhi hota hai.

questions.question: She got two quick promotions in order that she has good communication skills.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'because' instead of 'in order that'
Explanation:- sentence mein 'in order that' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'in order that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai aur 'because' ka matlab 'kyunki' hota hai. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'usko do quick promotion mile kyunki uske paas acchi communication skills hai'. Toh sahi meaning ke according 'because' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Either you [and he] will have to pay for this damage.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai aur yeh correlative conjunction hoti hai, isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: [While he saw the bear], he ran to the nearest tree, dropped his gun and climbed to a safe place.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Option C galat hai kyunki 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai. D option bhi galat hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jab unse bear ko dekha, toh apne pass waale tree ki taraf bhaag gaya', toh B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'while' duration ko refer karta hai aur yahan ek fix point of time ki baat karni hai. Isliye A option 'when he saw the bear' sahi hoga

questions.question: The secretary to my boss is very efficient as he not only gives him the required information [and also handles] correspondence independently.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'not only' ke sath 'but also' ka pair hota hai joki correlative conjunction hoti hai, aur yeh same rank ke words ko connect karte hai, isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: [Last before year], Shirley got very good grades.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- A and D option grammatically sahi structure nahi hai. B option tab lagta agar yahan yeh meaning diya hota ki 'Last year se pehle Shirley ke kaffi acche marks aate the', matlab 'last year se pehle jitne bhi year the', tab yeh baat habitual action ho jaati, aur past ke habitual action ke liye 'used to' model ka use hota. C option 'the year before last' ka matlab hai 'pichle year se 1 year pichewala year'. Toh yeh meaning wise and grammatically option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The soldiers had [no choice to] report the loss to their commander.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'soldiers ke paas commander ko report karne ke sivay koi choice nahi thi..', toh 'no choice but to' phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'ek hee option hona, aur koi choice naa hona' hota hai, jisme 'but' preposition ka kaam kar raha hai aur iska matlab 'ke sivaay' hota hai, isliye 'no choice but to' option D sahi hoga.
Note:- 'but' jab conjunction hota hai toh iska matlab 'lekin' hota hai..

questions.question: Keep the dog tied indoors; [however], it may bite some stranger.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yeh meaning pe based error hai. 'however' ka matlab 'halaanki', 'yet' ka matlab 'fir bhi', 'still' ka matlab 'fir bhi', 'else' ka maltab 'warna'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'dog ko andar rakho warna yeh kisi anjaan ko kaat lega'. Toh sahi meaning ke according 'else' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: She is [as good] if not better than her sister.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan 'she' ka 'her sister' se comparison hai yeh sentence ka complete structure aisa hai 'She is as good as her sister is if she is not better than her sister is'. yahan same 2 logon ka 2 baar comparison hua hai isliye subject and verbs understood hogye hain, lekin simile (conj) ka poora structure hi likha jaayega. isliye B option 'as good as' sahi hai.

questions.question: Keep him at arm's length [lest you may not] repent in the long run.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- option D sahi hoga kyunki 'lest' ke sath 'should' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: He is interested neither in business [or on the] job.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'neither' ke sath 'nor' ka pair hota hai aur yeh ek correlative conjunction hoti hai jo 'same rank' ke words ko connect karti hai, isliye 'nor in a job' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can have a comfortable journey [only then you are getting] your seats reserved in advance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'sirf agar tum apni ticket advance mein reserve karao', toh 'sirf agar' waale meaning ke liye 'only if' ka use hoga joki conjunction ki tarah kaam karega, isliye D option 'only if you get' sahi hoga. baaki 'only then', 'only when' yeh adverbial phrase hota hai, yeh conjunction ka kaam nahi karte.

questions.question: Turn left outside the library door and walk down the corridor [then you came to] the main staircase.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai 'corridor mein chalte raho jab tak tum main staircase tak naa pahunch jao', toh 'jab tak nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'until' ka use hoga, aur 'turn' aur 'walk' se pata chal raha ki present tense ki baat karni hai, isliye 'until' aur present tense 'come' wala 'until you come to' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He's not [so friendly like] she is.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- sentence mein negative comparison karna hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'wo utna friendly nahi hai jitni tum ho'. Toh 'as....as' ka use 'positive aur negative' comparison ke liye hota hai, lekin 'so....as' ke use sirf negative comparison ke liye hota hai. Options mein 'as.....as' wala option nahi hai, isliye 'so friendly as' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: [In spite of my niece's] dog Casper is very mischievous, he is lovable.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'uski niece ka dog Casper' matlab 'dog' pe possession banana hai, jiske liye 'my niece' pe apostrophe 's' ka use hoga, isliye option A aur D galat honge hai. B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'inspite of' ek preposition hoti hai aur yahan 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye 'conjunction' chahiye. Option C se matlab hoga 'halaanki meri niece ka dog sharaarti hai, sab usse pyar karte hai' isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option 'Although my niece's' sahi hai.

questions.question: [Such was] his performance that the audience gave a standing ovation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Aisi thi uski performance ki audience ne standing ovation di', toh 'ki' waale meaning ke liye 'such' ke sath 'that' ka use hota hai, sentence mein aage 'that' likha hai, isliye 'such was' 'no substitution required' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: [Unless] you carry a Covid-19 negative report, you can travel by air.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'provided' or 'provided that' yeh conjunction hoti hai jiska meaning 'basharte, agar(if)' hota hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Agar apke paas covid ki negative report hai to aap by air travel kar sakte hain' iss meaning liye B option 'provided' sahi hoga.

questions.question: [Unless we are not sure] of our goals, we cannot achieve them.
options: (d) Except if we are not sure
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai, aur 'unless' jiss clause ke sath lagta hai uss clause mein 'not' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'unless' se wo 'not' understood ho jata hai, yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'agar hum apne goals ko leke sure nahi hai toh hum unhe achieve nahi kar sakte', toh meaning ke according 'unless' ka use sahi hai, isliye 'unless we are sure' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Hurry up, [in case] you will be late for your school.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yeh meaning based error hai. yahan meaning yeh dena ki 'jaldi karo warna tum school ke liye late ho jayoge', toh 'warna' waale meaning ke liye A option 'otherwise' sahi hoga

questions.question: Cakes are Jaya's favourite snack, [even samosas is] Aparna's preferred choice.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction chahiye, lekin 'even' toh adverb hota hai, isliye option C galat hoga. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai. Sentence mein 'samosas' subject plural hai, isliye plural verb ayegi aur sentence ka matlab chahiye 'cake Jaya ka favourite food hai, jabki Aparna samosa prefer karti hai', toh plural verb aur 'jabki' waale meaning ke liye 'while samosas are' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: [No sooner] I get the message; I shall pass it on to you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'No sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai aur 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka joki dono option mein nahi hai isliye C and D options galat hain. yahan meaning dena hai ki 'jaise hi muje message milega, waise he tumhe pass kar dunga', toh 'jaise he' waale meaning ke liye 'as soon as' option A sahi hoga. baaki 'although' ka matlab 'halaanki' hota hai jo contradiction dikhaane ke kaam aata hai.

questions.question: [Just when I] sit down, than the doorbell rang.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'No sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai joki ek correlative conjunction hai, 'no sooner' ke sath inversion bhi follow hota hai, toh meaning ke according option A 'No sooner did I' sahi hoga

questions.question: She had grown [too thin which] she looked like Scarecrow.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'too' ke sath infinitive ka pair hota hai, isliye option B aur D galat honge. Option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'that' ke sath 'such' yaa 'so' ka pair banta hai. Sentence ka matlab chahiye 'wo itni patli ho gayi thi ki wo scarecrow ki tarah dikhne lagi', toh meaning ke according 'so thin that' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: I cannot help you [if you tell me] your problem.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'mai tumhari help nahi kar sakta agar tum mujhe apni problem nahi bataoge', 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai aur 'until/unless' jiss clause ke sath lagta hai usme 'not' ka use galat hota hai. isliye 'unless you tell me' wala D option sahi hoga.

questions.question: [Unless someone makes a complaint], they will not clear the garbage from the street.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Without, Despite, Except' yeh sab prepositions hai, lekin sentence mein 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye conjunction ka use karte hai. isliye meaning and grammar ke according question mein diya 'unless.....' sahi hoga.

questions.question: [Because] she didn't love him, she had to marry him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'because' aur 'since' conjunction ka use reason bataane ke liye hota, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'despite' preposition hoti hai, jabki humhe yahan conjunction chahiye do clause ke liye. Option B sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'halaanki wo usse pyar nahi karti thi, usse shadi karni padi', toh meaning ke according 'although' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The train was delayed [in order to] an accident.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- sentence mein 'train was' ek hee clause hai, toh yahan conjunction ki jarurat nahi hai isliye A and C options galat hain. B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'In order to + verb' sahi structure hota hai. isliye meaning aur grammar ke according D option sahi hai.
Note:- 'owing to' ka meaning 'because of' hota hai. Joki prepositional phrase hota hai.

questions.question: She was smiling [but looking] pleased about something.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan koi contradiction nhi dikhana hai, isliye option A aur C galat honge. Option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so' ka matlab 'isliye' hota hai, joki meaning ke according galat hai. Sentence ka matlab chahiye 'wo smile kar rahi thi aur khush thi kisi cheez ko leke' isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'and looked' sahi hai.

questions.question: She was [so tall to] reach the top shelf.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- sentence mein 'reach' verb hai lekin subject nahi hai matlab second clause nahi banega, isliye option B 'so tall that' galat hoga kyunki yeh clauses ko jodne ke liye kaam aata hai, option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so' ke sath 'to' ka use galat hai, option C bhi galat hoga kyunki 'too' ke sath infinitive ka pair banta hai. Option D 'tall enough to' sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'wo upper shelf tak pahuchne ke liye paryapt lambi thi', aur 'to reach' se infinitive bhi banega, jo meaning wise aur grammar wise sahi hoga, toh option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: [But for their] valour, they would have been defeated.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'unki bahaduri ke bina wo haar gaye hote', toh 'but for' ek phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'ke bina (without)' hota hai, isliye question mein diya structure sahi hai.

questions.question: [So much as] you behave like this, the decision of the management against you cannot be revoked.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'as' ke sath 'to' ka structure grammatically galat hai. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'much' ka use quantity ka refer karne ke liye hota hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'jab tak tum aise hi behave karoge.....', iss meaning ke liye B option 'as long as' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Hardly had he [sit on the chair than] it broke.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai joki correlative conjunction hoti hai. aur 'had' ke baad v3 ka use hoga isliye B option 'sat on the chair when' sahi hai.

questions.question: A woman cannot understand (a)/ how difficult it is to take care of a newborn baby (b)/ unless she doesn't experience the sleepless nights herself (c)/ for several weeks. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'doesn't experience' with 'experiences'
Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab hota hai 'jab tak nahi' jisme not pehle se understood hota hai aur yeh conjunction jis clause mein aati hai, uss clause mein negative ka use nahi karte, isliye yahan 'doesn't' nahi aayega, kyunki 'she' singular hai, isliye yahan singular verb 'experiences' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Both government policies as well as individual (a)/responsibility are necessary to reduce pollution (b)/ and protect natural resources for future generations. (c)No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'as well as' with 'and'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as well as' ki jagah 'and' aayega kyunki 'both' ke sath 'and' ka pair hota hai aur yeh co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'both government policies and individual' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A wise investor knows that (a)/ he has no other option (b)/ but to diversify his investments across multiple sectors (c)/ to protect himself from unexpected financial crises. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'but' with 'than'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'other' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai aur yeh ek co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'no other option than' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As soon as the heavy rain (a)/ started pouring on the crowded street (b)/ then people rushed to take shelter in nearby shops. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'then'
Explanation:- Sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai aur wo conjunction 'as soon as' aa chuki hai, isliye yahan 'then' remove hoga. aur waise bhi 'as soon as' ka use do action sath mein ho rahe hai yeh dikhane ke liye use karte hai jabki 'then' ka use ek action ke baad dusra action batane ke liye use hota hai, aur dono conjunction ka use sath mein contradictory ho jaayega.

questions.question: The children were playing happily in the backyard (a)/ during their mothers were preparing (b)/lunch for them in the kitchen. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'during' with 'while'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'during' ki jagah 'while' aayega kyunki 'during' preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein do clauses ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, kyunki sentence mein continuous tense hai isliye yahan 'while' conjunction ko prefer karenge. Sentence ka matlab hoga 'bacche khel rahe jabki unki mother khaana bana rahi thi', isliye yahan 'while' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She asked me that why (a)/ I had suddenly moved to a new city (b)/ without informing anyone in my neighbourhood. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' conjunction nahi ayegi kyunki sentence ke indirect speech mein likhe hone ke kaaran 'if, how, why, where, when' yeh word khud conjunction ki tarah kaam karne lagte hai, kyunki sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'asked' verb ke according 'why' se meaning sahi aayega, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: No sooner did (a)/ she send her job application (b)/ then she received a reply inviting her for an interview (c)/ which surprised her because she wasn't expecting such a quick response. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'then' with 'than'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'then' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'no sooner.....than' ek co-relative conjunction hoti hai, isliye yahan 'than' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new technology is as efficient, if not (a)/ more than most (b)/ systems currently used in government offices (c)/ for long-term data storage. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) add 'as' after 'as efficient'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as efficient' ke baad 'as' aayega kyunki iss se simile ka structure complete hoga, isliye yahan 'as efficient as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Maria finished the marathon (a)/ with a bright smile on her face (b)/ even she was exhausted after running for hours. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'even' with 'although/though/even though'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'even' nahi aayega kyunki 'even' ek adverb hoti hai, lekin sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur sentence mein contradiction bhi dikhaana ki 'usne marathon finish kari haalanki wo exhaust ho chuki thi', isliye yahan contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'although, though, even though' conjunction ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: The environmental campaign (a)/ raised not only awareness about plastic pollution (b)/ but also encouraged people to adopt sustainable habits (c)/ in their daily lifestyle. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'raised not only' with 'not only raised'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'raised' 'not only' ke baad aayega kyunki 'not only......but also' co-relative conjunction hoti hai jo same rank ke word ko connect karti hai, kyunki 'but also' ke baad verb likhi hai, waise he 'not only' ke baad bhi verb aayegi, isliye 'raised' ki position 'not only' ke baad karni padegi.

questions.question: Hardly had the students begun solving (a)/ the questions than the invigilator announced (b)/ an important instruction (c)/ about the question paper. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'than' with 'when'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'than' ki jagah 'when' aayega kyunki 'hardly/scarcely' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: The teacher said to the students (a)/ "Complete your homework on time, lest you (b)/ will face difficulty in understanding tomorrow's lesson." (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'will' with 'should'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'will' ki jagah 'should' aayega kyunki 'lest' ke sath 'should' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: He saves a portion of his income every month (a)/ that he can build a secure future (b)/ for his family and avoid financial stress (c)/ during emergencies. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'that' with 'so that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' ki jagah 'so that' aayega kyunki sentence mein matlab dena hai 'wo apni income ka portion save karta hai taaki apni family ke liye future secure kar sake', 'that' ka matlab hota hai 'ki' aur 'so that' ka matlab hota hai 'taaki', toh 'taaki' waale meaning ke liye 'so that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It is incorrect to assume that artificial intelligence systems can behave same like the human brain in all situations.
options: (a) It is incorrect to assume that
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'same like' with 'same as'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'like' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'same like' jaisa koi term nahi hota, isliye 'same as' ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: As she had prepared well for the debate competition, she forgot her lines on stage.
options: (c) she forgot her lines on stage
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'as' with 'although'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'although' aayega kyunki 'as' ka matlab 'kyunki' hota hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai 'halanki usse acche se prepare kiya tha, wo apni line bhool gayi', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'although' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: At the end of the long trek we were exhausted and delighted that we had finally reached the summit.
options: (a) At the end of the long trek
(c) that we had finally reached the summit
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'and' with 'but'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'and' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'and' conjunction se same degree adjective judenge, yaa toh positive yaa negative. 'exhausted' aur 'delighted' dono contradiction show kar rahe hai, isliye contradiction dikhaane waali conjunction 'but' ka use sabse sahi hoga. jisse matlab hoga 'wo thak gaye the lekin khush the'.

questions.question: Researchers have discovered that certain plants (a)/ can defend themselves against harmful insects (b)/ by releasing natural chemicals as pheromones, essential oils, and defensive enzymes. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'as' with 'such as/like'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'such as, like' aayega kyunki sentence mein natural chemical ke example dene hai jiske liye 'such as' yaa 'like' preposition ka use karte hai, 'such as' jab sath likha hota hai toh yeh preposition ka kaam karta hai, isliye yahan 'such as', 'like' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: You will not succeed in this exam as you study regularly with complete focus.
options: (a) You will not succeed in this exam
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'as' with 'unless'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'unless' aayega kyunki 'as' se meaning galat aa raha hai. sentence mein meaning chahiye 'tum succeed nahi ho payoge agar tum regularly padhai nahi karoge', toh sentence mein 'agar nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'unless' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Smart home devices have made daily life far more convenient and automated, so they also pose serious privacy concerns for users around the world.
options: (a) Smart home devices have made daily life
(c) so they also pose serious privacy concerns
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'so' with 'but'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'so' ka use aage result bataane ke liye use hota hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai matlab 'device acche hai lekin users ko privacy concerns bhi hai', isliye yahan contradiction dikhaane waali conjunction 'but'(lekin) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The earthquake caused massive destruction although it struck the city during the early hours of the morning.
options: (c) the city during the early hours of the morning
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'although' with 'when'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'when' ka use hoga kyunki 'although' contradiction ke liye use karte hai, lekin sentence mein 'jab' wala meaning chahiye matlab 'earthquake ne destruction machaya jab usne city ko struck kiya', toh 'jab' waale meaning ke liye 'when' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: If this cadet can run ten miles with ease (a)/ and complete high-altitude drills without resting, (b)/ his partner struggles to finish even half the course (c)/ and gasps for breath after every steep climb. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'if' with 'while'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' ki jagah 'while' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'agar' wala meaning nahi chahiye, sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai ki 'ek cadet ten miles aaram se chal leta, jabki dusra half bhi muskil se chal pata hai', toh contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'while' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.
Note:- 'although' bhi use kar sakte lekin sentence mein reason, result jaisa meaning nahi hai, isliye 'while' use kiya.

questions.question: Such intelligence officers who monitor dark-web activities (a)/ to prevent cyber-attacks and digital frauds (b)/ often work anonymously (c)/ and handle extremely sensitive information. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'who' with 'as'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'who' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'such......as' ka use 'jo, jaise, jisne' waale meaning ke liye karte hai aur 'as' relative pronoun ka bhi work karta hai, jisse matlab hoga 'aise officer jo monitor karte hai', aur 'as' 'monitor' verb ke liye subject(pronoun) ka bhi kaam kar raha hai, isliye meaning ke according 'as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The witness was (a)/ too nervous (b)/ for speak the truth in the courtroom (c)/ after receiving threats from the accused gang members. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'for speak' with 'to speak'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'for' ki jagah 'to' aayega kyunki 'too' ke sath infinitive 'to+v1' ka pair hota hai jo negative comparison karta hai. isliye yahan 'to speak' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In today's world, you cannot achieve financial stability (a)/ although you save and invest a decent amount every month (b)/ because steady planning and disciplined saving (c)/ are required to secure your future. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'although' with 'unless'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'unless' aayega kyunki sentence mein contradiction nahi dikhaane, balki yeh kehna hai 'tum financial stability nahi achieve kar payoge agar tum decent amount save nahi karoge', toh 'agar nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'unless' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A successful career can give you financial security, (a)/ global exposure, and respect in society, as it also (b)/ demands time, sacrifices, and long years of consistency (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'as it' with 'but it'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'as' ka matlab 'kyunki' hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai. matlab hoga ki 'ek successful career tumhe yeh sab dila sakta hai, lekin yeh time, sacrifice aur consistency ki demand bhi karta hai', toh 'lekin' waale meaning ke 'but' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She is neither interested in casual relationships (a)/ or ready for marriage right now (b)/ as she wants to focus on her career (c)/ and explore life independently. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'or' with 'nor'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'or' ki jagah 'nor' aayega kyunki 'neither' ke sath 'nor' ka pair hota hai, jo ki ek co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'nor' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students asked the administrator (a)/ that if the university portal would crash again like last year (b)/ because the server was already running slow. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' conjunction nahi ayegi kyunki sentence ke indirect speech mein likhe hone ke kaaran 'if, how, why, where, when' yeh word khud conjunction ki tarah kaam karne lagte hai, kyunki sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'asked' verb ke according 'if' se meaning sahi aayega, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: Not only the employees reported repeated system crashes (a)/ and slow network issues, (b)/ but they also complained about frequent data loss (c)/ during the peak working hours. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'the employees reported' with 'did the employees report'
Explanation:- 'not only' ka 'but also' ka pair hota hai aur iske sath inversion ka structure bhi follow hota hai, isliye 'not only did the employees report' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The reason for thousands of aspirants gathering (a)/ outside the commission office last week (b)/ was because the exam results (c)/ were delayed without any official notification. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'because' with 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'reason' ke sath 'because' superfluous ki category mein aata hai, kyunki yeh dono 'kaaran' batane ke liye use hote hai. toh sentence mein 'kii' waale matlab ke liye 'that' conjunction ka use karenge, jisse matlab hoga ki 'reason yeh tha ki exam delay ho gaya', isliye yahan 'that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the cyclist noticed a car speeding recklessly towards the crossing (a)/ he waved his hands repeatedly (b)/ so that to alert the pedestrians (c)/ standing near the zebra crossing. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'so that' with 'so as'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so that' ki jagah 'so as' aayega kyunki 'so that' ke baad clause likha jaata hai aur 'so as' ke baad infinitive, kyunki sentence mein 'to alert' infinitive likha hai, isliye yahan 'so as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This social media platform will implement strict verification rules (a)/ to reduce misinformation and fake profiles (b)/ if the influencers like them or not. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'if' with 'whether'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' ki jagah 'whether' aayega kyunki 'whether' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai. isliye yahan 'whether' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The storm across the coastal districts (a)/ was such a violent one (b)/ but fishermen couldn't sail their boats (c)/ for two consecutive days. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'but' with 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'such' ke sath 'as', 'that' ka pair hota hai. 'kii' waale meaning ke liye 'such.....that' aur 'jo, jaise, jisne' waale meaning ke liye 'such....as'. sentence ka matlab hai 'storm itna violent tha ki fishermen boat sail nahi kar paaye', toh 'kii' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'such' ke sath 'that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The express train was delayed for several hours (a)/ at the central station (b)/ because the dense fog covering the tracks (c)/ early in the morning. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'because' with 'because of'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'because of' aayega kyunki 'because' conjunction hai jo do clause ko jodne ka kaam karti hai, lekin 'the dense fog......morning' yeh clause nahi hai kyunki isme verb nahi hai, isliye conjunction ko hata ke 'because of' preposition ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: You are so late (a)/ to start preparing for this year's civil services exam (b)/ so you should prepare for the next year's exam (c)/ for better results. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'so' with 'too'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so' ki jagah 'too' aayega kyunki sentence mein negative meaning convey karna hai 'iss saal preparation start karne ke liye pehle se hee late ho', aur aage 'to start' infinitive bhi likha hai aur negative meaning bhi chahiye, isliye 'so' ki jagah 'too' sahi hoga, isliye 'too late to start' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As such you ever receive suspicious messages (a)/ on social media asking for your personal details (b)/ report and block the sender (c)/ without replying. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'as such' with 'if'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as such' ki jagah 'if' aayega kyunki 'as such' ka 'theek thaak, aisa koi' matlab hota hai, lekin sentence ka matlab 'agar tumhare pass aise koi message aaye jo tumhari personal detail maange toh report or block kar dena', sentence mein 'agar' waala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'if' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Always wear a helmet while riding a two-wheeler (a)/ but you might face a hefty fine or (b)/ serious injury if an accident happens. (c) No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'but' with 'otherwise/or/else'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'otherwise' aayega kyunki 'but' ka matlab lekin hota hai, lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'humesha two-weeler chalate samay helmet peheno warna tumhe hefty fine dena pad sakta hai', toh 'warna' waale meaning ke liye 'otherwise/or/else' ka use hota hai, sabse common 'otherwise' use hota hai, isliye yahan 'otherwise' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I was amazed to know that if Riya (a)/ had designed a working model (b)/ of a solar-powered water purifier (c)/ on her own. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'if'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' nahi aayega kyunki 'if' ka matlab 'kya' hai, lekin sentence mein kehna hai 'mein yeh jaan ke amaze tha ki Riya ne model design kiya hai', toh sentence mein 'kii' wala meaning chahiye jo ki 'that' se aayega aur do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'if' ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: Students find it much easier (a)/ to watch recorded lectures (b)/ then to attend a live class with full concentration. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'then' with 'than'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'then' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'then' adverb hota hai, aur 'easier' comparative degree lagi jiske sath 'than' conjunction ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'than' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She missed her practical examination (a)/ due to she was suffering from (b)/ various medical issues (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'due to' with 'because'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'due to' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'due to/owing to' yeh preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'kyunki' wala meaning chahiye, isliye 'because' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The doctors had no choice when to perform (a)/ an emergency surgery on the accident victim, (b)/ as delaying the procedure could have resulted (c)/ in severe internal bleeding and permanent organ damage. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'when' with 'but'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'when' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'no choice' ke sath 'but' fixed conjunction aati hai, isliye yahan 'but' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Our rural healthcare system can improve (a)/ but if we invest more in medical infrastructure (b)/ and train local doctors properly. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'but if' with 'only if'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but if' ki jagah 'only if' aayega kyunki 'but if' se 'lekin agar' wala meaning aayega, aur 'but' contradiction show karta hai. lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'healthcare system improve ho sakta hai sirf agar hum jyada invest kare medical infrastructure mein', toh 'sirf agar' waale chahiye, isliye yahan 'only if' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many army units have been deployed (a)/ in Delhi and other major cities (b)/ in order that intelligence agencies have noticed some (c)/ suspicious activities in border areas. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'in order that' with 'because'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in order that' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'in order that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'jo army deploy kari gayi' uska reason batana hai, 'kyunki' wala meaning dena hai, isliye yahan reason batane waali conjunction 'because' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The new government policy (a) / neither aims to reduce unemployment (b) / nor improve the quality of education (c) / across rural areas effectively. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'neither aims' with 'aims neither'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'neither' 'aims' ke baad aayega kyunki 'neither.....nor' co-relative conjunction hoti hai jo same type ke words ko connect karti hai, kyunki 'nor' ke sath 'improve' infinitive hai bina 'to' ke, aur 'nor' ke pass koi verb nahi hai, isliye 'neither' bhi verb ke sath nahi balki 'to reduce' infinitive ke sath lagega, isliye 'aims neither to reduce' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Either this high-performance electric car, which offers rapid acceleration and advanced self-driving features, [and the hybrid SUV] will be selected for the road-trip across the mountains.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Option A sahi hoga kyunki 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: [While he heard the explosion], he immediately rushed outside, called the emergency services, and tried his best to help the injured people who were screaming for assistance.
options: (c) No sooner did he hear the explosion
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'while he heard the explosion' galat hoga kyunki 'while' duration ke sath aata hai aur 'explosion' se pata chal raha ki isme koi duration nahi hai, isliye option B galat hoga. option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath inversion lagta hai. option C bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai. option D sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'jab usne explosion suna, wo turant hee bahar chal gaya'

questions.question: After the sudden breakdown of their car in the middle of the highway, the family had [no choice to wait] patiently for the towing service to arrive.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Option C sahi hoga kyunki 'no choice' ke sath 'but' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: Ensure that your car has sufficient fuel, proper tyre pressure, and all essential tools before starting this long highway journey [however] you may get stranded in an isolated area with no help nearby.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'however' ki jagah 'otherwise' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'car mein saari cheezein check kar lena warna tum waha akele padh jayoge', sentence mein 'warna' wala meaning chahiye, jiske liye 'otherwise' option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This phone is not [as durable like] the previous model, which could easily withstand rough use and still work smoothly for years.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein simile waali baat karni hai aur simile 'as.....as', 'so.....as' se banti hai. 'as....as' waali simile positive ke liye aur 'so....as' waali positive aur negative dono ke liye aati hai. options mein dono option available hai, isliye negative ke according 'so durable as' ko prefer karenge, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [In spite of] my friend's little puppy gets excited and chews everything, everyone adores him because he's so playful.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in spite of' ki jagah 'although' aayega kyunki 'in spite of' preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein teen clauses ko jodne ke liye do conjunction ki jarurat hai, ek conjunction 'because' likhi aur dusri chahiye, sentence ka matlab hai 'halanki wo puppy excited ho jata hai, sab chaba leta hai, usse sab log pasand karte kyunki wo playful hai', toh 'halanki' waale meaning ke liye 'although' option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [Such was the intensity] of the storm that the entire coastal town had to be evacuated urgently to ensure everyone's safety.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (c) 'No substitution required'

questions.question: [Unless] you have balance in your metro smart card, you will face no problem in entering the station.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'unless' ki jagah 'provided' aayega kyunki 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' jisse meaning galat aa raha hai, sentence ka matlab 'agar tumhare metro card mein balance hai toh tumhe station mein koi problem nahi ayegi', 'agar' waale meaning chahiye lekin 'if' option mein nahi hai toh option mein 'if' jaisa meaning dene wala 'provided' hai jiska matlab 'basharte' hota, isliye option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Pasta is Rohan's favourite food, [even burgers is] Priya's favourite.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'pasta Rohan ka favourite food hai, jabki burger Priya ka favourite hai', toh contradiction dikhana aur 'jabki' waale meaning chahiye, jiske liye 'while' sahi hoga, isliye option B 'while burgers are' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [No sooner] you complete the online application; you will receive a confirmation email along with your registration ID.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Option C aur D galat honge kyunki 'no sooner' aur 'hardly' ke sath inversion ka structure follow hota hai aur 'no sooner' ke sath 'than', 'hardly' ke sath 'when' follow hota. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jaise he online app complete karoge, tumhe confirmation email aayega', toh dono kaam sath mein hona batana hai, jiske liye 'as soon as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [Just when we locked the main door and stepped outside] for our evening walk, than it started raining heavily.
options: (a) No sooner did we lock the main door and step outside
(b) Hardly when we locked the main door
(c) As soon as we locked the main door
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Option A sahi hoga kyunki sentence mein 'than' se pata chal raha ki 'no sooner' aayega aur 'no sooner' ke sath inversion ka structure bhi follow hota hai, isliye option A sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [Unless residents submit a written request] to the municipality, they will not install new streetlights in the neighbourhood.
options: (a) Without residents submit a written request
(b) Despite residents submit a written request
(d) Except residents submit a written request
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (c) No substitution required

questions.question: She spoke politely [but behaving] confidently during the meeting, which impressed everyone present in the conference room.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'politely' aur 'confidently' dono positive baatein hai, isliye inhe 'and' conjunction ke sath likhenge, agar dono contradiction baatein hoti toh 'but' aata. Isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'and behaved' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The ladder was [so long to] reach the roof of the old farmhouse when the workers needed to repair the chimney.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Option A galat hoga kyunki 'too...ke sath....to' ka pair hota hai. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so' ke sath 'that' ka pair hota hai. option C bhi galat hoga kyunki 'that' ke baad clause likhte hai, lekin sentence mein clause nahi hai. 'long enough to' sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'ladder itni paryapt lambi thi farmhouse ki roof tak pahuch gayi', isliye option B 'long enough to' sabse sahi answer hoga

questions.question: [But for his timely medical advice], the patient would have suffered from severe complications and might not have recovered so quickly.
options: (a) Except with his timely medical advice
(b) Because of his timely medical advice
(d) But about his timely medical advice
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) No improvement
Explanation:- 'but for' ka maltab 'without' hota hai, jisse sentence ka matlab hoga ki 'bina timely medical advice ke, patient seriously suffer karta'.

questions.question: [So much as] you keep helping me in my projects, I will not tell your secret to our parents.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Option C sahi hoga kyunki sentence ka matlab chahiye 'jab tak tum meri project mein help karte rahoge, mein yeh secret parents ko kabhi nahi batayunga', toh 'jab tak ki' waale meaning ke liye 'as long as' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Hardly had she [opened the classroom window than] a strong gust of wind blew inside and scattered all the papers across the desks.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Option B sahi hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair aur inversion follow hota hai. aur 'had' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai. isliye option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Each and every man, (a)/woman and child were given (b)/food yesterday evening.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use was in place of were
Explanation:- agar distributive adjective ka use kiya jaaye toh bhale hi nouns 'and' se join kiye gaye ho verb singular verb aati hai.

questions.question: Neither the doctors nor (a)/ the nurse were present (b)/ when the patient (c)/ reached the hospital.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki agar do nouns neither...nor, either.....or, not only......but also, or, se connected ho tab verb, verb ke paas wale subject ke according aati hai, isliye yahan verb 'nurse' ke according singular aayegi.

questions.question: Five hours are too (a)/short a time to (b)/judge one's character. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use is in place of are
Explanation:- kyunki time, value, weight and length ko dikhane wale words jab ek unit ki tarah kaam karte hai toh unhe uncountable ki tarah treat kiya jaata hai. Eg.
10 kilometers is a long distance to travel on foot.
10000 rupees is a very big amount for me.

questions.question: Both Reeta and Ronika (a)/ has won (b)/ the dance competition (c)/ this year.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'have' instead of 'has'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'Rita' aur 'Ronika' dono subject 'and' conjunction se joined hain isliye verb plural aayegi.
Note:- 'both' koi distributive adjective nahi hai.

questions.question: The horse and (a)/carriage have been standing at (b)/the door for two hours.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use has in place of have.
Explanation:- yahan is sentence me 'the horse and carriage' (ghoda baggi) ek unit ki tarah kaam kar raha hai isliye verb singular aayegi.

questions.question: They all, except Shirin, were very sad (a)/ during the farewell party given (b)/ to the teacher retiring, and her (c)/ indifference were well noticed.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'indifference' hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: More persons (a)/than one has been (b)/involved in this quarrel.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use have in place of has.
Explanation:- More than one + noun(singular) + verb(singular)
More + noun(plural) + than one + verb(plural)

questions.question: The boy, as well as (a)/ his friends, were (b)/ absent from the class (c)/ when the teacher came.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki as well as, except, in addition to, with, along with etc. yeh sab prepositional phrases hain isliye inke baad aane wala noun inka object ho jaata hai aur verb first wale noun ke according aati hai.

questions.question: It is I who has (a)/always helped you (b)/in time of need.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use have in place of has.
Explanation:- who relative pronoun ka apna koi number gender nahi hota ye jisko refer karta hai usi ke according verb leta hai yahan yeh 'I' pronoun ke liye aaya hai isliye verb 'I' ke according 'have' aayegi.

questions.question: Children listens to people (a)/ speaking around them (b)/ for a long time before (c)/ they begin to speak.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'listen' instead of 'listens'
Explanation:- kyunki 'child' ka plural children hota hai aur yahan subject 'children' hai toh iske according plural verb 'listen' aayegi.

questions.question: Many a profound thinker (a)/believe that the march of civilization (b)/has not coincided with real human progress.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use believes in place of believe.
Explanation:-
Many a + noun (singular) + verb (singular)
'many a' - distributive adjective ki tarah kaam karta hai.

questions.question: The number of students (a)/ attending their classes (b)/ are constantly decreasing (c)/ in our university.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki -
The Number of + Noun (Plural) + Verb (Singular)
A Number of + Noun (Plural) + Verb (Plural)

questions.question: In the struggle (a)/between the bad and the good, the (b)/bad is ultimately defeated.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use are in place of is.
Explanation:-
'the bad' = bad people
the + adj = Common plural noun
the rich = rich people

questions.question: One of the major challenges (a)/ he faced during his (b)/ undergraduate days were (c)/ the shortage of money.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan is verb ka subject 'one' hai isliye iske according singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: The staff of his college is (a)/opposed to the takeover because (b)/they are convinced that they will lose their jobs.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use are in place of is.
Explanation:- 'staff' noun ke sath sentence ke according singular and plural dono verb aa sakti hain, sentence me aage 'they' and 'their' jaise words se clear ho rha hai ki 'staff' word ko plural me use kiya jayega.

questions.question: Every (a)/ curious child (b)/ want to (c)/ rip open a toy.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'wants' instead of 'want'
Explanation:- every + noun(singular) + verb (singular)

questions.question: No one were (a)/ present when I (b)/ entered the hall.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki 'no-one' subject ke sath verb singular aati hai.

questions.question: What I like the most about these (a)/stories are the fact that (b)/ they teach(c)/ us important life lessons.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'are' with 'is'
Explanation:- yahan b part me aayi verb ka subject 'what' se bna hua aage ka poora noun clause hai. Isliye verb singular aayegi.
Note: yahan 'stories' subject nhi hai wo to 'about' preposition ka object hai.

questions.question: The proposal which was passed (a)/by all the members last month have (b)/not been implemented yet. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'have' with 'has'
Explanation:- yhan b part me aayi verb ka subject 'The proposal' hai isliye verb singular aayegi. 'The proposal' subject ke baad adjectival clause likha hai, isliye verb subject se door likhi gyi hai, uss se confuse nhi hona hai.

questions.question: The contrast between (a)/Britain and other countries (b)/of Europe (c)/are striking.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'the contrast' hai jo ki singular hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: The river Yamuna (a)/ has many non-native species (b)/ like goldfish that is affecting (c)/ its ecosystem.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'are' instead of 'is'
Explanation:- kyunki 'that' relative pronoun yahan 'non native species' ko refer karne ke liye rakha gya hai isliye 'that' ke baad plural aayegi.

questions.question: Great many students (a)/ who are good at (b)/other subjects perform poorly (c)/in English.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'a great many' instead of 'great many'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan mahaan students nahi bahut saare students wala meaning dena hai jo ki 'a good/great many + noun' se aata hai.

questions.question: Each member (a)/ of the team (b)/ receive a memorabilia (c)/ after the match is over.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'receives' instead of 'receive'
Explanation:- kyunki 'member' noun se pehle 'each' distributive adjective laga hai isliye member subject ki verb singular aayegi which is 'receives'

questions.question: The blue Lotus (a)/ is one of the most beautiful flowers (b)/ which grows (c)/ in her garden.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'grow' instead of 'grows'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'which' ka antecedent 'flowers' plural noun hai uske according verb 'grow' aayegi.

questions.question: The perception (a)/ of success (b)/ vary (c)/ from person to person.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'varies' instead of 'vary'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'perception' hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye verb singular aayegi.

questions.question: Rehan and Ronit are (a)/ good friends and (b)/ it don't matter to them (c)/ as to who is wealthier.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'doesn't' instead of 'don't'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'it' hai jo ki singular hai uske according singular verb 'doesn't' aayegi. Note:- 'as to' me koi mistake nhi hai 'as to' ka meaning hota hai related to something matltab kisi vishay se sambandhit

questions.question: It have been only (a)/ through writing (b)/ that men have been able (c)/ to spread their ideas to mankind.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'it' singular noun hai isliye iske according singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: Billionaire Philip is (a)/ the owner of (b)/ the luxury yacht Lionheart, which worth (c)/ an estimated $150 million.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'which is worth' instead of 'which worth'
Explanation:- kyunki 'worth' ek adjective hai yeh verb ka kaam nahi kar sakta isliye 'is' linking verb ka use karke structure sahi karna padega.

questions.question: One of (a)/ the biggest enterprise (b)/ in India (c)/ is declaring a lockout.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'enterprises' instead of 'enterprise'
Explanation:- kyunki 'of' preposition yahan selection ke liye aati hai isliye aage likha noun plural form me aata hai.
One of + Noun (Plural) + Verb (Singular)

questions.question: Participating in (a)/ the Republic Day Parade (b)/ are considered an honour (c)/ by many people.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject banane ka kaam 'participating' gerund kar rha hai aur 'gerund' ya infinitive jab subject ka kaam karte hain toh verb singular aati hai.

questions.question: Sterling is only twenty-four but have achieved so much in his professional football career.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki 'sterling' kisi person ka name hai jo ki proper noun ho jayega aur singular verb lega.

questions.question: The problem of world hunger arises because of the economic inequality that distort food distribution.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'distorts' instead of 'distort'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan that relative pronoun - 'the economic inequality' ko refer kar rha hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye yahan singular verb aayegi

questions.question: It is estimated that most of the addict, a whopping 85%, in God's own country Kerala, are below 25 years of age.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'most of the addicts' instead of 'most of the addict'
Explanation:- kyunki - Most of + Noun (Plural) most of the addicts = jyadatar addicts

questions.question: Our most memorable meeting with Spielberg happened while we were at the Berlin Film Festival in 1977, where the film 'Shatranj ke Khilari' were being screened as India's official entry.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'shatranj ke khiladi' ek movie ka name hai jo ki proper noun hoga isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: A recent government report highlight that the shortage of teachers in higher educational institutions is greater than that in countries like China, Brazil, Sweden and Russia.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'highlights' instead of 'highlight'
Explanation:- kyuki yahan subject 'a recent government report' hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye singular verb aayegi.
Note:- waise 'highlights' ke alawa yhan 'highlighted' ya 'has highlighted' lga kar bhi theek kar sakte hain. Inn sabka tense alag hai ussi hisab se meaning bhi thoda alag alag hoga.

questions.question: Despite warnings the driver continued to speed and have been caught by the traffic police.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'was caught' instead of 'have been caught'
Explanation:- Subject singular hai toh verb bhi singular aayegi isiliye 'have been caught' ki jagah 'has been caught' yaa behtar hoga ki 'was caught' ka prayog karen, sentence ke meaning ke according.

questions.question: The news / of his involvement / in illegal activities /have shocked everybody.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki 'news' ek uncountable noun maana jaata hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: He wanted to know / the reason / why his low score / in Mathematics.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'why his score was low' instead of 'why his score low'
Explanation:- kyunki sentence ki grammar and meaning ko correct karne ke liye yahan 'his score' ko subject banana padega aur uske baad verb 'was' lagayi jaayegi aur 'low' subject complement ban jayega.
Note: Yahan ese bhi likh sakte hain: he wanted to know the reason for his low score. dono hi structure sahi hain.

questions.question: Either Ramesh or Reema have the keys to the cupboard.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki agar do nouns neither...nor, either.....or, not only.. but also, or, se connected ho tab verb apne paas wale noun ke according aati hai isliye yahan subject 'Reema' ke according singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: Over the years, the writer Amish has evolved to what millions of youngsters aspires to be today - an intellectual.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'aspire' instead of 'aspires'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'millions of youngsters' hai jo ki plural noun hai isliye iske according plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: When there were a strong wind, the pine trees made sad, eerie sounds.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'there' introductory subject hai aur real subject 'a strong wind' hai jo ki ek singular noun ki tarah use kiya gya hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: A large amount of money he invested were wasted.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'was wasted' instead of 'were wasted'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan is verb ka subject 'A large amount of money' hai jisme 'a large amount of' ek quantity ko dikhane wala adjectival phrase hai aur 'money' subject hai jo ki ek uncountable noun hota hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: Despite incessant rains, she is the only one who plan to attend the meeting at the ministry.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'plans' instead of 'plan' and 'that' instead of 'who'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'the only one' ko refer karna hai jiske liye relative pronoun that aayega aur 'that' ke baad singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: Organizing World Cup matches in England imply that rains can be a constant threat.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'implies' instead of 'imply'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject ka kaam 'organizing' gerund kar rha hai 'world cup matches' gerund ka object hai. Gerund ya infinitive jab subject bante hain toh verb singular lagayi jaati hai.

questions.question: That he managed to win (a)/ the championship despite his (b)/injury were really surprising. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Replace 'were really surprising' with 'was really surprising'
Explanation:- yhan c part mein aayi verb ka subject 'that' se bana hua aage ka poora noun clause hai. Isliye verb singular aayegi.

questions.question: Most of the work of this NGO are of little benefit to the disadvantaged.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki all/most/some/plenty etc ke case me verb us noun ke according aati hai jisko ye refer krte hain yahan wo noun 'work' hai jo ki ek uncountable noun hai, isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: A Royal Bengal tigress and her three cubs was poison and their carcasses left to rot in the Wildlife Sanctuary in Goa.
options: (b) and their carcasses left to rot
(c) in the Wildlife Sanctuary in Goa
(d) and her three cubs was poison
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'were poisoned' instead of 'was poison'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'A Royal Bengal tigress and her three cubs' plural hai isliye plural verb aayegi aur yhan passive meaning dena hai ki 'unhe zeher diya gya tha' isliye 'were poisoned' ayega.

questions.question: Whether he will accept (a)/ the offer or not(b)/ remain a mystery(c)/ to everyone in the office.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'remain' with 'remains'
Explanation:- yhan c part me aayi verb ka subject 'whether........or not' ye poora noun clause hai. Isliye verb singular aayegi.

questions.question: The neighbourhood were getting disturbed with the loud music that was playing at the wedding party in the big bungalow.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'was' instead of 'were'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'neighborhood' singular noun hai isliye iske according singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: According to environment activists, demolition of unauthorised apartment complexes are became a lesson for land encroachers.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'will become' instead of 'are became'
Explanation:- yahan subject 'demolition' hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye singular verb aayegi aur 'are became' tense ke according bhi sahi nhi hai. Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'has become/became/is becoming/will become' in verbs ka use kiya jaa sakta hai.

questions.question: People with full time sedentary jobs who commuting long distances, may have sleep problems due to lack of exercise.
options: (c) People with full time sedentary jobs
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'commute' instead of 'commuting'
Explanation:- kyunki v1+ing bina 'helping verb' ke nahi aati isliye 'commuting' galat hai aur yahan habitual action ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'who' ke baad waali verb present indefinite me likhi jaayegi.

questions.question: Prasad recalled that meeting people have been a part of his life as a student activist.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'had' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject ka kaam 'meeting' gerund kar rha hai aur people iss gerund ka object hai. Gerund ya infinitive jab subject bante hain toh verb singular lagayi jaati hai. Aur main clause past mein hai toh usually sub-clause ko bhi past me hi likhte hai.

questions.question: The simplest way to get proper recognition are through doing things with dedication and sincerity.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'the simplest way' hai jo ki ek singular noun hai isliye singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: The man with a lost eye have been accused of murder of two girls in his neighbourhood.
options: (d) The man with a lost eye
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'The man' hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye singular verb aayegi.
Note: the man with a lost eye - wo vyakti jo ek aankh se andha hai.

questions.question: The Prime Minister, along with the other ministers have left for America.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'has' instead of 'have'
Explanation:- kyunki jab do nouns 'with, along with, together with, in addition to, as well as, like, besides' in sab words se connect kiye jaate hain toh ye word prepositional phrase ka kaam karte hain aur inke baad aane wala noun prepositional object ban jaata hai isliye verb first noun jo subject ka kaam karta hai uske according aati hai. Yahan verb Prime Minister ke according singular aayegi.

questions.question: Everything that I like to eat are fattening.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'everything' hai jo aur 'that.....fattening' ye everything ke liye adjectival clause hai isilye 'everything' ke according singular verb 'is' aayegi.

questions.question: Only one copy of the book, running into 1200 pages, on Gandhiji's visit to the State of Andhra Pradesh, remain now.
options: (c) on Gandhiji's visit to the State
(d) Only one copy of the book
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'remains' instead of 'remain'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan subject 'only one copy' hai jo ki singular noun hai isliye singular verb aayegi.
Note:- running into 1200 pages = jisme pages ki sankhaya 1200 hai.

questions.question: Our class teacher who (a)/ encourages and helps all her students(b)/ are respected by everyone in the school. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Replace 'are respected' with 'is respected'
Explanation:- yhan c part me aayi verb ka subject 'Our class teacher' hai isliye verb singular aayegi. 'Our class teacher' subject ke baad adjective clause likha hai isliye verb subject se door likhi gyi hai uss se confuse nhi hona hai

questions.question: The famous author and actor are being honoured at a function today.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'is' instead of 'are'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'the famous author and actor' singular noun hai kyunki yahan definite article 'the' ek noun ke aage hi laga hua hai isliye famous author aur actor dono ek hi person hai, isliye iske according singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: The birth of a girl bring great joy to Neha's family.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan verb ka subject 'birth' noun hai jo ki singular hai isliye sentence me di gayi plural 'bring' verb galat ho gayi yahan 'brings' bhi nahi aa sakta kyunki ye koi habitual action nahi hai. Best meaning ke liye yhan 'brought' ya 'has brought' ka use karenge.

questions.question: Neither John nor Simon [are coming to the meeting].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Neither.....nor/Either.....or/Not only.....but also' wale structure me verb uss noun ke according aati hai jo verb ke paas hota hai isliye yhan 'Simon' ke according verb singular aayegi.

questions.question: Honesty as well as discipline [are required to succeed in life].
options: (a) are requirement to succeed in life.
(b) is required to succeed in life
(c) has required to succeed in life
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'as well as' yhan prepositional phrase hai isliye 'honesty' subject banega aur ye singular hai to verb bhi singular aayegi isliye option A and D galat hain. Meaning ke according C option sahi nhi hai isliye B option Answer hoga.

questions.question: Shubham and [I were watching] football match in our bedroom.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yhan 'and' conjunction se 2 subjects join kiye gye hain isliye 'I' ayega aur verb plural aayegi. isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: [Many an old story were retold], and ancient conundrum repeated.
options: (a) Many an old story was retold
(c) Many an old stories were retold
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Many a/an' ke sath singular noun aata hai aur verb bhi singular aati hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: The probable side effects of this medication [include burning and itching].
options: (b) can be including burning and itching
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yhan subject 'side effects' hai jo ki plural hai isliye plural verb aayegi isliye C option galat hai. V1+ ing form bina helping ke nhi aati isliye A option galat hai. yhan continuous wala meaning nhi dena hai isliye B option galat hai. Meaning and grammar ke according D option sahi hai.

questions.question: [Neither of the political parties have had much] interest in environmental causes.
options: (b) Neither of the political parties have had any
(c) Neither of the political parties have much
(d) Neither of the political parties has had much
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yhan subject 'neither' jo ki distributive pronoun hai isliye verb singular aayegi. D option sahi hai.

questions.question: The plants [readily respond to these stimulus].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yhan subject 'plants' plural hai aur these ke baad plural ayega isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Either the bears or the lion [has escaped from the zoo].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Neither.....nor/Either.....or/Not only.....but also' ke pair me verb uss subject ke according aati hai jo verb ke paas hota hai isliye 'lion' ke according verb singular aayegi. isliye A and B options galat hain. Yhan passive nhi active voice aayegi isliye D option galat hai. C option grammatically sahi hai.

questions.question: The student with his parents [were asked for waiting] outside the Principal's office.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yhan 'with' preposition hai aur 'parents' prepositional object hai and subject 'student' hai aur verb singular aayegi. isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: We must realise that learning from [mistakes is an] important part of life
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yhan clause me subject 'learning' (gerund) hai isliye verb singular aayegi isliye A and D options galat hain. yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'galtiyon se seekhna jindgi ka ek important part hai' isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option sahi hai.

questions.question: Indian team [were declared] the winner of the cricket World Cup.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Indian team' ek collective noun hai jo ki ek unit mana jayega isliye verb singular aayegi aur meaning ke according yhan passive voice aayegi isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: I, Anjali Menon, [is happy to let you know] that I have married Chetan Sharma.
options: (b) are happy to let you know
(c) am happy to let you know
(d) has happy to let you know
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yhan real subject 'I' hai aur 'Anjali Menon' case in apposition hai isliye 'I' ke according 'am' verb aayegi.

questions.question: There are indications that the prospects for growth in industrial output [has improved].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yhan subject 'prospects' hai isliye verb plural aayegi aur yhan 'improve hue hain' meaning dena hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Nothing but books and magazines [please] her.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- sahi structure ye hota hai:- Nothing but + noun + verb (singular) isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: Setbacks and failures [has always been] an integral part of science.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yhan subject 'Setbacks and failures' hain isliye verb plural aayegi isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Not only the boss but also all the employees [were involved] in this fraud.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Neither..nor/Either..or/Not only...but also' ke pair me verb uss noun ke according aati hai jo verb ke pass hota hai isliye 'employees' ke according verb plural aayegi aur meaning ye dena hai ki 'involved the' isliye C option sahi hai

questions.question: A new pair of shoes [have been purchased] by me.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yhan subject 'A pair' hai isliye verb singular aayegi aur meaning ke according verb passive voice mein aayegi isliye A option sahi hai

questions.question: None of the guests [were willing to stay] till the next day.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'None of + noun' ke baad singular verb prefer ki jaati hai aur willing ke baad infinitive 'to stay' aayega isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: Each boy and each girl of our [was present] at the annual function.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Each' ek distributive adjective hai isliye bhale hi 2 nouns 'and' se jude hue hain par verb singular hi aayegi aur yhan meaning dena hai 'present tha' isliye C option sahi hai

questions.question: [Every] of these students is able to speak English fluently.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Every' ek adjective hota hai isliye ye subject nhi ban sakta isliye D option galat hai. All ke sath verb plural aati hai isliye B option galat hai. None se meaning change ho jayega isliye C option galat hai. Meaning and grammar ke according A option sahi hai.

questions.question: As soon as the monsoon starts, the number of tourists [start decreasing].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sahi structure ye hota hai:- 'The number of + noun(plural) + verb(sing)' isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: There [has been] many incidents of robbery in this area.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yhan 'there' introductory subject hai aur real subject 'many incidents' hai. isliye verb plural aayegi aur meaning ke according perfect tense ayega isliye C option sahi hai

questions.question: A number of innocent people [dies owing to wars] all over the world every year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- sahi structure ye hota hai - 'A number of + noun(plural) + verb (plural)' isliye plural verb aayegi aur die verb ka passive nhi hota isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: I know very well that one of you [have stolen] my book.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yhan subject 'one' hai isliye verb singular aayegi isliye C option galat hai. V1+ ing bina helping verb ke nhi aata isliye D option galat hai yhan past perfect nhi ayega isliye B option galat hai. Meaning and grammar ke according A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Among those broken chairs [were lying] a brand new table.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yhan inversion structure ka use hua hai. real subject 'table' hai isliye verb singular aayegi yhan meaning dena hai ki 'padi thi' isliye B option 'was lying' sahi hai

questions.question: Only the quality of the products (a)/ and the efficiency of the service (b)/ doesn't determine (c)/ the company's overall reputation. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'doesn't' with 'don't'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'the quality' and 'the efficiency' do subject hai jo 'and' conjunction se jude hai, kyunki subject plural hai, isliye verb bhi plural aayega, isliye 'doesn't' ki jagah par 'don't' plural verb sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Aarav believes that (a)/ it don't make any difference (b)/ whether you succeed instantly (c)/ or achieve your goals after years of hard work. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'don't' with 'doesn't'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'whether you...........hard work' poore clause ko subject banane ki bajaaye 'it' introductory subject lagana prefer karte hai, aur 'it' ke sath verb singular aati hai, aage chahe real subject singular ho yaa plural. Isliye sentence mein 'don't' ki jagah par 'doesn't' singular verb sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Each and every student, (a)/ teacher and parent (b)/ were requested to attend (c)/ the annual function held in the auditorium. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'were requested' with 'was requested'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'were' ki jagah 'was' aayega kyunki yahan bhale hi 3 subject ho, lekin 'each' aur 'every' distributive nature ke words hai, jinke sath singular verb aati hai, isliye yahan 'were' ki jagah 'was' aayega.

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees (a)/ was willing to accept (b)/ the new working conditions (c)/ introduced by the company last month. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'was willing' with 'were willing'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'was' ki jagah par 'were' aayega kyunki 'either-or, neither-nor, not only - but also' ke baad verb, verb ke pass waale subject ke according hai, toh sentence mein pass wala 'employees' plural subject hai, isliye yahan 'was' ki jagah 'were' plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: I don't think that (a)/ two miles are a long distance (b)/ to be covered on foot at your age. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'are' with 'is'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'are' ki jagah 'is' aayega kyunki 'time, weight, value, distance' ko dikhaane waale jo words agar single unit ki tarah kaam kare toh inke sath singular verb aati hai, aur sentence mein 'a' article bhi hint hai ki 'two miles' subject ek single unit ki tarah kaam kar raha hai, isliye yahan 'are' ki jagah 'is' aayega.

questions.question: Both the director of the company and his senior advisors (a)/ has emphasized (b)/ the need for transparency (c)/ in all the financial transactions.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'has' with 'have'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'has' ki jagah 'have' aayega kyunki 'both' se pata chal raha ki dono subject ki baat ho rahi hai 'the director' aur 'senior advisors' ki, isliye yahan 'has' ki jagah 'have' plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: I know very well (a)/ that bread and butter (b)/ have been your favourite breakfast (c)/ since childhood.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'have' with 'has'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'have' ki jagah 'has' aayega kyunki kuch complementary food jaise 'bread and butter, curry and rice' yeh combination food hote hai, jo humesha sath mein khaaye jaate hai, isliye inke sath singular verb aati hai, isliye 'have' ki jagah 'has' singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: The performance of the athletes, as (a)/ well as the coaches, in the (b)/ international sports meet (c)/ were appreciated by the whole country. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'were' with 'was'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'were' ki jagah 'was' aayega kyunki 'the performance' singular subject hai, baaki 'athletes, coaches, international sport meet' prepositions ke object hai, toh verb subject ke according aati hai, isliye yahan 'were' ki jagah 'was' singular verb aayegi.

questions.question: More than one applicant (a)/ have claimed (b)/ that the terms and conditions (c)/ mentioned in the contract were misleading. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'have claimed' with 'has claimed'
