Ans (b) put 'very angrily' before 'in the meeting'
Explanation:- 'very angrily' 'in the meeting' ke pehle ayega kyunki isme 'Manner, Place, Time' ka structure follow ho raha hai, jiske according 'very angrily' Manner, Place se pehle ayega, isliye 'very angrily in the meeting' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He forgets usually (a)/ to carry his ID card (b)/ to the examination centre (c). No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'usually' before 'forgets'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'usually' manner of frequency hai jisko verb se pehle likhte hai jaise 'often, seldom, always, rarely etc' yeh verb se pehle aate hai aur 'daily, weekly, monthly etc' yeh clause ke end mein aate hai, isliye yahan 'usually forgets' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The villagers trusted (a)/ the new leader so more that (b)/ they followed all his instructions (c)/ without any question (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'more' with 'much'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'more' ki jagah 'much' ayega kyunki 'more' ek comparative degree hai lekin sentence mein koi comparison nahi karna, isliye yahan positive degree 'much' ayega aur 'so' 'much' ki intensity badhaane ke liye aaya hai.

questions.question: It was a most enjoyable evening and everyone (a)/ praised the host for arranging (b)/ such a pleasant get-together. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) no error
Explanation:- 'a most' ka matlab 'very' hota hai.

questions.question: You will be surprised (a)/ to know that she hasn't apologized (b)/ for her rude behaviour, nor her brother has (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) put 'has' before 'her brother'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'addition to statement' ka structure follow ho raha hai jisme negative sentence mein 'neither/nor + helping verb + subject' ka structure follow hota hai, isliye yahan 'has her brother' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: No matter she works how sincerely, (a)/ she never gets appreciated (b)/ for her efforts. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'how sincerely' before 'she works'
Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'koi farak nahi padta ki wo kitni sincerely kaam kare' iss type ke meaning ke liye yeh structure use hota hai 'no matter how sincerely she works'. Example 'no matter how hard he try', 'no matter how early I come' iss type ke meaning ke liye yeh structure use hota hai. isliye 'how sincerely' 'she works' se pehle ayega.

questions.question: Neem leaves are often used in making soaps (a)/ which are specially very effective (b)/ in preventing skin infections. (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'specially very effective' with 'very effective especially'
Explanation:- 'specially' ka matlab 'koi special tarika' aur 'especially' ka matlab 'koi particular'. Sentence mein 'neem soaps' ki baat ho rahi aur particularly skin infection ko prevent karne mein, isliye yahan 'very effective especially' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The audience clapped when the singer [graceful] bowed at the end of her mesmerizing performance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'bowed' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai aur 'graceful' adjective hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se 'gracefully' adverb sabse sahi answer hoga. 'gracefulness' aur 'graciousness' noun hai aur 'gracious' adjective hai.

questions.question: The students were [too happy] to see their favourite teacher return after a long medical leave.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'too.......to' ka structure negative meaning convey karta hai, lekin sentence mein positive baat karni hai, aur matlab dena hai 'students bahut khush the', isliye yahan 'very happy' option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question:
Select the appropriate option to replace the underlined word with the adverb of frequency.
She [did not agree] that her decision had hurt her close friends who had supported her for years.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein adverb of frequency pucha hai, 'yesterday agreed' adverb of time hai, 'willingly agreed, happily agreed' adverb of manner hai, isliye diye gaye option mein se option A 'never agreed' adverb of frequency sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Hardly [we had reached] the examination hall when the final bell rang, and everyone rushed to their seats.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai aur inversion follow hota hai, jisme verb subject se pehle aati hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'had we reached' inversion sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: [No sooner did the students finish] their final exams, than they began planning for a long vacation.
options: (a) No sooner do the students finish
(b) No sooner have the students finished
(d) No sooner had the students finishing
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (c) No substitution

questions.question: Even though both my sisters dance gracefully, [I can perform more well than both of them] on stage.
options: (a) I can perform more good than both of them
(b) I can perform good than both of them
(c) I can perform best than both of them
(d) I can perform better than both of them
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Sentence mein ek ka comparison dono sisters se karna hai aur yahan 'sisters' ek unit maane gaye hai, isliye yahan superlative degree nahi balki comparative degree ayegi, isliye 'well' ki comparative degree 'better' sahi hogi, isliye option D 'better than both of them' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The old bridge became so weak that vehicles could [none long cross] it safely during the monsoon.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein jab kehna ho ki 'ab hum aage nahi jaa sakte', iske liye 'no longer' phrase ka use karte hai, isliye yahan option A 'no longer cross' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The teacher [observed close] how each student responded during the practical exam.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'observed' ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai aur 'closely' adverb hota hai, isliye option B aur C galat honge. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki koi habitual action ki baat nahi karni. Isliye option A 'closely observed' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Drinking too much green tea can act as a mild diuretic, making your body release water [more often].
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (d) No improvement

questions.question: The students presented their dance [in the auditorium beautifully last night].
options: (a) beautifully in the auditorium last night
(b) last night beautifully in the auditorium
(c) in the auditorium last night beautifully
(d) beautifully last night in the auditorium
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein Manner, Place, Time ka structure follow hoga, isliye option A 'beautifully in the auditorium last night' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The speeding truck lost control on the highway, [narrowly missing] a group of school children crossing the road.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (d) No substitution

questions.question: [They only invited their close friends to the private ceremony.]
options: (a) They invited only their close friends to the private ceremony.
(b) They invited their only close friends to the private ceremony.
(c) Only they invited their close friends to the private ceremony.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'only' adverb hai jo yahan 'their' adjective ko qualify kar raha hai, isliye 'only' 'their' ke pehle ayega, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The soldier ran away from the battlefield [like coward].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence mein adverb ki jarurat hai, jo ki adverbial phrase of manner se banega jise 'in a cowardly manner' yaa 'like a coward' likhenge, isliye diye gaye options mein se option B 'like a coward' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The officer ordered [the guards to immediately close the gates].
options: (a) the guards to close the gates immediately
(b) the guards immediately to close the gates
(c) to the guards close immediately the gates
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'immediately' ki position galat hai kyunki yeh 'infinitive' ko split kar raha hai, isliye 'immediately' ko last mein likhenge, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The journey was comfortable but [the bit tiring] than I thought it would be.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Sentence mein comparison karna hai ki 'jitna socha tha usse jyada', isliye yahan 'more' ayega aur 'thoda sa' ke liye 'a bit' phrase use hota hai, isliye yahan 'a bit more tiring' option D sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: During an earthquake, / it is advised to take / cover above a table / to save your life.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'under' instead of 'above'
Explanation:- kyunki 'earthquake' ke case me table ke neeche chhupa jaayega.

questions.question: This test comprises of grammar, vocabulary and reading comprehension.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Remove 'of'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'comprise' ek transitive verb hai, iske saath kisi bhi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai

questions.question: They will go to bed / early since they / have to get up / at five on the morning.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Kyunki correct phrase 'in the morning' hota hai.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) It has been raining till morning.
(b) It has been raining from morning.
(c) It has been raining by morning.
(d) It has been raining since morning.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-'point of time' ke liye 'since' preposition ka use hota hai.

questions.question: She, often, accuses him for a lack of morality.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'of' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'accuse' verb ka fix structure ye hota hai:- accuse somebody of something

questions.question: To my point of view he should not have behaved in such a manner.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'from' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki correct phrase is 'from my point of view'.

questions.question: There is a whole world / out there that / is invisible from / the naked eye.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'to' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- kyunki 'Invisible to something/somebody' correct phrase hai.

questions.question: Not complying by any of the laws can land you into serious trouble.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'with' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'comply' ke sath 'with' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Amla juice / is rich with / Vitamin C. / No error
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'in' instead of 'with'
Explanation:-Rich in something - having a lot of money or valuable possessions.

questions.question: The jury was not happy with the performance / and was quite harsh. / The singer took / their criticism in heart.
options: (a) The jury was not happy with the performance
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'to' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Take something to heart (Idiom) - take criticism seriously and be affected or upset by it.

questions.question: Darkness spilled like ink and began to spread at everything.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:-use 'over' instead of 'at'
Over everything - covering everything.

questions.question:
Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.
There are no tables at the classroom.
options: (a) [There are] no tables at the classroom.
(b) There are [no tables] at the classroom.
(c) There are no tables at [the classroom.]
(d) There are no tables [at] the classroom.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'in' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- In inside a container, place, or area, or surrounded or closed off by something.

questions.question: The prisoner was / accused for stealing / from his landlord.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'of' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Accuse somebody of something. Be accused of something.

questions.question: The Japanese artist Yoh Nagao was busy splashing the wall from colours.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'with' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Splash kisi vyakti ya vastu par (taral padarth ke) cheente padna ya daalna. Splash somebody/something with something
Note: busy splashing me koi error nahi hai. 'Busy' ke baad bina preposition ke direct 'v1 + ing' form allowed hai.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-'fond' ke saath 'of preposition fix hai.

questions.question: I am having trouble / deciding in / a gift for them. / No error
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'upon/on' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Decide on/upon (phrasal verb) meaning = Chhantna. to choose something from a number of possibilities.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) Ashok was in the bus stop.
(b) Ashok was to the bus stop.
(c) Ashok was on the bus stop.
(d) Ashok was at the bus stop
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-At used to show an exact position or particular place.

questions.question: She has / a habit of / spending against / her means.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'beyond' instead of 'against'
Explanation:- Beyond - outside or after a stated limit

questions.question: She has not written / a single novel / by three years.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for/in' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- For used to refer to the duration of time.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-'On' is used before days.

questions.question: I will stop to refreshments at the next restaurant on the highway.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- purpose ko dikhane ke liye infinitive (to + v1) ya 'for + noun' structure ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Huda lived in / the southern part / off Germany.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'of' instead of 'off'
Explanation:- Of - used to show possession, belonging, or origin Off - away from a place or position, especially the present place, position, or time.

questions.question: The meeting was held upon / for an hour / due to non-availability / of the committee members.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'up' instead of 'upon'
Explanation:-
Hold up - to delay someone or something.

questions.question: No talking / on the dinner table / is an absolute rule.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'at' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- At used to show an exact position or particular place
Note:- 'No talking' me 'talking' gerund yahan subject ka kaam kar rha hai.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) Are you interested along with modern art?
(b) Are you interested into modern art?
(c) Are you interested with modern art?
(d) Are you interested in modern art?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-'interested' ka ye structure hota hai :- Be interested in something.

questions.question: There can be precious / diamonds and metals / in the surface / just below you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'under' instead of 'in'.
Explanation:- in the surface = surface me.
under the surface = surface ke neeche. Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- 'diamonds and metals' ho sakte hain just tumhare neeche jo surface hai uske neeche.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) The lion and the unicorn fought between the crown.
(b) The lion and the unicorn fought for the crown.
(c) The lion and the unicorn fought by the crown.
(d) The lion and the unicorn fought up the crown.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:-Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'lion and unicorn' crown ke liye lade the. Purpose ko dikhane ke liye 'for' preposition ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Lack of formal education did not prevent Lincoln to become a great leader.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'from becoming' instead of 'to become'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'prevent' ke sath 'from' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The investors were / put off by the dirty / visage of the workshop.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c). No error
Explanation:-put off cause someone to lose interest or enthusiasm. (kisi ka interest khatam kar dena)

questions.question: He took a hurried glance / on the newspaper / and swiftly left for work.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'at' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Glance at something

questions.question: Fortunately, he passed the exams / with dint of / sheer hard work and diligence.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'by' instead of 'with'
Explanation:- By dint of something (ke bal par) as a result of something.

questions.question: He has always been / quite careless for / his own safety.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'of/about' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Careless of/about something

questions.question: His cell phone is / different and costlier / than mine.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'different from' instead of 'different'
Explanation:- Kyunki agar 2 words kisi conjunction se connected ho toh dono apne according preposition lete hain.

questions.question: She persisted / to doing / what she wanted / despite opposition.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'in' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Persisted in doing something.

questions.question: The unseasonal rain / caused a lot of damage / to the crops.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) No error
Explanation:-'damage' ke sath 'to' preposition hi aati hai isliye ye 'no error' hai.

questions.question: Take care / for keep / your valuables safely.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'to' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Take care to do something - to be careful

questions.question: I had all / the comforts to life / in my childhood.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'of' instead of 'to'
Explanation:-
Of- used to show possession, belonging, or origin:

questions.question: The increase in irrigated areas / has resulted on achieving / record food grain production.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'result' verb ke sath 'in' preposition ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: She performed / the task / at the best / of her ability.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'to' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- To the best of one's ability as well as one can.

questions.question: I was angry / on myself / for making / such a silly mistake.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'with' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Angry with someone.

questions.question: He was formerly / a doctor of the corporate hospital.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'at' instead of 'of'
Explanation:- At used to show an exact position or particular place.

questions.question: This hall is / badly to need / of repair.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'in' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- In need of something

questions.question: They ordered the whole area / to be disinfected / on the earliest.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'at' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- At the earliest- jitna jaldi ho sake.

questions.question: Vivek should be excited / on the promotion / he's got.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'about' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Excited about something.

questions.question: Among you and me / she is quite rude / to the boy.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'between' instead of 'among'
Explanation:- Between you and me what I am about to say should be kept secret.

questions.question: He conceded / a very crucial / point at / his opponent.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'to' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- Concede something to somebody = to allow somebody to take something although you do not want to. Dusre ki bina ichcha hone ke baad bhi kuchh le jaane ka adhikar pradaan karna.

questions.question: The river / flowed besides / the hillock / in our village.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'beside' instead of 'besides'
Explanation:- Beside at the side of, next to:
Besides in addition to; also:

questions.question: Whenever he is / on a holiday, / he travels by foot / to the temple nearby.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'on' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- On foot walking.

questions.question: The notice / that the office / posted over the wall / is very appropriate.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'on' instead of 'over'
Explanation:- On used to show that something is in a position above something else and touching it, or that something is moving into such a position:
Over - above or higher than something else, sometimes so that one thing covers the other, above:

questions.question: Going to the weekly market / in every Tuesday / is a ritual that has been followed / by generations in my family.
options: (d) is a ritual that has been followed
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'on' instead of 'in' / Remove 'in' from 'in every tuesday'
Explanation:- 'in every tuesday' galat hai. Aur 'every tuesday' best option hai halanki 'on every tuesday' bhi chal sakta hai kyunki 'days' ke naam se pehle 'on' ka use kiya jaata hai. Lekin dono mese 'every tuesday' best option hai.

questions.question: Investing on real estate / can earn you quick profit / but it comes with a certain amount of risk attached to it.
options: (d) a certain amount of risk attached to it
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Invest in something

questions.question: Lack of required / vitamins and minerals / lead against / several complications / in the human body.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'leads to' instead of 'lead against'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'lead' ke baad 'to' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The recruiters / were pleased to John's / domain knowledge and personality.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'with' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Pleased with something/somebody.

questions.question: Will you please come / to help me / along this heavy box?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'with' instead of 'along'
Explanation:- Help verb ke structures:- Help someone in doing something. Help someone with something.

questions.question: We don't really / want a large house; / we are looking for some comfort / and some convenience on a moderate price.
options: (a) and some convenience on a moderate price
(d) we are looking for some comfort
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'at/for' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- 'price' ke liye 'at' ya 'for' preposition ka use hota hai. I bought it at/for a decent price.

questions.question: The visitors complained / at the poor accommodation / they were provided / during the tour.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'of' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- Complain of something.
Complain about/against someone

questions.question: At the last meeting / which took place in November, / half the members submitted / their resignations on protest.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- In protest kisi cheez ke virodh me.
Note: Half the members = half of the members ye dono structures allowed hain.

questions.question: Mithila art tradition is passed on / from one generation through a next / by children watching and helping / their mothers and grandmothers.
options: (a) from one generation through a next
(b) Mithila art tradition is passed on
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'to' instead of 'through'
Explanation:- From.. to

questions.question: Employees were given incentives based at their performance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'on' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'based' ke sath 'on' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Thousands of people / in Telangana are employed on / the granite companies.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- granite companies mein

questions.question: The guards in the colony always keep an eye in things going on around.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'on' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Keep an eye on something- to watch or take care of something or someone.

questions.question: Please give me / a kilo of potatoes, / two kilos of tomatoes and / a bunch coriander leaves.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'of' before coriander.
Explanation:- bunch of something Of used to show possession, belonging, or origin.

questions.question: Most hotels / offer for their guests / complimentary breakfast / during their stay there.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'for'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'offer' ek transitive verb hai iske sath preposition ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: A probe has been ordered / by the incident / that occurred at the celebrations.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'into' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- Probe into something.

questions.question: Who all are not desirous (a)/to get a well paid job (b)/and a beautiful lady to live life with? (c)/ No error (d)
options: (b) to get a well paid job
(c) and a beautiful lady to live life with?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use of getting in place of to get
Explanation:- 'Desirous' ke saath 'of preposition fix hai.

questions.question: I am going / to home / soon after the / programme gets over.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki yahan 'home' adverb hai aur adverb ke pehle koi preposition ka use nahi hota.

questions.question: There is constant friction / between the executive members / of the Association.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'among' instead of 'between'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'between' ka use 2 ke liye aur 'among' ka use 2 se zyada ke liye.

questions.question: Please refrain to going out without a face mask.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'from' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'refrain' ke sath 'from' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: You need to sign / these important documents / by ink.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'in' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'ink' ke saath 'in' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He could not / get a job / despite of / his best efforts.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'of'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'despite' ke sath 'of ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He is / afraid from / all insects / that crawl.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'of' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'afraid' ke sath 'of ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I saw several / French colonial villas / within my visit / to Puducherry.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'during' instead of 'within'
Explanation:- During - ke dauraan.

questions.question: The bottle slipped with my hand and broke into a thousand pieces.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'from' instead of 'with'
Explanation: From used to show the place where someone or something starts.

questions.question: She has been working with me on this project from two years.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'duration of time' btane ke liye 'for' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I am sorry I haven't learnt the poem at heart.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'by' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- By heart - learned in such a way that you can repeat it from memory.

questions.question: My grandmother is quite concerned to my progress at school.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'about' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Concern about something.

questions.question: I want you to complete this work by two days.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'within' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'time limit' ko btane ke liye 'within' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Poor people have run down of food supplies during the lockdown.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'out' instead of 'down'
Explanation:- Run out of something to finish, use, or sell all of something, so that there is none left.

questions.question: This jewellery box is made from silver and is an antique piece.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'of' instead of 'from'
Explanation: kyunki physical changes ke case me 'make' ke sath 'of ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He thinks that he can get away among lying and cheating.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: 'among' ki jagah yahan 2 preposition possible hain 'by' aur 'with' dono lagane se alag-alag meaning aayega.
Eg: He thinks that he can get away by lying and cheating. usko lagta hai ki wo jhoot bolna ya cheating ka use karke bach jayega.
Eg: He thinks that he can get away with lying and cheating, usko lagta hai ki wo bachke nikal sakta hai jo usne jhoot bola hai aur cheating kari hai uski punishment se. get away with something: escape blame, punishment, or undesirable consequences for an act that is wrong. (kisi apradh se bina saza ke nikal jaana)

questions.question: He has shattered his neighbour's window by purpose.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'on' instead of 'by'
Explanation:- On purpose - intentionally.

questions.question: The girl besides you in high heels is my younger sister.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'beside' instead of 'besides'
Explanation:- Beside - at the side of, next to:
Besides in addition to; also:

questions.question: I looked him at the eye and told him all I knew.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'in' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- look someone in the eye look directly at someone without showing embarrassment, fear, or shame.

questions.question: My hotel in Goa had a wonderful view of the sea in the window.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'through' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Window ke through dekhne par view tha na ki window me.

questions.question: A panel has been formed to look within the security needs of college students.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'into' instead of 'within'
Explanation:- Look into to investigate.

questions.question: Did you tell to your mother that you saw her friend at the theatre?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Remove 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'tell' ek transitive verb hai iske sath kisi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The country has the lowest per capita income and needs to create jobs to the youth.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- kyunki 'for' ke liye yahan meaning dena hai ki:- 'Youth ke liye job'

questions.question: Though she was able to finish the work on time, she couldn't do that out in fear.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'of' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Out of fear a feeling of distress, apprehension, or alarm caused by impending danger, pain, etc.

questions.question: It is difficult to make out that they are twins because they do not resemble to each other.
options: (c) It is difficult to make out
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Remove 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'resemble' ek transitive verb hai iske sath kisi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The manager was referring about the previous instances of loss to the employees during his address.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'to' instead of 'about'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'refer' ke sath 'to' ka use kiya jaata hai

questions.question: Deepa walked down the road slowly without looking anybody.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'at' before anybody
Explanation:- Kyunki 'look' ke sath 'at' preposition ka use kiya jaata hai.
Note:- walked down me koi galti nahi hai.

questions.question: One of the greatest responsibilities of a scientist is that his discoveries and inventions are utilized to the overall development of the nation.
options: (b) One of the greatest responsibilities of a scientist
(c) is that his discoveries and inventions
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- kyunki for ke liye Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- discoveries and inventions nation ki overall development ke liye use kiya jaaye

questions.question: We had a long discussion at a cup of coffee.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'over' instead of 'at'
Explanation: Ye ek fix phrase hai.

questions.question: All employees of the National Sugar Factory differ from their boss on the medical and pension policy.
options: (b) on the medical and pension policy
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'with' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Differ with-to disagree with somebody.

questions.question: He married with a rich heiress last year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'with'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'marry' ek transitive verb hai iske sath kisi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He succeeded to get / a decent job soon / after his graduation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use in getting in place of to get.
Explanation:- succeed in doing something

questions.question: Sita has no taste in classical dance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'for' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- Taste for to have interest Koi cheez pasand hona ya usme interest hona.

questions.question: In about two weeks our holidays will start.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) No error
Explanation:- Note: 'about' yahan 'two' adjective ke liye adverb hai na ki preposition.

questions.question: Across his morning walk on a beach in Mamallapuram, Prime Minister Modi was seen picking up plastic litter, bottles and other items.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'during' instead of 'across'
Explanation:- During - ke dauran

questions.question: The Government is setting up a special surveillance cell for epidemic-prone diseases at flood-ravaged Bihar.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'in' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- 'state' ke name se pehle 'at' nahi 'in' ka use hoga- 'in Bihar'

questions.question: After two months the phone signals were back at the valley.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'in' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- Note: ye dono structures theek hain 'go back to a place' he went back to his hometown. 'be + back in a place' we are back in our hometown

questions.question: If he wants to recover, he must abstain for alcohol.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'from' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'abstain' ke sath 'from' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: These facts should not have been disclosed for the public.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'to' instead of 'for'
Explanation:- Disclose something to somebody.

questions.question: The detective compared the forged signature to the original.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'with' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- kyunki compare (verb) with compare (adj) - to Iss sentence me 'compare' verb hai.

questions.question: The day before yesterday he left for Europe by the air.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'the'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'means of transportation' se pehle kisi article ka use nahi kiya jaata hai, 'by + transport ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Fate smiled above him in all his business ventures.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'on' instead of 'above'
Explanation:- Fate smiled on someone (idiom) - kisi par kismat meherbaan hona.

questions.question: He knocked the door for a few minutes and when he got / no response, he got back immediately.
options: (b) a few minutes and when he got
(c) no response, he got back immediately.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use knocked at the door in place of knocked the door.
Explanation:- knock at - darwaaza khatkhataana.

questions.question: Each student will have to carry his own lunch on the picnic.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'to' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- carry something to a place

questions.question: The actor smiled to me when I entered the room as if she knew me.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'at' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'smile' ke saath 'at' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: We reserved tickets for a journey on train for the next morning for my sisters and me.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'by' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'means of transportation' se pehle kisi article ka use nahi kiya jaata hai 'by + transport' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I am sorry to say that / I am not familiar with you and / with such types of things.
options: (a) I am sorry to say that
(b) I am not familiar with you and
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (b) Use familiar to you in place of familiar with you.

questions.question: I won't be here next week as I'm going to Mumbai to a conference.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- For - ke liye Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki Main Mumbai jaa raha hun ek conference ke liye.

questions.question: What shall we do on ourselves this evening?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'with' instead of 'on'
Explanation:- Yeh ek fix phrase hai:- what shall we do with ourselves this evening - hum aaj shaam ko kya karenge?

questions.question: Instead of studying in home I went to my friend's house.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'at' instead of 'in'
Explanation:- At used to show an exact position or particular place,

questions.question: High level security arrangements were made for the forthcoming visit to a Japanese Prime Minister.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'of' instead of 'to' and use 'The Prime Minister' instead of 'Prime Minister'
Explanation:- visit of the Japanese Prime minister = Japanese Prime minister ki visit

questions.question: It takes me one hour to get to work in the morning in week day.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'on a week day ya on week days' instead of 'in week day'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'days' se pehle 'on' ka use kiya jaata hai, aur ya toh 'day' se pehle article lagega ya use plural karenge.

questions.question: We have sufficient food and clothing about the flood victims in Kerala.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'about'
Explanation:- Sufficient for somebody/something.

questions.question: The Social Media Department is headless at the moment and many are vying to the post.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Vie for something - compete for something vie for (phrasal verb) kisi cheez ke liye compete karna.

questions.question: I am going to a holiday to Panchmukhi tomorrow.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'on' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'go on a holiday' ek fix phrase hai.

questions.question: Each film will be checked by a government-appointed censor board along public exhibition.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'before' instead of 'along'
Explanation: kyunki 'before' pehle Aur yahan meaning ye dena hai ki: public exhibition se pehle.

questions.question: Instead of helping her mother at the kitchen, Rekha was on her mobile talking to her friend.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'in' instead of 'at'
Explanation:- In inside a container, place, or area, or surrounded or closed off by something.

questions.question: We have observed that / many good programmers suffer of / shortage of funds and other resources.
options: (c) shortage of funds and other resources.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (b) Use suffer from in place of suffer of.

questions.question: Whether it is English / or Hindi I am with home / with both the languages.
options: (b) or Hindi I am with home
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use at home in place of with home.
Explanation:- at home comfortable with something. Eg. I am at home with this concept = Main is concept ko achchi tarah se samjhta hun ya iske sath comfortable hun.

questions.question: The servant was beaten through his master with a stick.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'by' instead of 'through'
Explanation:- Kyunki passive voice me 'by + doer' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The city of Banaras is widely known from its ghats and temples.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Known for something- kisi cheez ke liye mashhoor hona.

questions.question: In the evening he likes to read books and articles that have nothing to do of his work.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'with' instead of 'of'
Explanation:- have nothing to do with something = not related to something. Eg. - This argument has nothing to do with me.

questions.question: A friend of mine is working as a photographer of the local newspaper.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'for' instead of 'of'
Explanation:- Work for somebody/something.
Note:- Agar 'the local newspaper' ko 'as an institution' maane toh 'at' bhi laga sakte hain but meaning ke according yahan 'for' better hai.

questions.question: There is no point of arguing over something so unimportant.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'in' instead of 'of'
Explanation:- No point in doing something = Yeh kaam karne se koi fayda nahi hai.

questions.question: We may have to await for / a new political order to restructure / our economy by adopting a model of development closer to our needs.
options: (a) We may have to await for
(b) a new political order to restructure
(c) our economy by adopting a model of development closer to our needs.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use await in place of await for.
Explanation:- await wait for. 'await' ek transitive verb hai iske aur object ke beech me preposition nahi aayegi.

questions.question: After playing cricket / till 2 o'clock / the children ate their lunch / and left to home.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'for' instead of 'to'
Explanation: Leave for a place kisi jagah ke liye nikalna.

questions.question: I went to see / the Taj Mahal in a / moonlit night.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use on in place of in.
Explanation:-
Note:- 'generally night' se pehle 'at' preposition ka use hota hai. Par agar koi 'specific night' ki baat ho rhi ho toh 'on' ka use karte hain. Eg. On the Christmas night. On the Diwali night

questions.question: She was the best singer / on the country / who had sung / more than 5,000 songs.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'on'

questions.question: My friends proposed me / that we should go to the movie / and then have dinner at a hotel.
options: (b) that we should go to the movie
(c) and then have dinner at a hotel.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use proposed to me in place of proposed me.
Explanation:- 'propose' verb ka object 'human being' nahi banega.

questions.question: The robbers broke in the house at night.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'into' instead of 'in'
Explanation: Break into enter or open a place, vehicle, or container forcibly, especially for the purposes of theft.

questions.question: While she was returning / from college, a ruffian / attacked on her with a dagger.
options: (c) attacked on her with a dagger.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove on.
Explanation:- attack transitive verb hai

questions.question: To escape floods, a tigress took refuge at a vegetable garden.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (b) use 'in' instead of 'at'

questions.question: People living in low-lying / areas find it difficult to / cope up with the floods.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use cope with in place of cope up with.
Explanation:- cope with to deal successfully with a difficult matter or situation. Kathin sthiti se safaltapurvak nipatna.

questions.question: Diksha has been in a grumpy mood from she got up.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'since' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'point of time' ko refer karne ke liye 'since' ka use kiya jaata hai.
Note:- yahan 'she got up' ye past ka action 'point of time' ka kaam kar rha hai.

questions.question: The month of / January takes its name of / the Roman god Janus.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use name from in place of name of.
Explanation:- Jab kisi person ya cheez ka naam kisi se liya jaata hai tab ye from ka use karte hain. Eg. She takes his name from a flower.

questions.question: The travel agent is making the arrangements from my trips.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'for' instead of 'from'
Explanation:- for ke liye Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- trips ke liye arrangements

questions.question: The Committee is thinking / of not bringing around any / change in the basic structure.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use about in place of around.
Explanation:- bring about - cause something to happen. "she brought about a revolution in the field of swimming"

questions.question: Pallavi was relaxing in the beach at this time yesterday.
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (d) use 'on' instead of 'in'

questions.question: It seems that my watch / is not working properly so / will you please tell me what's the time in your watch.
options: (c) will you please tell me what's the time in your watch.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Replace 'in your watch' with 'by your watch'.
Explanation:- Yeh ek 'fixed phrase' hai 'time by one's watch' jiska meaning hai 'kisi ki ghadi ke hisaab se time'

questions.question: Sakshi discussed about the problem with her manager very briefly.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'about'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'discuss' ek transitive verb hai iske sath kisi bhi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I have just come to know / that Mr. Ray, one of my favorite / teachers died with cancer recently.
options: (a) I have just come to know
(b) that Mr. Ray, one of my favorite
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use died of in place of died with.
Explanation:- disease - die of

questions.question: Tilak rowed through the river and tied his boat on the other side.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'across' instead of 'through'
Explanation:- Across from one side to the other of something 2 dimensional with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

questions.question: The Principal requested to the Chief Guest to inaugurate the sports meet.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'to'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'request' ek transitive verb hai iske sath kisi bhi preposition ka use nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The man who was / blind with the right eye was a / notorious criminal of this area.
options: (b) blind with the right eye was a
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use blind in in place of blind with.
Explanation:- blind to negligent. blind in- one eye. blind of both eyes

questions.question: On September 11, 2001, two hijacked aircraft crashed to the World Trade Centre in New York.
options: (d) World Trade Centre in New York
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'into' instead of 'to'
Explanation:- Crash into something.

questions.question: He was very much engaged / in his work when the thieves / entered into the house and took away a lot of things.
options: (b) in his work when the thieves
(c) entered into the house and took away a lot of things.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use entered in place of entered into.
Explanation:- 'enter, visit and reach' ke baad me noun bhale hi 'where' ka reply lage, in verbs ko transitive manana hai aur aage likhe noun ko inka object.

questions.question: The management is not [beware of] this fact.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation: yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'management iss fact ko leke aware nhi hai' aur aware ke sath of aati hai aur 'is' linking verb ke baad adjective chahiye isliye A option 'aware of sahi hai.

questions.question: The young boy displayed an [aptitude on] scientific research.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Aptitude for something- Natural tendency or inclination. Isliye grammar and meaning ke according A option 'aptitude for sahi hai.

questions.question: Solomon always refers [in the dictionary] for clearing doubts about words.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Refer verb ke sath generally 'to' preposition aati hai. isliye C option refers to the dictionary' sahi hai.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) They rise with the morning lark and labour till almost dark.
(b) They rise with the morning lark and labour utmost almost dark.
(c) They rise with the morning lark and labour by almost dark.
(d) They rise with the morning lark and labour still almost dark.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:-yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo andhera hone tak kaam karte hain' iss meaning ke liye 'till' preposition ka use hoga.

questions.question: The banker warned me not to be [careless from] my ATM card.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Careless with/about something- kisi cheez ko leke careless hona. Isliye meaning ke according yhan B option 'careless with' sahi hai.

questions.question: We [congratulated him at] his new job. He was delighted.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- congratulate verb generally iss structure me use ki jati hai 'congratulate somebody on something' - kisi ko kisi cheez par badhai dena. isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The rate of interest for the loan went [out all our calculations].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'rate of interest humari saari calculations se paar chala gya' iss meaning ke liye C option 'beyond all our calculations' sahi hai.

questions.question: In order to succeed in life, we need to work [instead waste time].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation: yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'tumhe kaam karna chahiye, time waste karne ki bjaye' iss meaning ke liye D option 'instead of...' sahi hai.

questions.question: Saroj has been suffering [with osteoporosis from when] she was fifty years old.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'suffer from an illness' sahi structure hota hai aur aage past ka action point of time ki tarah kaam kar rha hai jiske liye 'since' preposition ka use hoga. isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: I take pride [to serve] my country.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'take pride in doing something' sahi structure hai iska meaning hota hai kisi kaam ko karne me garv mehsoos karna. isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: This statue of Lord Buddha is carved [in] jade.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'carved out of something' kisi cheez ko kaat ke bnaya gya. isliye meaning ke according yhan B option 'out of' sahi hai.

questions.question: I'll try to phone you [in the meeting].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation: yhan best possible meaning ye hoga ki 'mai try karunga tumhe call karne ki meeting ke dauraan' isliye B option 'during the meeting' sahi hai.

questions.question: The scientists have so far focused on [improve cropped] yields.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'on' preposition ke baad object ayega aur object gerund bnana padega taki aage likha 'yields' noun uss gerund ka object ban sake. isliye A option- 'improving crop yields' sahi hai.

questions.question: He pays me six dollars [the month of this] house.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yhan 'six dollars a month 'ka meaning hai 'six dollars per month' aur 'house' singular hai isliye 'this' ayega. isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Subhash had just returned from [work in] 9 p.m.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Particular time jaise 8pm, 9 am etc ke liye 'at' preposition ka use hota hai isliye 'returned from work at 9pm' sahi hai.

questions.question: He went to bed early to [get up on time] to attend his morning lecture.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'subh time se uthne ke liye ' iss meaning ke liye B option 'to get up on time' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The eggs [are warm into] a suitable temperature for the larvae to hatch from eggs.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'to' preposition limit ko show karne ke liye bhi use kari jati hai isliye The eggs are warmed to a suitable temperature' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The old lady needed love and care [beyond] money.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yhan meaning ye dena hai ki' old lady ko love and care ki jarurat thi paise ke alawa' iss meaning ke liye A option 'besides' ka use hoga kyunki 'besides' = in addition to something

questions.question: My father was always [ordering about my sister].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation: ye phrasal based question hai. 'order somebody about' ka meaning hota hai - kisi ko baar baar rude manner me ye btana ki unhe kya karna chahiye. isliye meaning and grammar ke according yhan B option sahi hai.

questions.question: When Sirisha [knock at the door] someone peeped through the window.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according yhan past tense use hoga aur 'knock' verb ke sath 'at' preposition ka use hoga isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The shopkeeper was obliged to dispense [to the service] of his salesman.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'dispense with something/somebody' ka matlb hota hai kisi cheez ya person ka use karna band kar dena kyuki ab unki jarurat nhi ho. Yhan meaning ye dena hai ki 'shopkeeper ne salesman ko hta dia ya uski services ka use band kar dia' isliye meaning ke according yhan A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Once Birbal was forbidden [for attending] the king's free lunch.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'forbid' verb ke sath generally 'from' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye A option 'from attending' sahi hai.

questions.question: I have online science classes [for Wednesdays].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Days ke name ke sath generally 'on' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye A option 'on Wednesdays' ka use hoga.
Note: yhan Wednesdays jo plural me use hua hai wo sahi hai iska meaning hai har wednesday ko.

questions.question: Our school has been issued instructions to restrict online classes to two hours [towards] the primary classes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yhan meaning dena hai ki 'primary classes ke liye' iss meaning ke liye C option 'for' preposition sahi hai.

questions.question: This silver glass will shine if you [rub by] lemon peel.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Tense ke according yhan present indefinite ka use hoga aur 'lemon peel' yhan ek instrument ki tarah use kiya ja rha hai isliye 'with' preposition ka use hoga. Isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: [From] all her birthday presents, Vanya liked the alphabetical mat the most.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation: yhan meaning dena hai uske sab birthday presents me se...' isliye D option 'amongst' sahi hai.

questions.question: There were many options to [choose for] and I decided to study International Policy.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'choose from the options' structure generally use kiya jata hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: The prisoners are [kept at] constant surveillance.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- The prisoners are kept under constant surveillance' ka matlb hai prisoners constant nigrani me rakhe jaate hain. ye structure grammatically and meaning wise sahi hai.

questions.question: It is wise to insure one's home [on] fire.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Insure against something' ka matlb hota hai uske emergency ke liye insurance karana. Eg. insure against fire aag lagne ka Insurance krana, insure against damage - damage ke liye insurance krana. isliye D option 'against' sahi hai.

questions.question: A heavy fine [will be inflicted with them] if they do not pay the taxes in time.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'inflict' verb ke sath generally 'on' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye D option ka use hoga.

questions.question: The students were [warned on] coming late to school.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'warn against' ka matlb hota hai koi kaam karne ke liye strongly mna karna. isliye meaning ke according yhan A option ka use hoga.

questions.question: He [was sitting besides his] best friend during the event.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- beside next to someone or something (kisi ke bagal me ). Besides in addition to something. Iss liye meaning ke according yhan B option ka use hoga.

questions.question: We want to divide the expenses [between] the three of us.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yhan 2 se jyada logon ki baat ho rhi hai isliye 'among' preposition ka use hoga.

questions.question: There was enough evidence to [convict him of] selling adulterated food.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Convict verb ka structure hota hai - 'convict someone of something' isliye question me diya structure sahi hai.

questions.question: Every year the family goes [for a pilgrim] to the temple at Tirupati.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yhan meaning dena hai ki ' har saal wo family ek dharmik yatra pe jaati thi Tirupati mandir ko.' isliye D option 'on a pilgrimage' sahi hai.

questions.question: The child put a ladder [on the wall] and climbed up.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- ladder wall ke inclined position me Igai jaati hai uske liye 'against' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye D option 'against the wall' sahi hai.

questions.question: I bet you can't beat me [by chess].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- sahi structure hota hai 'beat someone at something' isliye C option 'at chess' sahi hai.

questions.question: The director will [agree with the proposal] if we do not exceed the budget.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- kisi cheez ko accept karne ke liye agree hone ke liye agree ke sath 'to' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye A option 'agree to the proposal sahi hoga.

questions.question: The diver [dive in the pool] from a great height.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-yhan motion ko show karne ke liye 'into' preposition ka use hoga isliye D option 'dived into the pool' sahi hai.

questions.question: The old lady nearly [dead from fright].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Disease ke die - of. Accident ke liye die - in and hunger, thirst, fright etc ke liye die from/die of dono use hote hain but competitive exams me 'die of ka hi use dekha gya isliye exam me die of ko mark karen.

questions.question: Food and water are the two basic necessities that citizens should have [accessing in].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'access' ke sath generally 'to' preposition ka use hota hai. isliye D option 'access to' sahi hai.

questions.question: If a sudden sandstorm starts in the middle of a desert safari, (a)/ travellers should quickly sit above (b)/ the protective tent cover (c)/ and keep their faces covered until the wind slows down. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'above' with 'under'
Explanation:- 'above' ki jagah 'under' aayega kyunki jab desert safari mein storm aayega toh protective tent ke andar bethenge naa ki bahar, isliye yahan 'under' sahi preposition hogi.

questions.question: After months of planning, our college council proposed the principal (a)/ that we should organise a national student-startup expo (b)/ to showcase innovative ideas (c)/ and build collaboration with industry mentors. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'proposed the principal' with 'proposed to the principal'
Explanation:- Kuch verb jaise 'announce, propose, suggest, apologize, listen, write, etc. inke baad 'to' preposition ka use hota hai kyunki inke baad indirect object aate hai, isliye 'proposed to the principal sahi hoga.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.
options: (a) He has been waiting by the morning hours, hoping the office would open early.
(b) He has been waiting from the morning time, expecting someone to come and meet him.
(c) He has been waiting till the morning since he wanted to be the first one there.
(d) He has been waiting since the early morning hours to submit his documents at the office.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'he has been waiting since the early morning hours to submit his documents at the office'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'present perfect tense ka use hua hai, agar 'duration' ki baat ho toh 'for' ka use karte hai aur 'point of time' ki baat ho toh 'since' ka use karte hai. option D mein 'early morning hours' point of time ke liye 'since ka use perfect tense ke sath hua hai, isliye option D sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the chef opened the lid of the boiling soup, (a)/ hot steam began to rise instantly, (b)/ spreading to the entire kitchen. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'spreading to' with 'spreading through'
Explanation:- Kahin pahuchne ke liye 'to' preposition ka use karte hai, lekin koi cheez particular area mein feil jaaye, toh uske liye 'through preposition ka use karte hai, isliye 'spreading through sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: When I reached the main road yesterday evening, (a)/ I saw my childhood friend waiting in the bus stop, (b)/ holding an umbrella. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'waiting in' with 'waiting at'
Explanation:- Public transport waali jagah pe hone ke liye 'at' preposition ka use hota hai, jaise 'at the railway station, at the bus stop, at the airport', isliye 'waiting at the bus stop' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Although she earns a decent salary, (a)/ she has a habit of spending against her means (b)/ by purchasing expensive designer clothes and gadgets (c)/ that she doesn't need. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'against' with 'beyond'
Explanation:- 'against' ka matlab 'khilaaf, lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'apni salary se jyada kharch karti hai', jiske liye 'beyond' preposition ka use hoga jiska matlab limit se jyada', isliye 'beyond her means' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Last summer on this day (a)/ our whole group was strolling in the beach (b)/ taking pictures (c)/ and chatting happily. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'in the beach' with 'on the beach'
Explanation:- Kisi cheez ki surface pe hone ke liye 'on' preposition ka use hota hai aur kisi cheez ke andar ke liye 'in' preposition ka use hota hai, toh 'beach pe tehelne' ke liye 'on' preposition sahi hogi.

questions.question: She has not travelled outside her country by the last five years, (a)/ even though she always talks (b)/ about exploring different cultures and experiencing life (c)/ in other parts of the world. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'by the last five' with 'for the last five'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'present perfect tense' ka use hua hai, agar 'duration' ki baat ho toh 'for' ka use karte hai aur 'point of time' ki baat ho toh since' ka use karte hai. last five year duration hai, isliye 'for' preposition sahi hogi.

questions.question: They returned home in Tuesday morning, (a)/ just before sunrise, and quietly unpacked their bags (b)/ so they wouldn't wake the children, (c)/ who were still sleeping peacefully. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'in Tuesday' with 'on Tuesday'
Explanation:- Generally morning' ke sath 'in' preposition aati hai, lekin kisi particular morning ki baat hogi toh 'on' preposition ka use hoga, isliye on Tuesday morning' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: They were travelling overnight to reach their hometown (a)/ and planned to stop to breakfast at a popular dhaba on the highway, (b)/ where the fresh parathas and chai are famous among travellers. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'to breakfast' with 'for breakfast'
Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'wo breakfast karne ke liye ruke', toh 'ke liye waale meaning ke liye 'for' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye 'for breakfast' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: For almost five years, (a)/ Ayaan lived in the northern part off Canada, (b)/ where the snow-covered landscapes looked breathtaking, (c)/ but adjusting to the freezing temperatures was always a challenge for him. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'part off Canada' with 'part of Canada'
Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai Aayan Canada ke northern part mein raha, toh 'off preposition 'separation' ke liye use hoti hai, jabki 'ka, kii, ke waale meaning ke liye of preposition ka use hota hai, isliye 'part of Canada' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: On his way back from work (a)/ Ravi rode his small boat through the river (b)/ to reach his farmland. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'through' with 'across'
Explanation:- 'through' ka use kisi cheez ke andar se jaane ke liye hota hai generally 3D, jabki 'across' ka use kisi cheez ke uper se jaane ke liye generally 2D. 'boat' river ke uper se jaayegi, isliye 'across the river' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The conference was held upon for nearly forty-five minutes (a)/ because several key speakers were stuck in traffic (b)/, which led to frustration among the attendees (c)/ who had arrived early. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'held upon' with 'held up'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'held upon' ki jagah 'held up aayega kyunki koi cheez postpone ho jaane ke liye, ruk jaane ke liye, rukaawat aajane ke liye 'held up' phrasal verb ka use hota hai, sentence ke meaning ke according 'held up' phrasal verb sahi answer hogi.

questions.question: No arguing on the dining table is tolerated in our house, (a)/ as my grandparents firmly believe (b)/ that mealtime should remain peaceful and respectful (c)/ for everyone sitting together. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'arguing on' with 'arguing at'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'on' ki jagah 'at' aayega kyunki 'on' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ke uper', lekin dining table ke uper beth kar discussion nahi hoga, isliye yahan 'at' sahi hoga jiska matlab 'near' matlab 'table ke pass', isliye 'arguing at sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: There might be ancient fossils and rare minerals (a)/ in the surface of this rocky hill, (b)/ hidden for thousands of years and waiting to be discovered by researchers. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'in the surface' with 'under the surface'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in' ki jagah 'under' aayega kyunki 'in' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ke andar', lekin matlab chahiye 'rocky hill ke surface ke neeche', jiske liye 'under' ka use hoga jiska matlab 'kisi cheez ke neeche', isliye 'under the surface' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Two ambitious brothers fought by the family estate (a)/ after their father passed away, (b)/ leading to years of bitterness and legal battles (c)/ that affected not only them but also the entire extended family. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'fought by' with 'fought over/for'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'fought by ki jagah 'fought over/for aayega kyunki 'fight over ka matlab 'kisi cheez ki wazah se ladna aur 'fight for ka matlab 'kisi cheez ke liye ladne', sentence ke according dono ke meaning sahi hai, isliye 'fought over/for dono sahi answer honge.

questions.question: The customers were completely put off by the unhygienic condition of the restaurant, (a)/ as the tables were sticky, the plates were poorly cleaned, (b)/ and the unpleasant smell instantly ruined their appetite. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No error
Explanation:- put off ka matlab 'kisi vyakti ki ruchi yaa utsaaah ko kam kar dena'.

questions.question: Her approach to solving problems is different (a)/ and far more efficient than mine, (b)/ as she always thinks creatively and carefully analyses every detail (c)/ before reaching a conclusion. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) put 'from' after 'different'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'different' ke baad 'from' aayega kyunki 'different' aur 'more efficient' adjectives ko 'and' conjunction se joda hai aur dono ke liye 'than' common preposition lagayi hai, 'efficient' ke sath 'than' ka use sahi hai, lekin 'different ke sath 'than' ka use galat hai kyunki different ke sath 'from' ka use hota hai, isliye 'different from sabse sahi answer hoga.
Note:- jis word se related problem hai error wahi mark hogi

questions.question: During his university years abroad, (a)/ he enjoyed all the comforts to life, (b)/ from living in a spacious apartment (c)/ to having access to all modern facilities. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'comforts to' with 'comforts of'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'to' ki jagah 'of aayega kyunki 'ka, kii, ke' waale meaning ke liye 'of preposition ka use karte hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'zindgi ke comfort'. Isliye 'comforts of sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the guests arrived late at night (a)/ they entered into the banquet hall (b)/ and were amazed by the beautiful decorations and lights (c)/ arranged for the anniversary celebration. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'into' after 'entered'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'entered' ke baad 'into' nahi aayega kyunki 'jab aap kisi jagah enter hote ho', toh 'enter' transitive verb hoti hai jise object ki jarurat hoti hai. lekin jab 'enter' ka matlab ho involve hona' toh aise meaning ke liye 'enter' ke sath 'into' sahi hota hai jaise enter into relationship, enter into fight .

questions.question: Before starting his private clinic, (a)/ he served as a cardiac surgeon of (b)/ one of the top multi-specialty hospitals in the region (c)/ handling critical emergency cases regularly. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'surgeon of' with 'surgeon at'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'of ki jagah 'at' aayega kyunki kahin pe kaam karne ke liye 'at' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye 'surgeon at sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Among the lawyer and the client (a)/ there was a clear misunderstanding (b)/ regarding the final terms of the property agreement (c)/ signed last week. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'among' with 'between'
Explanation:- 'among' ka use 'do se jyada logon/cheezon' ke liye hota hai aur 'between' ka use 'do logon/cheezon' ke liye hota hai, sentence mein 'lawyer aur client do logon ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'between' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Traditional folk songs (a)/ are passed down effortlessly (b)/ from one generation through another (c)/ as children learn them by listening to elders at festivals and family gatherings. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'through' with 'to'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'through ki jagah 'to' aayega kyunki 'from' ke sath 'to' ka pair hota hai. sentence hoga 'from one generation to another' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The teacher politely requested to the students (a)/ not to make noise (b)/ as the examination was going on (c)/ in the adjacent classroom. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'to' after 'requested'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'requested ke baad 'to' nahi aayega kyunki order, advice, request' yeh di-transitive verb hoti hai jinka structure 'order, advice, request somebody to do something hota hai, isliye 'requested verb ke baad 'to' preposition ka use nahi hoga. somebody' indirect object hota hai aur 'something direct object hota hai.

questions.question: Many luxury hotels (a)/ offer to their regular guests (b)/ complimentary spa vouchers, room upgrades, and private lounge access (c)/ as a gesture of appreciation for their loyalty. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'to' after 'offer'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'offer' ke baad 'to nahi aayega kyunki offer' ek di-transitive verb hai jiska structure 'offer somebody something jaise 'they offered me a job', isliye 'offer' ke baad 'to' nahi aayega.

questions.question: After attending the late-night cultural event (a)/ with my friends, I went to home, (b)/ had dinner and went to bed. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'to' after 'went'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'went' ke baad 'to' nahi aayega kyunki 'home 'adverb or noun' dono ban sakta hai, noun ke case mein 'her home, my home, their home iss type se likha hota, lekin aisa kuch nahi hai aur 'went' intransitive verb ke baad likha hai, isliye yeh adverb banega, isliye 'I went home' sahi hoga.
Note:- agar noun likha hota toh 'to' preposition sahi hoti jaise I went to rahul's home .

questions.question: Despite of facing several technical glitches (a)/ during the online exam, (b)/ she managed to attempt all the questions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'of' after 'despite'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'of nahi aayega kyunki 'despite ke baad of ka use nahi hota. 'in spite of/despite dono ka matlab 'ke baavjood' hota hai.

questions.question: While rushing to catch the early morning bus (a)/ my wallet suddenly slipped with my pocket (b)/ and fell on the pavement. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'with' with 'from'
Explanation:- 'with' se sentence ka matlab hoga pocket ke sath gir gaya', lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'pocket mein se gir gaya', toh 'se' waale meaning ke liye 'from' preposition ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Our yoga instructor has been conducting (a)/ free early-morning sessions at the community park (b)/ since the past eight months (c)/ to help people improve their physical and mental well-being. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'since' with 'for'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'perfect continuous tense ka use hua hai jiske sath 'since' aur 'for' ka use karte hai, 'the past eight months se pata chal raha ki duration ki baat ho rahi hai, duration ke liye 'for' ka use karte hai, point of time ke liye 'since' ka, sentence mein duration hai isliye 'for the past eight months sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The travel agency promised that (a)/ the visa approval process would be completed by ten working days (b)/ so that the customers could plan their holidays accordingly. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'by ten' with 'within ten'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'by' ki jagah 'within' aayega kyunki jab point batana ho toh 'by' ka use karte hai, jaise Sunday tak de dunga toh 'by Sunday', lekin jab aapko duration batani ho toh 'within' ka use karte hai. sentence mein 'ten working days' se pata chal raha ki duration ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'within ten working days' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The man besides me in the crowded metro (a)/ was talking to his friend very loudly (b)/ without realizing that everyone was getting disturbed. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'besides' with 'beside'
Explanation:- 'besides' ka matlab hota hai 'in addition to something, ke alawa', 'beside' ka matlab 'ke bagal mein', sentence mein bagal wala meaning chahiye, isliye 'beside me' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: At the hill resort near Mussoorie (a)/ our room had a stunning view of the clouds floating over the mountains (b)/ in the wide glass window that covered the entire wall. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'in the wide glass' with 'through the wide glass'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in' ki jagah 'through' aayega kyunki 'in' se matlab glass window mein view tha', lekin matlab chahiye 'glass window ke paar dekhne par view tha', toh 'kisi cheez ke dusri taraf dekhne ke liye', 'through' preposition ka use karte hai, isliye 'through the wide glass sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Did you tell to your sister (a)/ that the parcel she was waiting (b)/ for finally arrived this afternoon. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'to' after 'tell'
Explanation: Sentence mein 'tell' ke baad 'to' preposition nahi aayega kyunki 'tell' di-transitive verb hai, jiske baad indirect object aate hai, isliye yahan 'tell' ke baad 'to' preposition galat hai.

questions.question: Riya called an urgent team meeting (a)/ and discussed about the sudden drop in customer feedback scores (b)/ on various online platforms. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'about' after 'discussed'
Explanation: discussed verb ke baad 'about' preposition nahi aayegi kyunki 'discussed' transitive verb hai jiske baad object aate hai, isliye 'discussed' ke baad 'about' preposition ka use galat hai.

questions.question: Many NGOs are working tirelessly to (a)/ create better employment opportunities to unemployed artists (b)/ so they can sustain themselves and continue their passion without financial pressure. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'to unemployed' with 'for unemployed'
Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'NGO's behtar employment opportunities create kar rahe hai unemployed artist ke liye', toh 'ke liye' waale meaning ke liye 'for' preposition sahi hogi, isliye 'for unemployed artists' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Even though the twin puppies were born on the same day (a)/ they do not resemble to one another (b)/ as one has fluffy brown fur (c)/ while the other has black fur. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'to' after 'resemble'
Explanation:- 'resemble ke baad 'to' nahi aayega kyunki resemble transitive verb hai jiske baad object aata hai, isliye 'resemble' ke baad 'to' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: In about forty-five minutes the flight to Dubai will take off (a)/ and passengers are requested (b)/ to reach the boarding gate without any delay. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish: Ans (d) No error

questions.question: Across his early morning jog in the community park (a)/ Rahul often stops near the lake (b)/ to feed stray dogs and greet elderly walkers (c)/ who enjoy sharing stories from their youth. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'across' with 'during'
Explanation:- 'across' generally 'ek point se dusre point tak jaane ke liye use hota hai', lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'early morning jog ke dauraan wo lake ke pass stray dogs ko feed karata hai', toh 'dauraan' waale meaning ke liye 'during' preposition sahi hogi, isliye across ki jagah 'during' aayega.

questions.question: The central health ministry has deployed additional (a)/ medical teams at flood-affected Bihar to monitor outbreaks of water-borne diseases (b)/ and ensure that relief camps receive proper sanitation facilities. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'at flood' with 'in flood'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'at' ki jagah 'in' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'additional medical teams deploy kari gayi bihar mein', toh 'mein' waale matlab ke liye 'in' preposition sahi hogi. Jaise:- he lives in delhi, not at delhi

questions.question: After a long drought, farmers hoped to be back at the valley (a)/ cultivating their fields again (b)/ as the government released water from the nearby dam (c)/ ensuring proper irrigation for the new harvest season. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
