Explanation:- yeh semi closed condition sentence hai jiska use present ki aise unreal situation ko imagine karne ke liye kiya jata hai jo speaker ke according fulfil nahi ho sakti aur iska structure 'if + (v2/ were+noun/ had+noun) + (would/could/might) + verb' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if I were well' sahi hoga.
Note:- 'c' part mein 'have' se pehle 'would' understood hai.

questions.question: If I saw you / in the market, / I would have surely met you.
options: (c) I would have surely met you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'if I saw you' with 'if I had seen you'
Explanation:- sentence ke meaning ke according yeh closed conditional ka structure hai, isliye yahan 'If I had seen you' sahi hoga.
Note: yeh unreal imagination nahi hai isliye 'would meet' (semi closed) se nahi banayenge.

questions.question: You would have / not passed the exam / if you had not helped by Ajay.
options: (c) if you had not helped by Ajay.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'If you had not helped' with 'if you had not been helped'
Explanation:- sentence ke meaning ke according yahan passive voice ki requirement hai. Isliye yahan 'if you had not been helped' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I had known / what a greedy man you are, / I would not have asked for any help from you.
options: (b) what a greedy man you are,
(c) I would not have asked for any help from you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) no error
Note: Yahan 'what a greedy man you are' yeh noun clause hai jo ki 'had known' verb ka object hai. Isse confuse na ho.

questions.question: If you persist in charging unfair / prices your license / will have been revoked.
options: (a) If you persist in charging unfair
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'will have been revoked' with 'will be revoked'
Explanation:- sentence ke meaning ke according yeh open conditional ka structure hai. Isliye meaning ke according 'will be revoked' future indefinite sahi hoga.
Note:-Yahan 'will be revoked' passive hai kyunki 'license revoke' kiye jaane ka receiver hai.

questions.question: If you were the prime / minister of India what steps / would you have taken to remove unemployment
options: (c) would you have taken to remove unemployment
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'would have taken' with 'would take'
Explanation:- yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination ko dikha raha hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi closed ka structure banega, jiska structure 'if + (v2/ were+noun/ had+noun) + (would/could/might) + verb' hota hai. Isliye yahan 'would take' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If I would be a / millionaire, I would not / meet people like you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'if I would be' with 'if I were'
Explanation: yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi-closed mein jayega. Isliye yahan 'if I were' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He behaves in such an arrogant manner / as if he is a billionaire.
options: (c) as if he is a billionaire
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'he is a billionaire' with 'he were a billionaire'
Explanation:- 'as if/ as though' ke sath do structure follow hote hai. 'present indefinite + as if/as though + v2' aur 'past indefinite + as if/as though + had+v3', sentence mein 'behaves' present indefinite diya hai, isliye 'as if ke baad v2 'he were a billionaire' sahi hoga. aur present ki unreal imagination ke liye v2 ka use hota hai.

questions.question: I wish / I learnt swimming when / I was young.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'learnt' with 'had learnt'
Explanation- sentence mein past ki imagination karni hai aur past ki imagination karne ke liye 'had+v3' ka use hota hai. Isliye yahan 'had learnt' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I wish / he realises / that she is fooling him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'realises' with 'realised'
Explanation:- sentence mein present ki imagination karni hai aur present ki imagination karne ke liye verb ki 2nd form ka use hota hai. Isliye yahan 'realised' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If we had Mohan / in our team, we would have / easily won the match.
options: (b) in our team, we would have
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'if we had Mohan' with 'If we had had Mohan'
Explanation:- yeh closed conditional ka sentence hai jiska structure 'if + (had+v3) + (would/could/might) + have + v3' hota hai, isliye yahan 'if we had had mohan' sahi hoga

questions.question: If I would realise / what you wanted, I would have / surely helped you.
options: (b) what you wanted, I would have
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'would realise' with 'had realised'
Explanation:- sentence ke meaning se pata chal raha ki closed conditional ka sentence hai, isliye yahan 'I had realised' sahi hoga.
Note:- what you wanted wala clause 'had realised' verb ka object banega. Isse confuse na ho.

questions.question: If the freedom fighters had come back / to life they would be shocked / to see the current state of our country.
options: (a) If the freedom fighters had come back
(b) to life they would be shocked
(c) to see the current state of our country
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'had come back' with 'came'
Explanation: yeh sentence present ki unreal imagination ko dikha raha hai isliye meaning ke according yeh semi closed ka structure banega, jiska structure 'if + (v2/were+noun/had+noun) + (would/could/might) + verb' hota hai. Isliye yahan 'came back' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi.
Note:- 'would be shocked' me 'shocked' adjective hai jo subject complement ban raha hai.

questions.question: If this ancient manuscript (a)/ gets decoded, the revelation changes the entire (b)/ understanding of how early civilizations interacted (c)/ across distant continents. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'will change' instead of 'change'.
Explanation:- 'If ke saath present nazar aa raha hai. 'Decoded' past participle hai. Agar yh manuscript decode ho jati hai ye matlab hai iska. 'gets decoded' 'get + v3 ka structure hai. 'gets' v1 likha hua hai. Iska matlab ye open conditional ban raha hai. Aur meaning se bhi pata chal raha hai ki ye koi unrealistic ya past ki baat nahi kar raha hai. Tho yaha open conditional lagana padega. Aur open conditional lagana hai tho If ke saath v1 likha hua hai is side me. Tho us side me hme future Igana padega. Tho 'change' nahi 'will change' hoga.

questions.question: Had Ananya not insisted on checking the pantry (a)/ cabinet once more before leaving for (b)/ the airport, the gas filled the entire kitchen. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Use 'would have filled' instead of 'filled'.
Explanation:- 'Had ananya not insisted' likhe ya 'If ananya had not insisted' likhe ek hi baat hai. Yani ye closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai 'had + v3' wala. Udhar 'had + v3' aa raha hai, past ki baat kar raha hai. Agar yh na hua hota tho yh ho gaya hota. Meaning se bhi pata chal raha hai ki closed conditional ka structure hai. Tho udhar 'had + v3' hai tho idhar 'would + have + v3' likhna hoga. Tho 'filled' nahi 'would have filled likhna padega.

questions.question: The tourist couple would have (a)/ missed the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti (b)/ if their boatman not chosen the shorter route. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Use 'had not chosen' instead of 'not chosen'.
Explanation:- Meaning past ka hai. Agar unhone aisa na kia hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Past wala meaning hai. Closed conditional wala meaning hai. Sentence me 'would + have + v3 bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho is side 'had + v3 likhna padega. Tho 'had not chosen' likhna padega.

questions.question: The neighbourhood kids would have missed (a)/ the Independence Day celebration in (b)/ the colony park if the electrician (c)/ has not repaired the faulty generator. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Use 'had not repaired' instead of 'has not repaired'.
Explanation:- Closed conditional wala meaning hai. Agar aisa na hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Sentence me 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho is side 'had not repaired' likhna padega.

questions.question: If the organisers of the Jaipur Literature Festival (a)/ will announce an additional interactive (b)/ session with author Chetan Bhagat, a large number of young (c)/ readers will rush to book the seats. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'announce' instead of 'will announce'.
Explanation: yeh open conditional hai. Imagination type ki baatein nahi hai. Aur baat bhi future ki kar raha hai ki agar aisa ho jaaye tho aisa ho jayega. Dono side me future hai ye bhi ishara kar raha hai. Yani open conditional me jayega. Aur 'If ke saath future tense nahi aata hai. Isliye 'will' ko drop karna padega. Aur 'organisers' plural hai isliye 'announce' verb me koi dikkat nahi hai. Isko aap tense chapter ka rule bhi keh sakte ho ki do future ek saath nahi aate hai. Ya phir conditional ka rule bhi.

questions.question: If freshly chopped apples are left uncovered in open air (a)/ the enzymes in the fruit (b)/ react with oxygen and have turned the surface brown (c)/ which is a natural oxidation process. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Use 'turn' instead of 'have turned'.
Explanation: 'are left uncovered' passive me likha hua hai. Lekin hai v1 hi. Idhar 'If ke saath v1 hai. Aur ye koi imagination tho hai nahi aur past ki bhi koi baat nahi hai. Tho ye open conditional hai. Aur open conditional me idhar present hai tho udhar future nahi lagega. Kyunki ye fact hai. Aur fact hai tho iske andar future lagane ki jarurat nahi hai. Isko v1 ke anadr hi rakhenge. 'and' laga hua hai aur udhar 'react' v1 hai tho idhar bhi v1 hi aayega. Tho 'have turned' nahi 'turn' likhna hoga. Scientific fact hai isliye v1 ke andar hi likha jayega.

questions.question: If the government had invested a decent amount on the waste (a)/ management system a decade ago, (b)/ the major metropolitan cities like Delhi (c)/ and Mumbai wouldn't have been in such a bad situation now. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Use 'would not be' instead of 'would not have been'.
Explanation: Sentence me 'had invested likha hua hai. Yani ye closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai. Lekin closed conditional tho past ki baatein karta hai. Agar aisa hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Aaj ye seher itni buri situation me na hoti. 'Now' se pata chal raha hai ki present ki baat kar raha hai. Aapne shart rakhi hai past ki aur result maang rahe ho present me yani mixed conditional ban gaya. Condition past ki hai aur result present me keh rahe ho tho mixed conditional type II ka structure ban gaya. Tho is side 'had invested hi rahega aur udhar Present ki baat karni hai tho 'would not have been' ke jagah 'would not be' likhna padega.

questions.question: If the power was not cut (a)/ by the maintenance staff the residents (b)/ could have watched the entire cricket match (c)/ without interruption. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'had not been cut' instead of 'was not cut'.
Explanation:- Past ki baat hai. Agar aisa na hua hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Closed conditional ke taraf ishara kar raha hai. Sentence me 'could + have + v3' bhi vahi ishara kar raha hai. Aur dusri baat power tho kisi ko kategi nahi. Power ko kata jayega. Tho passive bhi karna padega. Tho 'had not been cut' likhna padega.

questions.question: If I was you (a)/ I would not have trusted (b)/ someone who hides important details (c)/ before taking such a big financial decision. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Replace 'was' with 'were'.
Explanation:- Agar mai kahu mai ban jau shahrukh khan tho possible nahi hai na. Tho koi insaan koi dusra insaan tho ho nahi sakta. Yani imagination karni thi. Tho 'If I was you' galat hai 'If I were you' hoga. Kuch bachhe soch rahe honge ki agar is side 'were likha hua hai tho idhar 'would not trust aana chahiye na. 'would + base form aana chahiye. 'would not have' ye tho closed me aata hai. Tho aapko mixed conditional type I me btaye the ki agar condition unrealistic ho aur baat past ki karni ho tho is side v2 wala aur is side would/could/might + have + v3 aisa structure hoga.

questions.question: If I knew that my parents (a)/ would visit my flat (b)/ I would have cleaned the (c)/ guest room and prepared everything properly. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Replace 'If I knew' with 'If I had known'.
Explanation:- 'that my parents would visit my flat' ye tho 'knew verb ke object ke tarah se kaam kar raha hai. Yani is 'knew ka jo object hai usse koi relation nahi hai. If wala structure ka 'that my parents would visit my flat' isse relation nahi hai. Ye tho know verb ke object ke tarah se kaam kar raha hai. Uska relation 'I would have cleaned.....' wale clause se hai. Agar achhe se padha hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Basically ek condition hoti hai aur ek uska result hota hai. 'my parents would visit.....' nahi. 'I would have cleaned.... Ye result hai. Meaning se pata chal raha hai ki ye koi unrealistic baat hai nahi ki semi closed me leke jau. 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai ki isko closed me le jana hai. Agar mujhe pata hota ki mere parents aayenge tho maine yh kar dia hota. closed wala meaning hai. Tho 'If I had known' likhenge.

questions.question: He slipped on the muddy village road (a)/ and would have broken his arm (b)/ if the farmers (c)/ did not take him to the nearby hospital. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Use 'had not taken' instead of 'did not take'.
Explanation:- 'would have broken his arm iska matlab 'voh jaan ke tod lega apni baju ye nahi hoga balki uski baju tut jati wala meaning hoga.
Closed conditional wala meaning hai. 'would + have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai. Tho yaha 'did not take nahi 'had not taken' likhna padega.

questions.question: If my uncle would have reached our village last night (a)/ I would have taken him to the annual fair (b)/ where the whole community gathers (c)/ to celebrate the festive season. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'If my uncle had reached' instead of 'If my uncle would have reached'.
Explanation:- Agar uncle aa jate. Condition wale part ke andar 'would + have + v3' dia hua hai jo ki galat hai. Ye tho result ka structure hota hai. Aur result ka structure 'would have taken' tho laga hua hai. Tho yaha condition wale part me error hai. aur ye koi aisi baat hai nahi ki semi closed me leke jaaye aur structure bata raha hai ki closed me leke jana padega. Tho 'If my uncle had reached likhna padega.

questions.question: Had you informed me about your (a)/ father's sudden illness on time (b)/ I would definitely arrange (c)/ immediate transport to take him to the city hospital. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Replace 'would definitely arrange' with 'would have definitely arranged'
Explanation:- 'Had you informed likh de ya 'If you had informed' likh de ek hi baat hai. meaning bhi closed type ka hai. Agar aisa ho gaya hota tho aisa ho gaya hota. Tho 'would definitely arrange ke jagah 'would have definitely arranged likh denge.

questions.question: If I was financially stronger right now (a)/ I would book a short trip to Kerala (b)/ and explore the peaceful backwaters (c)/ and the local food. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'If I were' instead of 'If I was'.
Explanation: yaha imagination ki baat ho rahi hai. 'If I was financially stronger', 'I was' ye tho fact bata dega ki financially stronger tha. Jo ki galat hai. Agar mai hota yh wala meaning dena hai tho ye kaam 'was' nahi karta. Tho yaha 'If I were likhna padega.
Sentence me 'would book' sahi hai aur agar 'would have booked hota tho voh bhi sahi hota. Dono ke alag alag meaning hai.
Would book - Sentence me 'right now' likha hai isse pata chal raha hai ki present ki baat kar raha hai. Agar mai financially stronger hu tho mai kerala ki trip book karlu.
Would have booked - Tho pahli baat 'right now' nahi aa payega aur iska meaning hoga - Agar mai financially stronger hota tho mai kerala ki trip book kar leta.

questions.question: If I saw you outside the (a)/ railway station yesterday, I would have surely (b)/ stopped my car and talked to you. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Replace 'If I saw you' with 'If I had seen you'.
Explanation: Unrealistic baat hai nahi ki isko semi closed me leke jaaye. 'Would + have + v3' se pata chal raha hai ki closed conditional ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. Tho 'If I had seen' likhna padega.

questions.question: You would have faced a huge fine (a)/ for late submission of your income-tax return (b)/ if you had not helped by the accountant (c)/ who completed all your documents on time. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Replace 'had not helped' with 'had not been helped'.
Explanation:- Yahan passive voice ki galti hai. Ye closed conditional ka structure hai. Sentence me 'would have + v3' bhi ishara kar raha hai, Tho is side had + v3 ka passive likhna ladega. Isliye 'had not been helped' correct hoga.

questions.question: If she had studied harder (a)/ she would be scoring (b)/ much better marks in the exam now. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Replace 'would be scoring' with 'would score'.
Explanation:- ye mixed conditionals based questions hai. yhan condition past ki hai but result present ka hai. isliye yhan result wale part me would + v1 ayega.

questions.question: If the pharmacy keeps selling medicines without proper bills (a)/ despite several inspections, (b)/ its operating licence (c)/ will have been revoked within days. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Replace 'will have been revoked' with 'will be revoked'.
Explanation:- 'will have been + v3' tab use hota hai jab koi action future ke kisi specific point tak complete ho jaaye. Lekin yaha present ki baat bata raha hai iska result future me hoga, na ki future ke kisi point tak complete ho chuka hoga. Yeh open conditional hai: If + simple present, will+v1. passive mein 'will be + v3'. Isliye 'will be revoked' correct hoga.

questions.question: If you were the health minister of India (a)/ what immediate reforms (b)/ would you have implemented (c)/ to improve the condition of government hospitals? (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Replace 'would you have implemented' with 'would you implement'.
Explanation: yaha imagination ki baat ho rahi hai. Tho 'If you were wale ke andar koi dikkat nahi hai. Yaha meaning aur immediate se pata chal raha hai ki ye past ki baat nahi kar raha hai. Tho ye semi closed ke andar jayega aur semi closed ke andar jayega tho 'would you have implemented ke jagah 'would you implement likhna padega.

questions.question: If I would be the owner of this renowned luxury hotel (a)/ chain that operates across several Indian cities, (b)/ I would not allow any staff member (c)/ to behave rudely with guests under any circumstances. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Replace 'If I would be' with 'If I were'.
Explanation:- Result 'I would not allow....' Ye wala part hai. Tho 'If ke saath 'would be' wala part nahi aayega. Aur ye semi closed ke andar imagination wali baat hai. Agar mai is taj ka malik hota. Aur meaning semi closed wale structure ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. Aur idhar 'would not allow' ye bhi hint de raha hai. Tho 'would' helping verb hai. 'be' main verb hai. Tho 'be' se hi bnana padega. Tho 'If I were the owner' likhna padega.

questions.question: He keeps giving orders to everyone in the office (a)/ in such an authoritative tone (b)/ as if he is the CEO (c)/ of a multinational corporation. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Replace 'he is the CEO' with 'he were the CEO'
Explanation:- 'He keeps' yani present ki baat karni hai. Aur order dene wali baat tho fact hai. Aur present ki imagination v2 se hoti hai. Tho 'He were the CEO' likhna padega.

questions.question: I wish (a)/ I understood the value of maintaining good health (b)/ when my parents repeatedly advised me (c)/ during my college days. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'had understood' instead of 'understood'.
Explanation:- 'I wish' ke saath do structure bante hai. present ki imagination karoge tho v2 banega, aur past ki baat karoge tho 'had + v3' banega. 'kaash maine is chiz ki value ko samjha hota' yani past ki baat karni hai, tho 'I had understood likhna padega.

questions.question: I wish (a)/ she realises how genuinely her parents care for her (b)/ instead of arguing with them (c)/ over every small issue. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'realised' instead of 'realises'.
Explanation:- Ab yaha koi hint nahi hai ki past ki baat kar raha hai. past ki baat karne ka koi hint nahi hai. Yani present ka imagination karna hai tho v2 se karna padega. Tho 'she realised' likhna padega.

questions.question: If we had sufficient funds (a)/ in our NGO at the time of the disaster, (b)/ we could have (c)/ provided immediate relief to hundreds of affected families in the nearby villages. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Replace 'If we had sufficient funds' with 'If we had had sufficient funds'.
Explanation:- Agar us samay pe fund hote tho hm aur families ki madad kar sakte the. Closed conditional ki taraf ishara kar raha hai. 'could + have + v3' ye bhi hmare liye hint hai. Tho is side 'had + v3' aana chahiye tha, aur yaha akela had likha hai aur akela had tho v2 ho jayega. Jo ki galat hai. Isliye 'had had' karna padega. 'had + v3' banane ke liye.

questions.question: If our national leaders had come back (a)/ to observe the level of corruption in our country, (b)/ they would be deeply disappointed. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'came' instead of 'had come back'.
Explanation:- 'would be deeply disappointed voh disappointed honge. aisa mt sochna ki 'would be + kya aagya', 'would + base form hi laga hua hai. yh bas passive structure aaya hai.
Ab hme pata hai ki national leader vapas zinda tho honge nahi. Jaise, agar gandhi Ji vapas zinda ho Jaye tho unko ye chiz dekh ke bhut udasi hogi. Tho waise hi agar national leader vapas aa Jaye observe karne ke liye hmare desh me corruption ko tho voh disappointed honge. Tho obvious baat hai semi closed me Jayega aur semi closed me Jayega tho v2 se bnana padega. Tho 'came back likhna padega.

questions.question: The education commission proposed that (a)/ a uniform digital-attendance system is introduced (b)/ across all government schools (c)/ to minimise manual errors and increase transparency. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'be introduced' / 'should be introduced' instead of 'is introduced'.
Explanation:- Education commission ne prstav dia ki ek uniform attendance system introduce kia jaaye. 'is introduced ka mtlb tho 'introduced hai'. Jo ki galat hai. education commission ne prstav dia ki introduce kia Jaye, aur kia Jaye wala meaning tho present subjunctive mood se aayega. Tho yaha 'be introduced / should be introduced likhna padega. kyunki present subjunctive mood me verb ki base form aati hai.

questions.question: The family prayed that the (a)/ critically injured passenger is taken to a (b)/ specialised trauma centre without delay. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'be taken' / 'should be taken' instead of 'is taken'.
Explanation:- Family ne prathana kari ki jo critically injured passenger hai use le jaaya jaye specialised trauma hospital me, 'is taken' ka mtlb tho le jaya jata hai. Jo ki galat hai. 'le jaaya jaye' wala meaning dena hai tho 'be taken/should be taken' likhna padega.

questions.question: All the parents demanded that (a)/ the malfunctioning playground equipment was replaced quickly, (b)/ because several children had already been injured (c)/ due to its broken hinges and loose support bars. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'be replaced' / 'should be replaced' instead of 'was replaced'.
Explanation:- Sabke sab parents ne demand kia ki playground equipments ko replace kia jaaye. 'was replace ka matlab tho replace kar dia gaya tha. Jo ki galat hai. Yaha 'kia jaaye' wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'be replaced/should be replaced likhna padega.

questions.question: It is imperative that every traveller carries a printed copy of the updated travel advisory, (a)/ because several checkpoints along the international border now (b)/ demand immediate proof of health clearance and itinerary details. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'carry' / 'should carry' instead of 'carries'.
Explanation:- yeh baat obvious hai ki har koi traveller carry kare. 'Every traveller carries iska matlab tho har traveller carry karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. ye obvious hai ki har traveller carry kare. ye 'kare' wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'carry/should carry' likhna padega.

questions.question: The dietician advised that the patient took light meals (a)/throughout the day, since heavy portions (b)/ could slow down his digestion and interfere (c)/ with the medication schedule. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'take' / 'should take' instead of 'took'.
Explanation:- Dietician ne advise kia ki patient light meals le. 'took' matlab usne light meals li thi. Jo ki galat hai. Usne salah di ki voh aisa kare ye wala meaning dena hai. Tho yh present subjunctive mood se aayega. Yani verb ki base form lagegi. Tho 'take/should take' likhna padega.

questions.question: I demand that he talks to the project manager (a)/ about the repeated delays, (b)/ since the team is struggling to maintain the schedule (c)/ and urgently needs clear instructions for the upcoming tasks. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'talk' / 'should talk' instead of 'talks'.
Explanation:- Mai maang karta hu ki voh project manager se baat kare. 'He talks ka matalb tho voh baat karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Meaning dena hai ki voh baat kare. Voh baat kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'talk/should talk likhna padega.

questions.question: It is suggested that students revised their previous year's notes carefully, (a)/ because many questions in the upcoming test (b)/ are expected to be based on fundamental concepts covered earlier. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'revise' / 'should revise' instead of 'revised'.
Explanation:- Aisi salah di jati hai ki students revise kare. 'students revised ka matlab tho students ne revise kar lia tha. Jo ki galat hai. Revise kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'revise/should revise' likhna padega.

questions.question: It is mandatory that your daughter comes to (a)/ the cultural rehearsal in formal attire, (b)/ because the final performance will be recorded (c)/ for the annual school presentation. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'come' / 'should come' instead of 'comes'.
Explanation: yh mandatory hai ki tumhari daughter cultural rehearsal me formal attire me aaye. 'comes' ka matlab tho aati hai. Jo ki galat hai. Mandatory hai ki tumhari daughter formal attire me aaye ye meaning dena hai. Tho 'come/should come likhna padega.

questions.question: To maintain accuracy in the department's monthly reports, (a)/ it is necessary that every employee (b)/ does his data-entry tasks carefully, (c)/ since even minor mistakes can create major inconsistencies later. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Use 'do' / 'should do' instead of 'does'.
Explanation:- It is necessary ki har employee apne data entry task ko achhe se kare. 'does' ka matlab tho karta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'do/should do likhna padega.

questions.question: It is essential that the newly appointed investigation team (a)/ conducts a multi-stage review of the digital evidence (b)/ collected over the last six months before submitting (c)/ its findings to the national cybersecurity panel. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'conduct' instead of 'conducts'.
Explanation:- Ye jaruri hai ki newly appointed investigation team aisa kare, 'conducts' ka matlab tho conduct karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'conduct/should conduct' likhna padega.

questions.question: The expert panel recommended that the pharmaceutical company (a)/ reviews all clinical reports carefully (b)/ to ensure that no adverse-reaction detail is missed (c)/ before filing for final approval. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'review' instead of 'reviews'.
Explanation:- Expert panel ne recommend kia ki pharmaceutical company aisa kare. 'reviews' ka matlab tho review karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'review/should review' likhna padega.

questions.question: The High Court ordered that the state administration initiates strict disciplinary action (a)/ against officials who knowingly overlooked (b)/ repeated violations in the industrial pollution case. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Use 'initiate' instead of 'initiates'.
Explanation:- High court ne aadesh dia ki state administration aisa kare. initiates ka matlab tho initiate karti hai. Jo ki galat hai. Kare wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'initiate/should initiate likhna padega.

questions.question: The senior advocate insisted that the witness (a)/ gives a detailed account of the events (b)/ leading to the financial fraud (c)/ before the second hearing begins. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Use 'give' instead of 'gives'.
Explanation: Senior advocate ne insist kia ki witness jo hai detailed account of events de yani detail me bataye jo jo chize huyi thi. 'gives' ka matlab tho deta hai. Jo ki galat hai. Tho 'give/should give likhna padega.

questions.question: It is essential that someone you truly love _______ not only your words but also the silence you hide behind your smile.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c)
Explanation:- Aisa jaruri hai ki voh samjhe. Samjhe wala meaning dena hai. Tho 'understand likhna padega.

questions.question: It is imperative that the one you choose for life _______ your growth and hold your hand when everything falls apart.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b)
Explanation:- Jisko tum chunte ho voh aisa kare. Kare wala meaning dena hai jo present subjunctive mood se aayega. Aur present subjunctive aayega tho verb ki base form aayegi. Tho 'support' sahi ho jayega.

questions.question: He put his / sign on the footer of the / letter and posted it.
options: (b) sign on the footer of the
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'sign' with 'signature'
Explanation- 'sign' ki jagah 'signature' aayega kyunki 'sign' verb hoti hai aur 'signature' noun hota hai, sentence mein 'his' adjective ke baad noun ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'signature' sahi hoga. Note: 'sign' noun hota hai jab iska matlab koi mark, symbol, gesture' hota hai.

questions.question: Nowadays he is living / in foreign but / his parents live in India.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'in foreign' with 'abroad'
Explanation- 'foreign' word ek adjective hai aur 'in' preposition ka object nahi ban sakta, isliye 'in a foreign country' yaa fir 'abroad' ka use hoga kyunki 'adverb of place' banana hai. Dono mein se 'abroad' prefer karenge.

questions.question: The english teacher / asked us to revise / the chapter that he taught yesterday.
options: (c) the chapter that he taught yesterday
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'The English teacher' with 'The teacher of English'
Explanation- 'english teacher' ka matlab 'angrez teacher', lekin sentence ka matlab chahiye 'English padhaane wala teacher' jiske liye sahi term 'the teacher of english' hogi.

questions.question: Unless you don't study / hard, you won't / be able to crack this exam.
options: (c) be able to crack this exam.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'unless you don't' with 'unless you'
Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai, jisme 'not' pehle se understood hota hai isliye 'unless/until jis clause mein aata hai uss clause mein 'not' ka use nahi hota, isliye 'unless you study' sahi hoga

questions.question: You should know / that he is my cousin brother and you should not / misbehave with him again.
options: (b) that he is my cousin brother and you should not
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'brother' after 'cousin'
Explanation:- 'cousin' ke sath 'brother' yaa 'sister' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'cousin' pehle se hee noun hai, isliye 'cousin' ke sath 'brother' yaa 'sister' superfluous ki category mein aata hai.

questions.question: You should not worry / because the company will reimburse back / the money you spent / during your official visit to Lucknow.
options: (b) because the company will reimburse back
(d) during your official visit to Lucknow
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'back'
Explanation:- 'reimburse' ka matlab hee hota hai 'give back, waapas lautaana', isliye iske sath 'back' superfluous ki category mein aata hai.

questions.question: These firms which are / the main suppliers of electronic / components in India.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'which'
Explanation:- sentence mein 'which' nahi aayega kyunki 'which' relative pronoun se adjectival clause bana hai jiski verb 'are' hai. Lekin 'firms' subject ko verb nahi mili poore sentence mein, isliye yahan 'which' hata denge, jisse 'firms' subject ki verb 'are' ho jaayegi. Sentence mein ek hee clause hai.

questions.question: It is not difficult to believe / that a man who has lived in this city for a long time he will never feel / at home anywhere else in the world.
options: (a) It is not difficult to believe
(b) that a man who has lived in this city for a long time he will never feel
(c) at home anywhere else in the world.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'he'.
Explanation:- 'will never feel' verb ka subject 'a man' banega jo 'who was...' wale adjectival clause se pehle likha hai. 'He' laga denge toh 'a man' subject ko verb hi nahi milegi. Isliye yahan 'he' hatana padega.

questions.question: What you had said about / the employees it was found to be / correct but it could not be proved.
options: (b) the employees it was found to be
(c) correct but it could not be proved.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'it'
Explanation:- 'what you had said about the employees' yeh poora noun clause hai jo 'was found' verb ka subject banega. Isliye yahan 'it' pronoun ka use superfluous hai.

questions.question: He was very / friendly enough to help / me when I was in distress.
options: (c) me when I was in distress.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'very'.
Explanation:- 'very' and 'enough' ek sath use nahi hote yaa toh 'very friendly' hoga yaa 'friendly enough' hoga. lekin aage 'to help' infinitive diya hai jiske sath 'enough' sahi hota hai isliye yahan 'very' ko hata denge.

questions.question: The passing marks in / this paper are thirty three / but you have got just thirty.
options: (c) but you have got just thirty.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'pass marks' in place of 'passing marks'.
Explanation:- 'passing marks' ka matlab 'pass hote hue marks', lekin matlab chahiye 'pass hone ke liye marks' jiske liye 'pass marks' sahi term hoti hai.

questions.question: They stayed in / Kashmir for a short period / of time and / then returned home.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'of time' after period
Explanation- 'period' ka matlab hee 'time' hota hai. Isliye iske sath 'of time' superfluous hai.

questions.question: The principal forbade / the students not to / stage a walk out.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'not'
Explanation:- 'forbid' verb mein 'not' pehle se hee understood hota hai aur iska matlab 'kisi ko kuch kaam karne se rokna/mana karna'. Isliye iske sath 'not' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Probably by the end / of the year he will have left / for the USA with bag and baggage.
options: (b) of the year he will have left
(c) for the USA with bag and baggage.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'with' before 'bag and baggage'
Explanation:- 'bag and baggage' ka matlab 'with all your belongings' Yeh ek idiom hai jo adverb ki tarah kaam karta hai iske pehle 'with' ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: The short story / should not exceed more than two / hundred words.
options: (b) should not exceed more than two
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'more than'.
Explanation:- 'exceed' ka meaning hi hota hai 'more than something' iske sath 'more than' lagana superfluous hai.

questions.question: We have signed / a mutual agreement / with the other party.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'an agreement' in place of 'a mutual agreement'.
Explanation:- jab bhi koi 'agreement' sign hota hai wo mutually hee sign hota hai, isliye 'agreement' ke sath 'mutual' superfluous hota hai. aur 'agreement' ke according 'an' article aayega.

questions.question: He doesn't hardly know / anything about the real / factors that caused that accident.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Replace 'doesn't hardly know' with 'hardly knows'
Explanation:- Use either 'he hardly knows anything' or 'he does not know anything', kyunki 'hardly' ka matlab 'naa ke barabar' jisme 'not' pehle se understood hai. isliye 'hardly' ke sath negative word ka use nahi hota hai.

questions.question: The Reason why most / people get trapped in MLM schemes / is because that they want / to become rich overnight.
options: (b) people get trapped in MLM schemes
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'because'
Explanation:- 'because' ek reason ko batane wali conjunction hai aur agar sentence mein 'reason' word ka use ho chuka hai toh 'because' nahi aayega. aur 'that' conjunction ka kaam karega.

questions.question: Throughout the whole year, / there was not even / a single day without / violence in this city.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'whole'
Explanation- 'throughout' ka matlab hee hota hai 'poora', isliye iske sath baad 'whole' lagana superfluous ho jaayega.

questions.question: While walking in / the park, I came across / by chance my friend Rajat
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'by chance'
Explanation:- 'come across' ka matlab he hota hai 'kisi se achaanak milna' isliye iske baad 'by chance' yaa 'suddenly' lagana superfluous ho jaata hai.

questions.question: He asked me / that why I had not met Rajesh / after the interview.
options: (b) that why I had not met Rajesh
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'that'
Explanation:- sentence indirect speech mein likha hai, toh 'asked' verb ke baad 'how, why, where, when' yehi conjunction ka kaam karte hai aur iss sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction nahi aayegi.

questions.question: I asked him if / he had money sufficient enough / to pay the rent.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use either 'sufficient' or 'enough'.
Explanation:- dono ka meaning same hota hai 'paryapt'.
Note:- agar yeh alag alag part mein aate toh 'enough' ko rakhte aur 'sufficient' ko remove karna prefer karte kyunki aage infinitive diya hai.

questions.question: He asked me / what we would do / Supposing if they didn't come.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use either 'if' or 'Supposing'
Explanation:- kyunki yeh dono conjunctions hain aur dono ka meaning same hai toh dono mein se koi ek use karenge.

questions.question: They were not / able to cross the bridge / despite of their best efforts.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'of' after 'despite'
Explanation- 'in spite of = despite' (ke babjood) 'despite' ke baad 'of' ka use nahi hota hai.

questions.question: Whether you / believe it or not / I know that it is a true fact.
options: (c) I know that it is a true fact.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'true' before 'fact'
Explanation:- 'fact' humesha ussi ko bolte hai jo 'true' ho. Isliye 'fact' ke sath 'true' superfluous hota hai.

questions.question: I couldn't come here / yesterday because / it was raining like cats and dogs.
options: (c) it was raining like cats and dogs.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'like'
Explanation:- 'raining cats and dogs' ka matlab 'rain heavily' Yeh ek idiom hai jo adverb ki tarah kaam karta hai isliye iske pehle 'like' preposition ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: The teacher was angry / because the / students didn't give the test.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'didn't give' with 'didn't take'
Explanation:- hindi mein hum kehte hain 'students ne test diya' but english mein correct usage 'take the test' hoti hai.
Eg. All the students took their final exam yesterday

questions.question: A light breeze / was blowing which helped / the child go to sleep.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Remove 'light' before 'breeze'
Explanation:- 'breeze' ka matlab hee 'light wind' hota hai, isliye iske sath 'light' superfluous hoga. Note:- 'helped the child go to sleep' me 'go' bare infinitive hai.

questions.question: The speed of the / car decreased when it / approached near the toll plaza.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'near'
Explanation:- 'approach' ek transitive verb jiske baad object aate hai, isliye iske baad 'near' preposition galat hogi aur 'approach' ka matlab 'kisi ke pass pahuchna' jiske sath 'near' superfluous hota hai.

questions.question: I request you / to kindly help me in / decorating this room.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'kindly'
Explanation:- 'request' and 'kindly' sath mein superfluous maane jaate hain. 'I request you to help me...', 'Kindly help me in....' Inme se ek structure ka use sahi hota hai. Yahan sentence parts mein divided hai isliye b part mein se 'kindly' ko remove karna hi option hai.

questions.question: While finalising the (a)/ lengthy rental agreement, the landlord (b)/ requested the tenant to put her sign (c)/ on each page of the contract. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'sign' with 'signature'
Explanation:- 'sign' ki jagah 'signature' hoga kyunki 'sign' verb hoti hai aur 'signature noun hota hai, sentence mein 'her' adjective hai jiske baad noun ki jarurat hai, isliye 'signature' noun sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: His elder sister has been (a)/ working in foreign for more than (b)/ five years, although she frequently visits home (c)/ to spend time with her parents. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'in foreign' with 'abroad'
Explanation: Sentence mein 'in foreign' ki jagah 'abroad' aayega kyunki 'in' preposition ke baad object ki jarurat hai, lekin 'foreign' adjective hota hai, isliye 'in foreign ko hatake 'abroad' adverb of place se bhi wahi meaning aayega, isliye 'abroad' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While conducting a practice session, (a)/ the English teacher advised the students to revise the grammar rules (b)/ thoroughly before attempting the practice questions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'the English teacher' with 'the teacher of English'
Explanation:- 'the English teacher ka matlab hoga 'angrej teacher', lekin sentence mein matlab chaiye 'english padhane wala teacher jiske liye 'the teacher of english sahi term hoga. Ex:- 'the german teacher' ka matlab 'aisa teacher jo Germany se belong karta ho'

questions.question: Unless she doesn't submit (a)/ all the required documents her application (b)/ for the scholarship will not be processed. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'doesn't submit' with 'submits'
Explanation:- 'unless ka matlab hota hai 'agar nahi jisme 'not' pehle se hee hota hai, isliye 'doesn't' yahan superfluous hoga, isliye 'she ke according 'submits' singular verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: He warned them that the boy (a)/ they were making fun of was his cousin brother (b)/ and that such behaviour would not be tolerated by him. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'brother' after 'cousin'
Explanation:- 'cousin' ke sath brother yaa sister ka use nahi hota kyunki 'cousin' pehle se hee noun hai, isliye 'cousin' ke sath 'brother yaa sister superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'brother' nahi aayega, sentence mein 'boy' se pata chal gaya hai.

questions.question: You need not worry (a)/ because the finance department (b)/ has assured that it will reimburse back all the travel expenses. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'back' after 'reimburse'
Explanation:- 'reimburse ka matlab hee hota hai 'give back, waapas lautana', isliye iske sath 'back' superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'back' nahi aayega.

questions.question: These programmes which play a crucial (a)/ role in enhancing employment opportunities (b)/ in several underdeveloped regions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'which'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'which' nahi aayega kyunki 'which' se adjectival clause bana hai jiski verb 'play' hai, lekin 'programs' subject ko verb nahi mili poore sentence mein, isliye yahan 'which' relative pronoun ho hata denge, jisse 'play' verb 'programs' subject ke liye verb ban jaayegi.

questions.question: A student who has worked consistently (a)/ throughout the year he will surely perform well (b)/ in the final examinations that the university conducts annually. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'he' after 'year'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'he' pronoun nahi aayega kyunki 'who....se lekar... the year' tak clause bana hai, aur 'student subject ki verb 'will' banegi, isliye yahan 'he' pronoun ko hatana padega, jisse 'will' verb 'student' subject ko mil paaye.

questions.question: The villagers decided to rebuild (a)/ the old community hall again after (b)/ it got damaged in the heavy storm. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'again' after 'hall'
Explanation: Sentence mein 'again' nahi aayega kyunki 'rebuild' ka matlab hee hota hai dubara banana', isliye 'again' adverb superfluous hoga.

questions.question: The athlete was very (a)/ strong enough to complete the entire marathon (b)/ despite the harsh weather conditions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'very'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'very' aur 'enough' sath mein nahi aapayenge kyunki yaa toh 'very strong' hota yaa 'strong enough', lekin aage infinitive likhna hai aur infinitive ke sath 'enough' sahi hota hai, isliye yahan 'very' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: The students are angry because (a)/ the passing marks have been increased to fifty percent (b)/ by the institution just before the final examinations (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'passing marks' with 'pass marks'
Explanation:- 'passing marks' ka matlab hota hai 'pass hote hue marks', lekin hume yeh kehna hai ki pass hone ke liye marks' isliye yahan 'pass marks' sahi term hoti hai, isliye 'pass marks sahi hoga.

questions.question: They worked in (a)/ this remote village for a brief period of time (b)/ before shifting to the nearby town (c)/ to start their new business venture. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'of time' before 'period'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'of time' nahi aayega kyunki 'period' ka matlab hee 'time' hota hai, isliye yahan 'a brief period' ke sath 'of time' nahi aayega.

questions.question: The coach forbade (a)/ the players not to (b)/ consume junk food during the training period (c)/ as it could negatively affect their performance. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'not'
Explanation:- 'forbade' verb mein 'not pehle se hee understood hai aur iska matlab 'kisi ko kuch kaam karne se rokna/mana karna', isliye iske sath 'not' nahi aayega.

questions.question: At the end of the semester (a)/ the professor will leave the institute (b)/ for his hometown with bag and baggage. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'with'
Explanation:- Sentence mein bag and baggage ek adverb ki tarah se kaam karne wala structure hai, aur isse pehle preposition nahi aati, isliye yahan 'with' preposition nahi aayegi.

questions.question: The final report (a)/ should not exceed more than fifty pages (b)/ as the committee has instructed all researchers (c)/ to keep the documentation concise and precise. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'more than'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'more than' nahi aayega kyunki 'exceed' ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi cheez se jyada , isliye iske sath more than superfluous ho jaayega, isliye yahan 'more than' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Rohit mentioned that (a)/ his company had recently signed a mutual agreement (b)/ with a logistics firm of Mumbai (c)/ to streamline deliveries across Maharashtra. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'mutual'
Explanation:- Jab bhi koi agreement sign hote hai wo mutually he sign hota hai, isliye 'agreement' ke sath 'mutual' superfluous hoga. aur 'mutual' ko hatane se 'agreement' ke according 'an' article bhi aayega.

questions.question: Anjali doesn't hardly remember anything (a)/ about the chain-snatching incident (b)/ that took place when she was ten years old. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove either 'hardly' or 'doesn't'
Explanation:- 'hardly' ka matlab he hota hai 'naa ke barabar isme pehle se hee not understood hota hai, isliye 'hardly' yaa 'doesn't' mein se koi ek word aayega.

questions.question: The reason why many youngsters (a)/ fall for online investment scams (b)/ is because they blindly trust influencers (c)/ who promise unrealistic returns in a few days. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'because' with 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'because ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'reason' ka matlab he hota hai 'kaaran' aur 'because' ka bhi 'kaaran' matlab hota hai, isliye yahan 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki yahan 'kii' wala meaning chaiye, general structure 'the reason is that hota hai. isliye yahan 'because ki jagah 'that' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He reiterated his point again (a)/ during the discussion hoping that the committee (b)/ would finally pay attention to his proposal. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'again'
Explanation:- reiterated ka matlab hee hota hai 'say again, dohraana', isliye iske sath 'again' superfluous hoga, isliye 'again' nahi aayega.

questions.question: While travelling to Pune for an official meeting, (a)/ I came across by chance (b)/ an old schoolmate, Rohan, at the railway food stall. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'by chance'
Explanation:- 'came across ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi se achanak milna', isliye iske sath 'by chance(achanak)' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: Meera asked her brother (a)/ that why he had not attended (b)/ their cousin's engagement ceremony. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'that'
Explanation:- Sentence indirect speech mein likha hai, toh 'asked' verb ke saath 'how, why, where, when' yehi conjunction ka kaam karte hai, aur iss sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction nahi aayegi.

questions.question: Kavya doesn't have sufficient enough savings (a)/ to manage her rent and groceries in Bengaluru (b)/ if she gets fired from her job. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove either 'sufficient' or 'enough'
Explanation:- 'sufficient' ka matlab hee 'enough' hota hai, isliye inn dono mein se koi ek ka use hoga.

questions.question: Muskan asked her brother (a)/ supposing if their train to Kolkata got cancelled due to heavy rains (b)/ what alternative route they could take (c)/ to reach there on time for the ceremony. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove either 'supposing' or 'if'
Explanation:- 'supposing' aur 'if dono ek sath nahi aate, kyunki inn dono ka matlab same hota hai, isliye dono mein se ek hi lagayenge.

questions.question: Not until the results were announced (a)/ did she understand how well she (b)/ had performed in the examination. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No error
Explanation:- 'Until' as a conjunction aajaye toh verb ke sath 'not' nahi aata, lekin 'until' ko qualify karne ke liye 'not' aa sakta hai, 'not until structure use hota hai.

questions.question: The investigation revealed the true fact (a)/ that the fire in the Surat textile market (b)/ broke out owing to faulty wiring (c)/ and negligence of shop owners. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'true'
Explanation:- 'fact' humesha bolte usi ko hai jo true ho, isliye 'fact' ke sath 'true' superfluous hai.

questions.question: While travelling to Lucknow (a)/ Priya got stuck for hours (b)/ as it suddenly started raining like cats and dogs (c)/ near the Barabanki highway toll plaza. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) remove 'like'
Explanation:- 'raining cats and dogs ka matlab hai 'raining heavily' matlab 'moosladhaar baarish', jisme 'cats and dogs' ka matlab 'heavily hai matlab yeh adverb hai aur adverb se pehle 'like' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: Radhika had prepared extensively for (a)/ her CGL mains but because she fell sick (b)/ on the morning of the (c)/ exam, she couldn't give the test. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'give' with 'take'
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab 'wo test nahi de paayi', toh grammar mein iske liye sahi word 'take' hai, isliye yahan 'she couldn't take the test sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The HR representative informed the (a)/ applicants that the team would revert back (b)/ to each of them individually (c)/ after thoroughly examining all the submitted documents. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'back'
Explanation:- 'revert' ka matlab hee hota hai 'answer back', isliye iske saath 'back' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: While driving late at night on the (a)/ Ahmedabad-Vadodara Expressway he slowed (b)/ down his bike when he (c)/ approached near the police barricade. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) remove 'near'
Explanation:- 'approached' ek transitive verb hai jiske baad object aayega, isliye 'approached' ke baad 'near' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: Before leaving for his night shift (a)/ Raghav requested his neighbour to kindly (b)/ look after his elderly father who(c)/ had been feeling unwell since the previous evening. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'kindly'
Explanation:- 'requested' ke sath 'kindly ka use nahi hota kyunki dono ka meaning same hota hai, agar 'requested' pehle likha hai toh 'kindly' hatana padega.

questions.question: What should have been (a)/ a great disaster (b)/ was averted.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'could' in place of 'should'.
Explanation:- Meaning based error hai ye. 'What should have been a great disaster' ka matlab hoga 'Jo bahut bada Disaster hona chahiye tha'. Aur 'What could have been a great disaster' ka matlab hoga 'Jo bahut bada disaster ho sakta tha'. Toh 'ho sakta tha' waale meaning ke liye 'could' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: You must (a)/ be hurry, (b)/ otherwise you will (c)/ miss the train.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'be'
Explanation:- kyunki 'must' modal ke baad ek hi main verb aayegi 'be' and 'hurry' dono verbs hain. Sentence ka matlab hai 'tumhe jaldi karna chaiye', toh Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'hurry' main verb rahegi, aur 'be' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: There was such a crowd (a)/ that he would (b)/ not find his brother. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'could' in place of 'would'
Explanation:- Meaning based error hai ye. 'he would not find his brother' ka matlab hoga 'wo apne bhai ko nahi dhundega'. Aur 'he could not find his brother' ka matlab hoga 'wo apne bhai ko nahi dhund paaya tha'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'dhund nahi paaya' wala meaning sahi hai, isliye yahan 'could' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Distrust seems to (a)/ be a factor borne out (b)/of prevailing circumstances.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'born' in place of 'borne'
Explanation:- Both 'born' and 'borne' are forms of verb 'bear'. 'Born' is commonly used with the meaning "to give birth." 'Borne' is used in adjective form with the meaning 'being carried by'. eg water borne (paani ke dwara carry kiya jaane wala) air borne (hawa ke dwara carry kiya jaane wala) etc. sentence ka matlab hai 'avishvaas maujooda paristhithi se paida hua ek factor hai', toh sentence mein 'paida' wala meaning chaiye, isliye yahan 'born' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The scooter that (a)/ I am using (b)/ these days is belonging (c)/ to my brother.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'belongs' instead of 'is belonging'
Explanation:- Kyunki 'belong' ek stative verb hai, Stative verb esi verbs hoti hain jinhe hum 'ing' form mein use nahi karte. Like -feel, believe, smell, hear, listen, look, belong, have, etc.

questions.question: Would you find me (a)/ absent please do not(b)/ forget to leave a message behind.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'should' in place of 'would'.
Explanation:- Yeh 'should' word ka ek unique use hai. Generally toh yeh modal hi hota hai par 'should' word conjunction bhi ban sakta hai aur tab iska matlab hota hai 'agar'. Yahan sentence ke meaning ke according 'agar' meaning dena hai isliye 'if' yaa 'should' ka use hoga

questions.question: The new taxation rates (a)/ announced by the government (b)/ are bound to effect the export sector. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'affect' in place of 'effect'.
Explanation:- 'affect' generally ek verb ka work karta hai aur 'effect' noun ka. Infinitive 'to+v1' se banta hai, isliye yahan 'to affect' ayega.

questions.question: He uses to study (a)/ till 11 P.M.(b)/ and then goes before (c)/ the library closes. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'studies' in place of 'uses to study'.
Explanation:- poore sentence ko padhke pata chal raha hai ki yahan present ke habitual action ki baat ho rahi hai isliye yahan present indefinite tense lagega jisme verb ki first form use hoti hai. Yahan koi past ki habit nahi hai. Isliye yaha 'studies' present indefinite tense sahi hoga.

questions.question: Every night I am (a)/ in the habit of hearing(b)/ the news on the Radio(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'listening to' in place of 'hearing'.
Explanation:- 'listen' ka matlab hota hai 'intentionally kisi cheez ko sunna'. 'hear' ka matlab hota hai koi cheez sunai de jaana. Toh 'news' generally intentionally he sunte hai, aur 'listen' ke sath 'to' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye 'listening to' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I have friends (a)/ who should love (b)/ to stay at home, (c)/ but they have to go to work.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'would' in place of 'should'.
Explanation:- yeh modal ke meaning par based error hai. 'friends who should love to stay at home' ka matlab hoga 'friends jinhe ghar par rehna pasand karna chahiye'. Aur 'friends who would love to stay at home' ka matlab hoga 'friends jo ghar par rehna pasand karenge'. Toh sentence ke according 'pasand karenge' wala meaning chaiye, isliye 'would' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The Desais soon (a)/ got used to live (b)/ in the country.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'got used to living' in place of 'got used to live'
Explanation:- 'get' yahan linking verb hai aur 'used' yahan adjective hai jo subject complement ka kaam karega, 'get' verb ke liye 'to' preposition hai aur 'live' ko preposition ka object banana hai lekin 'live' toh verb hoti hai, toh verb mein 'ing' lagade toh wo gerund(noun) ban jaayega, isliye yahan 'to living' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The man who (a)/ was committed (b)/ the theft last night (c)/ was caught this evening.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'was'
Explanation:- 'man' commit karne ke action ka doer hai isliye verb active form mein aayegi isliye 'was' ko hatana hoga kyunki 'was + verb' ki 3rd form passive voice hoti hai.

questions.question: Every morning (a)/ he might kiss (b)/ his beloved (c)/ and set off for work.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'used to or would' in place of 'might'.
Explanation:- sentence mein 'might' se pata chal raha hai ki past ki baat ho rahi hai. Aur 'every morning' se pata chal raha ki past ki habit hai yeh, toh past ki habit show karne ke liye 'used to' yaa 'would' model ka use karte hai.

questions.question: When the allotted time (a)/was over they torn off (b)/the papers which they had used.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'tore' in place of 'torn'.
Explanation:- 'tear' verb ki form 'tear, tore, torn' hoti hai, toh 'tore' verb ki 2nd form hai aur 'torn' 3rd form hai. Yahan 2 past ke actions ki baat ho rahi hai isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form aayegi.

questions.question: Psychology has been (a)/ defined the scientific study of (b)/ human psyche and behaviour.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'defined as the' instead of 'defined the'
Explanation:- kyunki kuch aisi verbs hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use kiya jaata hai. jaise 'define, regard, describe, treat, know etc' kyunki in verbs mein generally aisa meaning banta hai 'kisi ko kisi ke jaisa manna'
Eg. - Kalidasa is known as the Shakespeare of India.

questions.question: The unreasonable behaviour (a)/of his daughter (b)/ was thoroughly (c)/upset Mr.Gupta. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'upset' in place of 'was upset'.
Explanation:- kyunki yahan active voice ka use hoga naa ki passive ka. Yahan meaning yeh hai ki 'uski daughter ke unreasonable behaviour ne Mr. Gupta ko poori tarah se upset kar diya'. 'was upset' passive voice hai or voice active karni hai isliye verb ki 2nd form sirf 'upset' use hoga isliye C part se 'was' remove karenge.

questions.question: The child cut his (a)/finger with a razor (b)/and bleeded profusely. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'bled' in place of 'bleeded'
Explanation:- kyunki 'bleed' verb ki forms hoti hai 'bleed, bled, bled'. Sentence ke according 2nd form chaiye, isliye 'bled' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The knight was received (a)/ compliments from the king (b)/for his bravery.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'received' in place of 'was received'
Explanation:-kyunki yahan passive voice nahi active voice ki zarurat hai. Passive mein verb ka object nahi hota, lekin yahan 'compliments' object hai. Isliye isse 'received' active voice mein likhenge.

questions.question: The criminal (a)/will certainly be hung (b)/because the charges brought upon (c)/him are very serious.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'hanged' in place of 'hung'.
Explanation:-
hang - hung - hung (latkaana)
hang - hanged - hanged (faansi dena)

questions.question: Whatever one may say (a)/ of him, (b)/ none dare call in question (c)/ his honesty. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'dares to call' in place of 'dare call'
Explanation:-Yahan 2 galtiyan hain. Ek yeh ki yahan koi 'not' wala yaa interrogative structure nahi ban raha isliye yahan 'dare' ko 'main verb' manenge, aur jab dare main verb banta toh uske baad infinitive aata hai, isliye iske baad 'call' ko 'to call' infinitive mein change karene. kyunki 2 verbs ek sath nahi aayengi. Dusri galti yeh ki 'none' ke baad generally singular verb prefer ki jaati hai isliye 'dares' likhenge, isliye 'dares to call' sahi hoga.

questions.question: [When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fleed the spot.]
options: (a) When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fled the spot.
(b) When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately flew the spot.
(c) When the villagers putted up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately fleed the spot.
(d) When the villagers put up a firm resistance to the fearsome bandit with all their might, he ultimately flown the spot.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'fled' instead of 'fleed'
Explanation:- sentence mein 'flee' verb ki baat karni hai jiski form 'Flee, Fled, Fled' hoti hai aur 'when' se pata chal raha ki past ke do action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'fled' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi.

questions.question: When I was young,(a)/ I can run (b)/faster than mohan.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'could' in place of 'can'.
Explanation:- sentence padhke pata chal raha ki past ki baat ho rahi hai, toh verb past mein aayegi, isliye 'can' ki past form 'could' sahi hogi.

questions.question: I never considered him to be a person who would (a)/ go back on his promise and (b)/ then do not even apologise. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'do'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 2 verbs 'and' conjunction se Jodi gayi hai isliye 2nd verb apologise se pehle bhi 'would' modal understood hai, 'who would go back on his promise and then (would) not even apologise'. Isliye yahan 'do' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: [As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.]
options: (a) As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
(b) As soon as we gone for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
(c) As soon as we were going for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia digged a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
(d) As soon as we went for an afternoon siesta, my pet rabbit Tia dug a huge hole right in the middle of the lawn.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) use 'dug' instead of 'digged'
Explanation:- sentence mein 'dig' verb ki baat karni hai jiski form 'Dig, Dug, Dug' hoti hai, toh sentence mein 'as soon as' se pata chal raha ki do action sath mein ho rahe hai aur 'went' se past ka pata chal raha hai, isliye yahan bhi verb ki 2nd form 'dug' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: A soldier (a)/ could fight (b)/ for his country and save his country's honour. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'must' in place of 'could'.
Explanation:- yeh modal verb ke meaning par based error hai. 'A soldier could fight for his country' ka matlab hoga 'ek soldier apne desh ke liye lad sakta hai'. Aur 'A soldier must fight for his country' ka matlab hoga 'ek soldier ko apne desh ke liye zarur ladna chahiye'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according compulsion wala meaning chaiye, isliye yahan 'must' model ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Would you liked (a)/ to have some fries (b)/ along with your coffee, sir?" (c)/ asked the waiter.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'like' instead of 'liked'
Explanation:-kyunki modal verbs ke baad verb ki 'base form' ka use kiya jaata hai. Isliye yahan 'like' verb ki base form sahi hogi.

questions.question: "He may live long"(a)/ his sad mother (b)/ prayed.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'May he live long' in place of 'He may live long'.
Explanation:-kyunki yeh ek optative sentence hai jo ki prayer ke liye use hua hai. Optative sentence wo hote hai jo prayer, wish, desire etc. ko express karte hai. Eg. 'long live the king, god bless you, may you live long etc.'
Note:- yahan 'may' ki jagah 'might' nahi hoga kyunki yeh direct speech mein likha gaya hai.

questions.question: Raman putted the vegetables (a)/ in the frying pan (b)/ and after adding some water, (c)/ closed the lid.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'put' instead of 'putted'
Explanation:- sentence mein 'put' verb ki baat karni hai iski teeno forms same hoti hai, isliye yahan 'putted' ki jagah 'put' ayega.

questions.question: If you get good marks (a)/ I shall happy (b)/as much as you. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'shall be happy' in place of 'shall happy'.
Explanation:-kyunki 'shall' ek modal hai aur 'happy' ek adjective hai toh hume 'shall' ke baad ek aise main verb ki zarurat hai jiske baad akela adjective 'happy' aa sake isliye yahan main verb ke roop me ek linking verb 'be' ka use hoga.

questions.question: When the villagers (a)/ were attacked, (b)/ they were raised to violence. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'roused' in place of 'raised'.
Explanation:- 'Raise' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi cheez ko uthana', aur 'Rouse' ka matlab 'kisi person ke andar kisi feeling ko jagana'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'villager ke andar violence ki feeling uthpann ho gayi', isliye yahan 'roused' verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: All those students who are participating in the play (a)/ have been notify (b)/ to stay back for rehearsal (c)/ after 3:00 p.m.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'have been notified' instead of 'have been notify'
Explanation: kyunki 'students' notify action ke receiver hain, matlab wo iss ko notify nahi karenge, balki unhe notify kiya jaayega, isliye verb passive form mein aayegi, isliye 'have been notified' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Why didn't (a)/ you submitted (b)/ your project (c)/ on time?(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'submit' instead of 'submitted'
Explanation:- kyunki 'Do/Does/Did' ke baad verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai, isliye 'didn't you submit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Electric heaters (a)/were providing (b)/to all the officers (c)/at the guest house.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'were provided' instead of 'were providing'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Electric heaters' provide kiye gaye the, naa ki 'electric heater kuch provide karenge', isliye verb passive form mein aayegi 'were provided' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Einstein's school teachers (a)/thought he would (b)/never success (c)/in life.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'succeed' instead of 'success'
Explanation:- kyunki 'would' ek modal hai aur modal verbs ke baad verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai, 'Success' ek noun hai aur 'Succeed' verb hai.

questions.question: You need not tell a lie (a)/ when the judge asked you yesterday where you were (b)/ when the crime was committed.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'need not have told a lie' in place of 'need not tell a lie'.
Explanation:- kyunki iss sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki 'tumhe jhoot bolne ki zarurat nahi thi, jab judge ne kal tumse pucha tha ki tum kahan the jab crime kiya gaya tha'. Yahan aage past ki baat ho rahi hai matlab wo person jhoot bol chuka hai. Isliye yahan 'modal + have + v3' structure ka use hoga.

questions.question: If we have no definite aim before us (a)/ we would only wonder about in aimless pursuits (b)/ and achieve nothing.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'wander' in place of 'wonder'.
Explanation:- 'wander' ka matlab 'bina kisi udeshya yaa disha ke idhar-udhar ghumna', 'Wonder' ka matlab 'kuch janana chahna, kuch janane ke liye excited hona'. toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'wander' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The monkeys swinged (a)/ on the branches and (b)/ jumped over the compound wall. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'swung' instead of 'swinged'
Explanation:- 'jumped' se pata chal raha ki past ki baat karna hai, kyunki 'swing' verb ki 2nd and 3rd form 'swung' hoti hai. 'Swing, Swung, Swung', isliye yahan 'swung' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Need you (a)/ to buy (b)/so many books? (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'buy' instead of 'to buy'
Explanation:- Iss sentence ko theek karne ke 2 methods hain. Ek to agar 'need' ko main verb banaye toh 'Do you need to buy' lagake theek ho jaayega aur 2nd agar 'need' ko modal banaye to 'Need you buy' karke theek ho jaayega. 'Correct the latter part' wale concept ke according 'need you buy' wale structure ko prefer krenge.

questions.question: The doctor advised Mr. Murugan that, (a)/ because of his severe cramps, (b)/ he should lay in bed for a few days.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'lie' in place of 'lay'
Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai doctor ne Murugan ko advice kiya, severe cramps ki wazah se unhe kuch din bed pe letna chaiye', toh letne waale meaning ke liye 'lie' verb ka use hoga. 'Lie' verb jiska matlab 'letna yaa pada hona' hota hai aur yeh intransitive hoti hai, iski form 'lie, lay, lain' hoti hai. Aur 'Lay' verb jiska matlab 'letaana yaa rakhna' aur yeh transitive hoti hai, iski form 'lay, laid, laid' hoti hai.

questions.question: Though the police tried all sorts of methods to illicit (a)/ information from the public (b)/ they remained silent.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'elicit' in place of 'illicit'
Explanation:- 'Elicit' ka matlab 'kisi se information, facts wagera nikalwaana' aur 'Illicit' ka matlab 'illegal (Gair kanooni)', toh sentence ka matlab hai 'police ne public se jankari haasil karne ke liye saare tarike apnaaye', toh 'information nikaalne ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'elicit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I ordered his dismissal (a)/when he flouted (b)/the company rules.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) no error
Explanation:- 'flout' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi baat ko maane se inkaar karna, law yaa rules ka paalan naa karna', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'flouted' ka use yahan sahi hai.

questions.question: News of the calamity (a)/ is reached (b)/ the family members (c)/the next day.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'reached' instead of 'is reached'
Explanation:- kyunki yahan meaning yeh hai ki 'calamity ki news family members ke paas agle din pahunchi thi, toh 'news pahuchi naa ki 'news ko pahuchaya gaya' isliye isse 'is reached' passive voice mein nahi balki 'reached' active voice mein likhenge.

questions.question: Bhagat Singh lie down (a)/ his life (b)/ for his motherland.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'laid down' in place of 'lie down'
Explanation:- 'lie down' ka matlab 'neeche letna' aur 'lay down' ka matlab 'nyochhawar yaa kurbaan kar dena', sentence ka matlab hai 'Bhagat Singh ne apni motherland ke liye jaan nyochaawar kardi', isliye yahan 'laid down' phrasal verb sahi hoga. Note:- 'lay down' phrasal verb ke aur bhi matlab hote hai

questions.question: The tennis player easy through the (a)/opening set before her opponent and rallied to take the (b)/final two sets for the biggest victory of her young career.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'eased' in place of 'easy'.
Explanation:-kyunki 'easy' ek adjective hai and 'eased' verb hai. Hume yahan 'player' subject ke baad verb ki requirement hai. Isliye yahan 'eased' verb sahi hoga.

questions.question: This summer, (a)/I've met down (b)/a lot of (c)/interesting people. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'met' instead of 'met down'
Explanation:- kyunki 'meet down' jaisi koi phrasal verb nahi hai. kisi se milne wale meaning ke liye 'meet' verb ka use hota hai jiski form 'meet, met, met' hoti. 'I've' ka matlab 'I have', toh 'have' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai, isliye 'have met' sahi hoga.
eg. I met my uncle.

questions.question: I use to going (a)/for a morning walk (b)/when I was (c)/living in Dehradun.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'I used to go' instead of 'I use to going'
Explanation:- kyunki past ke kisi Habitual action ko refer karne ke liye 'used to' modal ka use kiya jaata hai, aur modal verb ke sath verb ki base form ka use kiya jaata hai. Isliye 'I used to go' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You may ask (a)/ someone where the ship (b)/ is bounded for. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'bound' in place of 'bounded'.
Explanation:- 'bound for' phrasal verb hoti hai jiska matlab 'kisi jagah ki taraf'.
Eg. This bus is bound for Broadway. Aur ek verb hoti hai 'bind' jiska matlab hota hai (rassi se baandhna) aur iski form hoti hai 'bind, bound, bound'.
Eg. They bound the prisoner's hands behind his back. Aur ek aur verb hoti hai 'bound' jiska matlab 'bade bade steps leke bhaagna' jiski form 'Bound, bounded, bounded' hoti hai. Sentence ka matlab 'ship kaha jaa raha hai', toh 'jaane waale meaning ke liye 'bound for' phrasal verb ka use sahi hai.

questions.question: The problems that our(a)/ country has and will face (b)/ are the outcome of the selfishness (c)/of our so called saviours.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'has faced and will face' in place of 'has and will face'
Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'jo problems apni country face karti hui aa rahi hai aur kargi', toh 'has' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai aur 'will' ke baad verb ki base form, isliye yahan main verb ko common nahi liya jaa sakta. Isliye 'has faced and will face' verb sahi hogi

questions.question: They made her (a)/as the Chairperson (b)/of their bank (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Remove 'as'
Explanation:- kyunki 'as' comparison ko dikhata hai aur yahan 'her' and 'chairperson' ek hi hai toh comparison nahi hoga. Isliye yahan 'as' ka use nahi hoga. Grammatically baat Karein toh 'her' object hai aur 'chairperson' object complement hai.

questions.question: It is be said (a)/ that in 2019 (b)/ the Indian Stock Market will fall (c)/drastically and we can expect that fall very soon.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'it is being said' or 'it is said' instead of 'it is be said'
Explanation:- jab koi expected event ke baare mein batana ho aur yeh wala meaning ho ki 'aisa kaha jata hai' yaa 'aisa kaha jaa raha hai', toh iss meaning ke liye phrase 'it is said' ka use hota hai aur agar wo event chal raha hai toh present continous ka passive 'it is being said' ka use hota hai, sentence ke according dono structure possible hai.

questions.question: Most of my friends(a)/ heard the earthquake (b)/ but I was totally unaware of it. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'felt' in place of 'heard'.
Explanation:- kyunki earthquake feel kiya jaayega naa ki suna jaayega. Isliye yahan 'heard' ki jagah 'felt' aayega.

questions.question: The President (a)/ overtakes (b)/ in Bangladesh. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'takes over' in place of 'overtakes'.
Explanation:- 'take over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez pe control karna', aur 'overtake' ka matlab 'kisi vehicle wagera se aage nikal jana', sentence ka matlab hai 'president ne Bangladesh ka control le liya', isliye yahan 'takes over' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Our equipment gets damage (a)/very often in summer because (b)/there are frequent power cuts.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'damaged' in place of 'damage'.
Explanation:- 'get' linking verb ki tarah kaam karti hai aur iske baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, lekin 'damage' yahan verb hai, isliye isse adjective banana ke liye past participle(adjective) 'damaged' mein change karna hoga. Isliye yahan 'gets damaged' sahi hoga. eg. 'He got injured. He got tired'.

questions.question: It was a (a)/windy autumn day (b)/and leaves were fallen (c)/rapidly from the trees.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'falling' instead of 'fallen'
Explanation:- kyunki 'fall' happening verb hai iska passive nahi banta aur yahan meaning passive wala nahi dena. Balki yeh kehna hai ki 'wo ek windy autumn day tha jisme jaldi jaldi tree se patte gir rahe the', toh koi cheez ho rahi thi, isliye yahan 'fall' verb ki happening(ing) form 'were falling' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He transferred (a)/the melted iron (b)/in a large container.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'molten' instead of 'melted'.
Explanation:- Yahan 'iron' noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hai. Aur 'melt' verb ki form 'Melt, Melted, Melted' hoti hai aur 'molten' ek adjective hota hai, isliye yahan 'molten iron' sahi hoga.
