questions.question: He was so curious [that he rose many questions] in the meeting.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation: Ye question 'rise, raise and arouse' ke difference pe based hai. 'raise' transitive verb hoti hai jisme matlab 'uthana, badhaana, paalna' hota hai aur 'rise, arise' dono intransitive verb hoti hai, sentence mein transitive verb chaiye kyunki 'questions' object diya hai sentence ka matlab hai 'usne uthaaye bahut saare question meeting mein', toh meaning aur grammar ke according 'raised' verb sahi hogi. 'raise' verb ki forms 'raise, raised, raised' hoti hai.

questions.question: My friend [is owing an expensive cell phone].
options: (d) is own an expensive cell phone
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'own' possession ko dikhane wali ek stative verb hoti hai aur iski 'ing form' nahi hoti. Subject singular hai isliye 'owns' singular verb wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Delegates of the conflicting countries formally meet at a conference [to ironing out] their differences.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan 2 concepts use ho rahe hai. Ek toh yeh ki action ka purpose bataane ke liye yaa verb se 'why' ka reply dene ke liye 'to + v1' infinitive ka use hota hai. Dusra concept 'iron out' phrasal verb hoti hai meaning 'problems aur dispute ko niptaana'. Toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'to iron out' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The Intern should [take a right choice] in choosing the right job for her.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Make a right choice/ decision' ek fix expression hai. yeh fix expression reading se hi pata chalte hain. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Old people [acquire experience] through age.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'experience prapt karna' meaning dene ke liye 'gain experience' ka use hoga. Yeh reading based question hote hain ki kya meaning mein konsi verb ayegi.

questions.question: The application of the medicine seemed to [lesson] his pain.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yahan infinitive likhna hai jo 'to + v1' se banta hai. 'lesson, lesion' word noun hote hai or 'lessen' ek verb hai or 'lessened' past participle (adjective) hota. Toh infinitive ke liye verb ki jarurat hai, isliye 'to lessen' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Eighty girls sat there at four long tables, [doing their homework by] candlelight.
options: (a) to have done their homework with
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'eighty girls 4 long tables pe bethkar apna homework karti hui candle light ke side mein', toh continuity dikhaani hai isliye 'doing' present participle ko sahi use kiya gaya hai. Isliye option A galat hoga. C option isliye nahi hoga kyunki yaa toh meaning ke according 'doing' se a sakta hai yaa 'to do' lekin 'to doing' se nahi. D option isliye nahi hoga kyuki usme 'its' likha hai, jabki 'girls' ke liye 'their' chaiye, isliye 'no improvement' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The snowstorm in that region [will effect thousand] of travellers.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Affect' verb hoti hai aur 'Effect' noun hota hai. Sentence mein verb ki jarurat hai, isliye option B aur C galat honge. Option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'would' model hai aur model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye option A bhi galat hoga. Hazaro travellers meaning dene ke liye yahan 'thousands of travellers' ka use hoga. Isliye D option 'will affect thousands' hi sahi hoga.

questions.question: A clinical thermometer [consists of a] long, narrow, uniform glass tube.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- A option isliye nahi hoga kyunki 'consist' ek stative verb hai iski 'ing' form nahi hoti. C option isliye nahi hoga kyunki singular subject ke according singular verb aayegi. D option isliye nahi hoga kyunki yahan ek fact bataya jaa raha jo ki present indefinite tense yani v1 mein likha jata hai. Isliye yeh 'no improvement' hoga.

questions.question: The district [woken up to a] thick blanket of snow this morning as the winter entered its most bitter phase.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation: question mein aage 'entered' word se pata chal raha hai ki past tense ayega, 'woken' 3rd form hoti hai, isliye option B galat hoga, 'awaken' jaise koi word nahi hai 'awoken' hota hai, isliye option C bhi galat hoga, past tense ki baat karni hai, isliye sirf D option verb ki 2nd form 'woke up to a' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The small farmers often [need at] borrow money to meet high expenses.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Generally need verb ke baad infinitive ka structure aata hai.
Eg. He needs to study hard. isliye C option 'need to' aayega.

questions.question: Rioting broke out after the government [raised] the fuel prices again.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'broke' 2nd form se pata chal raha ki sentence past mein hai isliye diye gaye options mein 'raised' verb ki 2nd form he sahi hoga. Isliye 'no substitution' sahi hoga.

questions.question: As the tree came crashing down, the monkeys [woke up from its sleep] and ran from branch to branch.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- sentence mein 'came' verb se pata chal raha sentence past mein hai aur 'monkeys' plural hain, isliye 'their' ka use hoga. isliye 'woke up from their sleep' A option sahi hoga. 'waken' jaise word nahi hota, 'woken' 3rd form hoti hai.

questions.question: The prospects of surviving any serious illness are improved if the disease is [catching early].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'kisi bhi serious bimaari se bachne ka prospect bhad jaayega agar uss bemaari ko samay se pakad liya jaaye', toh yahan 'disease' kuch nahi pakdegi, balki disease ko pakadna hai, isliye isse passive voice mein likhenge isliye option D galat hoga. Option A aur C bhi galat honge kyunki yeh continuous mein likhe, sentence mein koi continuity show nahi karni, Toh passive ke according 'is caught early' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The range of flavours is determined by where the plant species is grown and how [it is processed].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sentence ka maltab hai 'flavours ki range determine hoti hai ki kahan plant ki species grow hui hai aur kaise unhe process kiya gaya hai', toh 'plant' kuch process nhai kar rahe balki unhe 'process' kiya jaa raha hai, isliye yahan passive voice aayega, option A aur B galat honge kyunki active mein likhe hai, sentence mein kahi gayi baat ek fact ke taur pe hai naa ki past ka koi action isliye yahan present indefinite ka passive 'it is processed' he sahi hoga. Option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The news about the surge in Covid-19 cases [is broadcasted] every morning.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Noun chapter ke according 'news' ke sath verb singular aati hai aur 'broadcast' verb ki form 'v1,v2,v3' same hi hoti hai. Isliye 'is broadcast' B option sahi hai

questions.question: The pilgrims [were fined them] one thousand rupees each for littering around the shrine.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- sentence ka maltab hai 'Pilgrims par fine Igaya gaya' naa ki 'pilgrims ne fine lagaya' ye meaning dene ke liye passive voice ka use hoga, isliye B option nahi hoga. Verb plural chahiye isliye C option nahi hoga. object 'them' nahi aayega isliye A option bhi nahi hoga. D option 'were fined' sahi hai.

questions.question: [Hears to] the news tonight at 9 p.m., as there will be an important announcement about the budget.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yeh imperative sentence banana hai isliye v1 ka use hoga aur 'news' ko sunne ke liye 'hear' nahi 'listen' verb ka use hoga isliye D option aayega. 'jab intentionally' sune toh 'listen' aur 'sunai de jaaye', toh 'hear' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: I worked hard so [that I might success].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yhan modal ke baad verb ki base form aayegi. success and successor noun hain, successful adjective hai. succeed verb hai. isliye yhan C option aayega.

questions.question: The green shirt is too [lose for me] to wear.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'lose' verb ka maltab (harna yaa kho dena), 'loss' noun ka matlab (nuksaan), 'loose' adjective ka matlab (dheela), 'is' linking verb ke baad adjective ki jarurat hai, isliye 'loose' adjective ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: According to J Krishnamurti, education is not about having a career but about being able to look, [observation] and listen.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- yahan 3 infinitives ko joda gaya hai 'to look', 'to observe' and 'to listen'. yeh concept advance verb mein padhaya jata hai ki jab 2 yaa 2 se jada infinitive conjunction se jode jaate hain uss case 'to' bas first infinitive ke sath hi likhte hain. Isliye C option aayega. A mein 'observer' noun hai isliye galat hai. B mein 'observant' adjective hai isliye galat hai. D mein 'observation' noun hai isliye galat hai.

questions.question: The river [overflew it's banks] in the monsoon.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Banks' (river ke kinaare) yeh word noun hai ispe river ka possession banane ke liye 'its' possessive adjective ka use hoga. 'It's = 'It is' hota hai aur ye pronoun + verb hota hai isliye B option galat hai. 'overflow' verb ki form 'overflow, overflowed, overflowed' hoti hai, isliye option D 'overflowed its banks' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If somebody attacks you, you [needs be able] to defend yourself.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'You' subject ke baad verb plural aati hai aur 'need' verb ke baad generally infinitive se structure banta hai isliye 'need to be able' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The children's cricket ball hit their neighbour's window [and it broke].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan meaning dena hai 'wo khidki toot gyi' iske liye happening verb 'it broke' sahi lagi hui hai. A option me 'is' ke baad v2 diya hai, B option mein v3 bina helping verb ke hai, C option me continuous hai. isliye ye teeno options galat hai.

questions.question: My student, a doctor by profession, [preferring to walk] to the hospital everyday.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'everyday' se pata chal raha ki habitual action hai, aur Habitual action ke liye present indefinite tense yani 'V1' lagate hai aur subject singular hai isliye verb singular ayegi. isliye C option 'prefers to walk' sahi hai.

questions.question: I request you [to not to crack] jokes in the class.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Kisi ko kuch karne ki request ke liye generally ye structure use hota hai: 'I request you to help me.' Yahan kuch naa karne ki request hai iske liye 'not + infinitive' ka use hota hai. isliye 'not to crack' A option sahi hai.

questions.question: [Shall you pass] me that pasta bowl?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan khane ka bowl pass karne ki request kari jara hi hai jo ki informal request ke ander ayega, informal request ke liye 'can' model ka use karte hai isliye 'can you pass' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: I told Pooja [that she could have use my car to get around] while she is in my hometown
options: (a) that she could have use my car to get around with
(b) that she can use my car to get around
(c) that she could have use my car to get away
(d) that she can use my car to get away with
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- A and C option galat hai kyunki 'modal + have + V3' sahi structure hota hai. D option ke last me 'get away with' dia hai jiska meaning 'punishment se bachke nikal jana hota hai' jo sentence ke meaning ke according sahi nahi hai. B option mein jo 'get around' hai uska meaning hota hai ka matlab 'bina kisi problem ke alag alag jagahon pe jana', toh isse matlab hoga 'wo meri car use kar sakti hai kahin bhi jaane ke liye jab wo seher mein ho', toh meaning ke according 'to get around' wala option B sahi hoga.
Note:- Tense chapter ke concept ke according main clause past mein hai toh sub clause bhi past mein hona chahiye but aisa koi option nahi hai jo grammatically 100% sahi ho toh diye gaye options mein se B best hai usi ko mark karna padega.

questions.question: [Would you have been] so kind as to close the window?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Polite request ke liye 'would' modal ka use hota hai aur modal ke baad verb base form mein aati hai isliye B option 'would you be' sahi hoga.

questions.question: [Do I need] finish this work today itself?
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Need' modal ya main verb banta hai jiske yahan according 2 structures ho sakte the. 'Do I need to finish this work today itself?' , aur 'Need I finish this work today itself?'. 1st structure mein need ke baad infinitive chahiye tha jo ki diya nahi hai. isliye B option 'Need I finish' hi mark kiya jaayega.

questions.question: Don't park your car here, the police [should] tow it away.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: yahan possibility show karni hai, generally possibility show karne ke liye 'may' yaa 'might' modal ka use hota hai. Isliye C option 'might' use hoga.

questions.question: My uncle and his family [may come] late last night, but I am not sure.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'mere uncle aur unki family shayad kal der raat aaye honge.' iss meaning ke liye 'modal + have + V3' ka structure use hota hai. isliye B option 'might have come' ka use hoga.

questions.question: If Sahana works till night she [can be] able to finish her homework.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Can' yaa 'Could' modal ka use jab ability dikhaane ke liye kiya jata hai toh inke baad 'be able to' ka use superfluous ho jata hai matlab unnecessary ho jata hai. Options ke according best answer D hai.

questions.question: Natwar was a fraudster who always tried to [fooling] others.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Iss question mein verbs ke meanings se confuse na hona. yahan simple concept yeh ki yahan 'try' verb ke baad infinitive likhna hai 'to' bhi likha hai isliye base form 'deceive' lagake 'to deceive' infinitive ban jaayega. Kyunki infinitive mein 'to+v1' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Last week's rain [ravaged] the whole city.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yeh question or aage bhi kaafi question mainly verb ke meaning pe based hain. Sentence and verb ke meaning ke according best option select karna hai.
'Ravage' aur 'Ruin' ka matlab kisi cheez ko bahut buri tarah nuksan pahuchana', 'Rescind' ka matlab 'kisi law wagera ko cancel karna', 'Retract' ka matlab 'peche hatna yaa promise wagera se mukar jana', toh sahi meaning ke according 'ruined' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Her hopes for building her own [house were beaten when] she lost her jewellery box.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yeh verb ke meaning pe based question hai
were defeated - hara di gyi
were frustrated - pareshan kar di gyi
were relieved - free kar di gyi
were dashed - khatam ho gyi.
'Dash someone's hopes' ek idiom hai jiska meaning hota hai 'kisi ki hopes khatam karna' Isliye meaning ke according D option aayega.

questions.question: In times of difficulty, she [preys] for an oracle to guide her.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Prey (noun) shikaar, Pray (verb) prarthna karna, Praise (verb) tareef karna, price (noun) keemat, Isliye grammar and meaning ke base pe yahan D option 'prays' aayega kyunki Subject singular hai.

questions.question: The government has finally agreed to [wave] the entertainment tax on the movie.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- wave (verb) - haath hilana, wave (noun) samundar ki leher, waive (verb) - apna haq yaa claim tyaag dena, Wager (verb) to bet or gamble, Waiver(noun)- a document that records the fact that someone has given up the right to a claim, isliye meaning and grammar ke according yahan A option 'waive' aayega.

questions.question: Polyethylene terephthalate, one of the most often recycled plastics and the material used in the majority of water and soda bottles, [can be transformed] into everything from polyester fabric to automotive parts.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'might be placed' ka matlab 'rakha jaa sakta hai', 'might be evolved' ka matlab 'evolution kiya jaa sakta hai', 'may be converted' ka matlab 'ek form se dusre form change kiya jaa sakta hai', 'may be devaluated' ka matlab 'value ko kam kiya jaa sakta hai', Isliye yahan sentence ke meaning ke according 'may be converted' C option sahi hoga.

questions.question: Oscar is the most prestigious award which is [introduced to good] actors in that year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Award' dene ke liye 'awarded' verb ka use hoga aur oscar obviously best actors ko hi milta hai, isliye 'awarded to best' C option sahi hoga.

questions.question: The art history teacher was sacked after [she were thought] taking school supplies.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: Sentence ke meaning ke according 'teachers ko job se nikal diya gaya kyunki wo school supplies ko chori karti pakdi gayi'. Iss meaning ke liye C option 'she was caught' aayega.

questions.question: I am working hard in order to [earn a decent living].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No substitution.
Explanation:- 'in order to' ke baad verb ki base form ayegi isliye A and B option galat honge. option C meaning ke according sahi nahi hai. D option 'earn a decent living' ka meaning hai 'earn enough money to live a good life' isliye meaning and grammar ke according D option hi sahi hai.

questions.question: Many companies [displaced playing] income tax last year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- A and C option mein 'Hedge' ka matlab 'kisi question ka seedha jawab dene se bachna' jo ki sentence mein required meaning ke according galat hai. Option B mein 'Circumvent' ka meaning hota hai- 'kisi cheez ko avoid karna' lekin iske baad 'to' preposition ka use galat hai, D option me 'evade paying' ka matlab hai 'pay karne se bachna'. D option grammar and meaning dono ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: You must [aware of] friends who speak against you.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'must' ek modal hai iske baad main verb ayegi. 'Caution' noun hai, 'scarce and careful' Adjective hain, isliye A, C, D options galat hain. B option mein 'beware' ek verb hai jo grammar and meaning ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: The [child felt down] from a great height.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- A and D options galat hai kyunki 'V3' and 'v1 + ing' form of verb bina helping verb ke use nahi hoti. B isliye galat hai kyunki 'child' singular hai aur iske baad 'fall' plural verb nahi aa sakti. C option 'fell down' grammatically sahi hai.

questions.question: The little boy [did many mischiefs] in school.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:-'mischief' generally uncountable noun hota hai iska plural nahi hota aur iske sath 'many' nahi aa sakta, isliye A, C, D options galat hai. B option grammatically sahi hai.
Note- 'Make a mistake / make mischief' inn structures mein 'make' verb ka hi use hota hai. ye reading se pata chalta hai.

questions.question: He felt as defenceless as the [sheared] lamb in the field, shivering, stripped of the only protection he had ever had.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan sheared ki jagah shorn hoga kyunki shear ki forms sheared sheared hoti hai lekin iski past participle (adjective) form shorn hoti hai.

questions.question: I was [forbidden to take] any drink.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'prohibited from' ka matlab avoid karna yaa jaane se rokna' aur 'rebuff, Reject, snub' inn sab verb ka meaning 'ignore karna yaa avoid karna' hota hai isliye yeh verb 'prohibit' ke sath galat hai. B option 'prohibited from receiving' meaning ke according sahi hai. Jisse matlab hoga 'mujhe mana kiya gaya hai koi bhi drink lene se'

questions.question: She [does not helping to getting angry] when she sees someone being treated unfairly.
options: (a) is not help to being getting angry
(b) may not help to got angry
(c) will not help to gets angry
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- yahan sentence ka meaning ye dena hai ki:- 'wo khud ko rok nahi paati gussa hone se jab wo kisi ko unfairly treat hote hue dekhti hai'. Ye khud ko rok naa pana wala meaning dene ke liye 'can/could not help + gerund' structure ka use hota hai. eg. I could not help crying when I saw his body. question mein aisa hi meaning dena tha isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: We [might as well] watch a film on TV as there's nothing much to do.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) No improvement required
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Hum tv pe ek film bhi dekh sakte hai kyunki or jada kuch karne ke liye hai nahi, yahan', 'as well' yahan koi simile etc nahi hai ye ek adverb hai jiska meaning 'also jaisa hota hai' isliye yahan grammar and meaning ke according yahan 'We might as well watch..' already sahi use kiya gaya tha.

questions.question: Juliet is [telling to] Ben to complete the work immediately.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Inform, ask and tell' inn verbs ke baad human being direct likha jata hai bina 'to' preposition ke aur 'say' verb ke sath 'to' lagana padta hai agar human being likhna ho toh. Inn reasons ki wajah se option B, C and D galat hai. A option 'is telling Ben' sahi hai.

questions.question: He [described about the scenery] yesterday.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- A and C option galat hain kyunki 'describe' transitive verb hai isliye iske or object ke beech mein preposition nahi ayegi. D isliye nahi aayega kyunki verb plural likhi hai aur waise bhi sentence ke last mein yesterday likha hai isliye past tense verb ki 2nd form ka use hoga, isliye B option 'described the scenery' sahi hai.

questions.question: The workers' union has threatened [for going to] an indefinite strike.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- kuch karne ki dhamki dene wale meaning mein 'threaten' verb ke baad infinitive lagaya jata hai isliye D option 'threatened to go on an indefinite strike' sahi hai.

questions.question: You will be in trouble if you don't [obey to my] orders.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Do/does/did' helping verb ke baad main verb humesha base form mein aati hai isliye C option galat hai. Obey transitive verb hai iske or object ke beech mein preposition nahi ayegi isliye option A and B bhi galat hai. D option 'don't obey my orders' sahi hai.

questions.question: A man in need [pleaded for help].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) No improvement
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'musibat mein pade admi ne madad ke liye gujarish ki' isliye iss meaning ke according 'pleaded for help' already sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: My friend did not understand the story. She asked me [for explain it her].
options: (d) can I explain that to her
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- kisi ko koi cheez explain karne ke liye 'explain something to somebody' structure ka use hota hai. Isliye A option 'She asked me to explain it to her' sahi hai.
Note:- D option isliye galat hai kyunki indirect speech mein interrogative structure use nahi hota. agar D option 'If I could explain it to her' hota to theek ho sakta tha.

questions.question: You can always [dependent on me].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'can' modal ke baad verb ki base form ayegi aur 'depend' ke sath 'on' preposition aati hai. 'depend on somebody' ka matlab 'kisi pe nirbhar hona, rely karna', isliye 'depend on me' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The mob [drove on the rampage] and looted several shops in the locality.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan 'Go on a rampage' use hoga kyuki ye ek fix phrase hai jiska meaning hota hai :- 'hinsak ho jana yaa hinsak behave karna, jisse nuksan yaa vinaash ho', 'go' ki 2nd form 'went' hoti hai, aur meaning ke according option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The flames of the fire [leap into] the air.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: yahan meaning ke according past indefinite tense aayega naa ki present indefinite isliye option A and B galat hain. 'V1 + ing' bina helping verb ke nahi aata isliye D option galat hai. isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option 'leapt into' sahi hai.

questions.question: On winter evenings, a haze of smog [hang in] Delhi.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation: yahan ek fact bataya jaa raha isliye present indefinite tense lagega, isliye A option galat hai. Yahan singular verb ki requirement hai, isliye D option galat hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'delhi ke upar haze of smog hota hai' iss meaning ke liye B option 'hangs over' sahi hai

questions.question: The commanders [entered by force into] terrorists' camp.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Broke into' ka matlab kisi jagah bina permission ke ghusna', 'Broke down' ka matlab 'kaam karna band kar dena', 'Broke with' ka matlab 'kisi riste yaa sambhand ko khatam karna', 'Broke off' ka matlab 'kisi cheez band karna yaa samaapt karna', sentence ke meaning ke according yahan 'broke into' phrasal verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: Pintu has been advised to [reduce] smoking by his family doctor.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- A, B and C options grammatically sahi nahi hai. Meaning and grammar ke according D option sahi hai. 'Cut down' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ke aakar, maatra yaa sankhya ko kam karna'.

questions.question: The question [was raised for discussion] before the members during the assembly session.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'came up' ka matlab 'jiske baare mein baat kari jaani hai', 'came off' ka matlab 'ghatith hona, safal hona', 'came round' ka matlab 'kisi ki salaah manana', 'came out' ka matlab 'publish hona, ujaagar hona'. Meaning ke according yahan 'came up' phrasal verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: His disease is no doubt very serious but he will [pull over].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki:- 'uski bimari serious hai lekin wo survive kar jaayega' iss meaning ke liye 'pull through' phrasal verb ka use hota hai. 'Pull through' ka matlab 'kisi khatarnak yaa kathin daur se bach nikalna'. Isliye option A sahi hoga.
Eg:- She had pneumonia but she pulled through.

questions.question: When I was your age, I was working two jobs [to provide for] my family.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No substitution
Explanation:- Verb yani action ka purpose batane ke liye yaa keh sakte hain verb se 'why' ka reply dene ke liye generally Infinitive ka use hota hai, aur 'provide for' phrasal verb ka meaning hota hai :- 'kisi ko uski jarurat ki cheez dena', isliye question mein 'to provide for' sahi use hua hai. Isliye option D 'no substitution' sahi hoga.
Note:- Infinitive and gerunds phrasal verb se bhi banaye jaate hain.

questions.question: You must [cut off] your expenses if you want to save money.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'cut out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ka bina kaam ka hissa hatana', 'cut down on' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko kam karna', 'cut for' jaisi koi phrasal verb nahi hai, 'cut up' ka matlab 'bahut buri tarah se ghaayal karna' isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'cut down on' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The walls of the temple caved [out] due to weak construction.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation: yahan meaning dena hai ki walls collapse kar gayi matlab gir gyi. Jiske liye 'cave in' phrasal verb ka use hota hai.
'cave in' ka matlab If a ceiling, roof, or other structure caves in, it breaks and falls into the space below. Isliye 'cave in' phrasal verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: Despite not getting approval from the leader, we decided to [carry out] the plan.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) No improvement
Explanation:- 'carry over' ka matlab 'baad mein kisi cheez ka upyog karna', 'carry away' ka matlab 'control khona', 'carry off' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko jabardasti hatana', 'carry out' ka matlab 'koi task perform karna', isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'carry out' aayega

questions.question: One of the baby elephants broke [off] from the herd and lost its way.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Break off' ka matlab 'relationship wagera khatam karna'. 'Break in' yeh ek noun hota hai iska matlab 'kisi building wagera mein jabardasti ghusna kuch churaane ke liye', 'Break down' ka matlab 'koi machine yaa gaadi wagera kaam karna band kar dene ke liye use hota hai', 'Break away' ka matlab 'group se alag ho jana'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option aayega.

questions.question: Please fill [away] this application form while you wait for your turn.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Fill out' ka matlab 'koi official document yaa form bharne ke liye jaankari jodna'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'fill out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Drink a mixture of wormwood oil and olive oil [to got rid of] worms.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- infinitive mein 'to + v1' ka use hota hai. isliye option A and C galat hain. Phrasal verb 'Get rid of' ka matlab 'kisi cheez se chhutkara pana yaa fek dena'. isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'to get rid of' aayega.

questions.question: When it comes to love of sports, he [takes off] his father.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Take after' ka matlab 'to resemble a relative' (dikhne mein yaa kisi quality mein apne kisi relative jaisa hona)
'Take off' ka matlab 'to remove clothes etc, to leave the ground (plane) / depart', Isliye yahan meaning ke according C option 'takes after' aayega.

questions.question: My sincerity and patience [drove me] through all odds and problems of life
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'carried someone through something' ka matlab 'kisi ki madad karna khaaskar muskil waqt mein', Isliye yahan meaning ke according A option ka use hoga.

questions.question: The affection of her husband [carried her up] in the midst of all her problems.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation: 'tore someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ko dukh pahuchana', 'bore someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ko emotional dukh sehne mein madad karna', 'stood someone up' ka matlab 'jaanboojh kar kisi se milne mein asafal hona', 'drove someone up' ka matlab 'kisi ki chidaana, gussa yaa pagal kar dena',
Isliye meaning ke according yahan 'bore her up' option B ka use hoga

questions.question: I was [carried by] her rapturous song.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans.(b)
Explanation:- 'carry off' ka matlab 'kisi tough kaam ko karne yaa haasil karne mein safal hona'
'be/get + carried away' ka matlab 'bahut excited ho jana aur emotional hoke control kho dena'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'carried away' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The Ukrainian soldiers [passed in] for several weeks.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Held out' means 'kisi khatarnaak yaa kathin paristhithi mein bane rehna'. Isliye meaning ke according C option 'held out' ka use hoga.
Note:- D option mein likhe 'hanged in' ko 'hang in' samaj ke confuse na hon.

questions.question: I [called of] an explanation for his rude behaviour.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'called out' ka matlab 'kisi emergency se nipatne yaa koi seva pradaan karne ke liye bulana', 'Call off' ka matlab 'meeting wagera cancel karna', 'Call in' ka matlab 'kisi ko bulana', 'Call into question' ka matlab 'doubtful hona'. Isliye meaning ke according A option 'call out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The NCERT [was set up ahead] by the government to assist and advise the Central and State Governments on policies and programmes for qualitative improvement in school education.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Set off' ka matlab 'koi journey start karna', 'set forth/forward' ka matlab 'kisi baat ko likhke yaa bolke usse explain karna', 'Set over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko ek person se dusre person tak transfer karna', 'Set up' ka matlab 'koi business, institution yaa organization sthaapit karna'
isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'set up' aayega.

questions.question: It is a bad habit to [talk in] while someone is speaking.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'cut in' ka matlab 'kisi ki baat ko beech mein rokkar khud bolna', 'intrude over' ka matlab 'kisi aise jagah jaana jahan aapka welcome nahi hota', 'burst in' ka matlab 'kisi jagah chillate hue enter karna', 'walk over' ka matlab 'kisi vyakti ki isthithti naa samajhakar uske sath bura vyvhar karna' Isliye meaning ke according A option 'cut in' sahi hoga..

questions.question: Vishnu and family [are looking around into] the possibility of moving to Canada.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: 'Look around' ka matlab 'kisi jagah pe jaake yeh dekhna ki wahan kya hai', 'Look into' ka matlab 'investigate karna'. 'Look upto' ka matlab 'kisi ki tareef karna, respect karna'. Isliye meaning ke according yahan C option 'are looking into' aayega.
Note: yhan continuous tense lagega naki present indefinite kyu ki ye koi habitual action nahi hai isliye B option galat hai.

questions.question: It was apparent that the girl was [heading into] a serious disaster.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'head for' ka matlab 'kisi jagah yaa situation ki taraf badhna', 'head out' ka matlab 'jagah chhodna', 'head down' ka matlab 'value kam hona'
Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'heading for' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The delegates [talked of] the matter for an hour but without any result.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Talk over' ka matlab kisi samjhote pe pahuchne ke liye matter pe discussion karna isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'talked over' use hoga.

questions.question: The organization [had set up for] a Free Mandela Committee and launched a lively campaign with the slogan 'Free Mandela'
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation: 'Set up' ka matlab 'koi business, institution yaa organization sthaapit karna', 'Set to' ka matlab 'kisi kaam ko determination se shuru karna', 'Set over' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko kisi dusri cheez ke upar rakhna yaa tikaana', 'Set upon' ka matlab 'kisi pe hamla karna'
Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'set up' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The minor project put forward by the government [is now moving around into] its third year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki project apne third year mein jaa raha hai' iss meaning ke liye A option 'is moving into' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I cannot [sit up with] this sort of insult in office.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'mai iss type ki insult bardasht nahi kar sakta' iss meaning ke liye B option 'put up with' ka use hoga. 'Put up with' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko sehen karna yaa bardaasth karna'.

questions.question: Though Mr.Swami [ran in] debt, he did not stop wasting money.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Run into' ka matlab kathinaayi kaa saamna karna, takraa jana', 'Run over' ka matlab 'kisi ko vehicle se kuchal dena', Isliye yeh meaning ke according B option 'run into' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I have been wondering [at taking] skating as a hobby
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Wonder' ke sath generally 'about' preposition aati hai. 'Take to' ka matlab 'kisi cheez yaa kisi vyakti ko pasand karna', 'Take up' ka matlab 'koi particular activity shuru karna' Isliye grammar and meaning ke according B option 'about taking up' use hoga.

questions.question: I can't [make out] my mind about taking a vacation in winter.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Make up one's mind' ka matlab 'kisi baat pe decision lena, mood bana lena', 'Make out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko understand krna', 'Make on' ka matlab 'chalu karna, yaa jalaana', Isliye yahan meaning ke according 'make up' A option aayega.

questions.question: It is quite difficult to [make on] what this doctor writes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation: 'Make out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko understand krna', 'Make on' ka matlab 'chalu karna, yaa jalaana', Isliye yahan meaning ke according 'make out' A option aayega.

questions.question: He felt dejected but the feeling [passed out] in a minute.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Pass out' ka matlab 'behosh ho jaana', 'Passed off' ka matlab If an event etc 'passed off' matlab 'wo ek special tarike se ghatith hua aur complete hua'. 'Pass back' ka matlab 'kisi ko apne hath se kuch lautaana', 'Pass on' ka matlab 'mar jaana' Isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'passed off' ka use hoga

questions.question: The strong wind [blow off] all the candles.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:-yahan meaning ke according past indefinite lagega naaki present indefinite kyunki yeh koi habitual action nahi hai isliye A and C options galat hain. D option isliye galat hai kyunki 'v1+ ing form' bina helping verb ke nahi aati. 'Blow out' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko bhujaa dena'. Isliye meaning and grammar ke according B option 'blew out' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He [got away from] punishment as there was not enough evidence against him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according yahan past indefinite tense use hoga isliye A and C option galat hai. 'Get away from' ka matlab 'kisi jagah se bhaag jaana, arrest hone se bachne ke liye', Isliye grammar and meaning ke according question me diya 'got away from' already sahi likha hai. Isliye 'no substitution' hoga

questions.question: I am trying my best to [give in] junk food.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Give in' ka matlab 'surrender hona, sehmat hona', 'Give up' ka matlab 'kuch karna band karna, surrender karna', 'Give out' ka matlab 'baatna, distribute karna', 'Give back' ka matlab 'jiski cheez usko wapas lautaana', Isliye meaning ke according yahan C option 'give up' ka use hoga.

questions.question: I cannot [put with] his rudeness any longer.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Put up with' ka matlab 'sehen karna', 'Put up' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ka nirmaan karna', 'Put away' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ko uske sahi place pe lautaana', 'Put up to' ka matlab 'kisi ko galat kaam ke liye raazi karna', Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'put up with' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He [fell over] in studies owing to his illness
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'fall behind' ka matlab 'peeche reh jaana, yaa samay pe koi kaam naa kar pana', 'Fall over' ka matlab 'kisi insaan balance khokar gir jaaye', 'Fall out' ka matlab 'kisi se behes karna yaa dosti tod dena', 'Fall for' ka matlab 'pyar karne lagna, attract hona'
Isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'fell behind' ka use hoga.

questions.question: After the old building [was pulled out], the building contractor surveyed the progress of the work.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'Pull over' ka matlab 'vehicle side mein lagwana', 'Pull up' ka matlab 'vehicle wagera rokna', 'Pull down' ka matlab 'building wagera gira dena', 'Pull out' ka matlab 'kisi vehicle yaa uske driver ka road ke kinaare se door hat jaana', Isliye meaning ke according yahan A option 'was pulled down' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Our new accountant [fall short in] my expectations.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- yahan singular verb ki requirement hai isliye A and C options galat hai. 'Fall short of' ka matlab 'expectation poori naa kar pana', Isliye grammar and meaning ke according 'falls short of' B option ka use hoga.

questions.question: His uncle advised Naveen [to Keep away from] involving himself in the controversy.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) No improvement
Explanation:- Kisi ko kuch karne ke liye advise karne ke liye 'advise somebody to do something' iss structure ka use hota hai. 'Keep away (from somebody / something)' ka matlab 'pass jaana yaa shaamil hone se bachna'

questions.question: The authorities [are looked on the matter].
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Authorities iss action ki doer hai isliye yahan active voice lagegi. isliye A and B option jo passive mein likhe wo galat hai. 'look into' ka matlab 'investigate karna' isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option ka use hoga.

questions.question: The Soldiers [carried around] the order of their commander without question.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Carry out' ka matlab 'task perform karna', 'be/ get + carried away' ka matlab 'excited ho jaana aur emotionally hokar control kho dena', isliye meaning ke according yahan B option 'carried out' aayega

questions.question: Before the main concert began, (a)/ the singer sung (b)/ a couple of old folk songs to warm up the crowd. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'sung' with 'sang'
Explanation: Sentence mein 'sung' ki jagah 'sang' aayega kyunki 'sing' verb ki form 'sing, sang, sung' hoti hai, toh 'sung' 3rd form bina helping verb ke galat hai, sentence mein pata chal raha ki past ki baat karni hai, isliye verb ki 2nd form 'sang' sahi hoga. baaki yahan 'had sung' past perfect tense bhi aata hai, kyunki past perfect tense ka use past ke do action mein comparison ke liye hota hai, jo action pehle hota hai, usse past perfect mein likhte hai, isliye yahan 'had sung' bhi aa sakta hai. lekin 'sang' v2 prefer hoga.

questions.question: The unexpected decision by the principal (a)/ was surprised (b)/ all the students and the teachers present at the event. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'was surprised' with 'surprised'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'was surprised' ki jagah 'surprised' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'unexpected decision ne surprise kiya' naa ki 'decision surprise hua', isliye isse 'was surprised' passive form mein galat hoga, 'decision ne surprise kiya' waale meaning ke liye verb ko active mein likhenge, isliye yahan 'surprised' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The entire cost of the wedding celebration (a)/ was born (b)/ by the bride's parents. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'born' with 'borne'
Explanation:- 'born' ki jagah 'borne' aayega kyunki 'born' ka matlab 'paida hona', aur 'bear' ka matlab 'kisi cheez ki jimmedari lena, sehna', jiski form 'bear, born, borne' hoti hai, sentence ka matlab hai wedding ki poori cost ki jimmedari dulhan ke parents ne li', isliye yahan 'was borne' sahi hoga. kyunki 'is/am/are/was/were' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai.
Note:- 'borne' adjective(past participle) bhi banta hai jaise 'water-borne disease' matlab wo bemaari jo 'paani se hoti hai' etc.

questions.question: The ancient texts regarded (a)/ the sun the primary source of all life (b)/ and energy on the earth. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) put 'as' after 'the sun'
Explanation:- kuch aisi verbs hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use kiya jaata hai. jaise 'define, regard, describe, treat, know etc' kyunki in verbs mein generally aisa meaning banta hai 'kisi ko kisi ke jaisa manana', isliye 'the sun' ke baad 'as' aayega. jisse matlab hoga 'ancient text mein sun ko all life ka primary source mana gaya hai'.

questions.question: After the exhausting football match, (a)/ the player laid (b)/ on the grass to recover his strength. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'laid' with 'lay'
Explanation: Sentence mein 'laid' ki jagah 'lay' aayega kyunki ek verb hoti hai 'lie' jiska matlab 'letna yaa pada hona', joki intransitive hoti hai aur iski form 'lie, lay, lain' chalti hai. dusri hoti hai 'lay' jiska matlab 'letaana yaa rakhana', joki transitive hoti hai aur iski form 'lay, laid, laid' chalti hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'exhausting match ke baad player grass pe late gaya', toh player khud leta, toh 'letne' waal matlab ke liye 'lie' verb ki 2nd form 'lay' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The speaker's emotional story managed to rouse deep sympathy among the audience, and many were seen wiping their tears as he continued.
options: (a) The speaker's emotional story managed to
(b) rouse deep sympathy among the audience,
(c) and many were seen wiping their tears
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'rouse' with 'arouse'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'rouse' ki jagah 'arouse' aayega kyunki 'rouse' ka matlab 'kisi ko gehri neend se jagana' aur 'arouse' ka matlab hota hai kisi ke andar feeling jagana jaise anger, sympathy, love etc', sentence mein 'emotional story' se pata chal raha hai 'feeling' jagaayi hai, isliye yahan 'arouse' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Despite repeated reminders from the accounting department, (a)/ the branch manager did not paid (b)/ the quarterly utility bills (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'paid' with 'pay'
Explanation:- 'paid' ki jagah 'pay' aayega kyunki 'do/does/did' ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'pay' ka use hoga.

questions.question: During the sudden inspection conducted by the health ministry, (a)/ a significant number of expired food items (b)/ was finding in the main storage facility of the restaurant. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'was finding' with 'were found'
Explanation:- Sentence mein 'was finding' ki jagah 'were found' aayega kyunki 'food items was finding' se matlab hoga 'food item dhund rahe hai', jabki meaning dena hai 'food item paaye gaye', toh sahi meaning ke liye passive mein likhna padega, isliye yahan 'were found' passive form sahi hoga. 'items' plural hai isliye 'were' plural verb aayi hai.

questions.question: Before the children left for the playground after breakfast, (a)/ their mother instructed them to lie (b)/ all their soiled clothes carefully into the laundry basket. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'to lie' with 'to lay'
Explanation:- Sentence men 'lie' ki jagah 'lay' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'unki mother ne kaha ki gande kapde laundry basket mein daalke jaayo', toh 'daalne, rakhne, letaane' wala meaning ke liye 'lay' verb ka use hota hai, aur 'lie' ka matlab 'letna' hota hai, toh meaning ke according 'to lay' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Before the passengers could board the aircraft, (a)/ they had to confirm that their luggage was correctly tagged (b)/ for the flight bounded for Paris. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'bounded for' with 'bound for'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'bounded for' ki jagah 'bound for' aayega kyunki 'bounded' ka matlab 'koi cheez chaaro taraf se ghiri hui ho', aur 'bound for' ka matlab koi vehicle wagera kisi jagah ki taraf travel kar raha hai', sentence ka matlab hai 'flight paris jaa rahi hai matlab paris ke liye bound hai', isliye yahan 'bound for' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Despite the initial objections from several members of the board, (a)/ they eventually decided to consider her as (b)/ the primary candidate for the prestigious fellowship. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'as'
Explanation:-Kuch verb jaise 'make, choose, elect, select, anoint, appoint, consider etc' yeh aise verb hoti hai jinke baad 'as' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'as' ka use comparison ke liye hota hai, lekin inn verbs se ek hi person ke baare mein kuch bataya jaata hai, jiska structure 'verb + object(person) + object complement', waise he sentence mein 'consider' verb hai 'her' object hai aur 'the primary candidate' object complement. Isliye yahan 'as' ka use nahi hoga.
Note:- agar yeh verb 'passive voice' mein use ho toh 'as' laga bhi sakte hai aur nahi bhi.

questions.question: While the scientists were performing the delicate experiment, (a)/ they clearly felt (b)/ a distinct ringing sound coming from the high-frequency magnetron placed nearby. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'felt' with 'heard'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'felt' ki jagah 'heard' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'ringing sound ki awaaz aa rahi hai high frequency magnetron se' likha hai, toh koi bhi 'sound, awaaz' wagera sunai degi naa ki 'feel' hogi, isliye yahan 'heard' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: During the quarterly financial review, the CEO warned that (a)/ their biggest competitor would take over (b)/ them in terms of global market share by the end of the year. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'take over' with 'over take'
Explanation:- 'take over' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi cheez pe control paa lena' eg. 'the military take over of the government' aur 'over take' ka matlab hota hai kisi dusre vyakti, vehicle ko peche chhod dena kyunki aap fast chal rahe ho', sentence ka matlab hai jo unka biggest competitor hai global markets ke terms mein iss saal aage nikal jaayega', toh 'aage nikal jaane' waale meaning ke liye 'over take' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The ostensibly transparent mechanism (a)/ for employee feedback (b)/ paradoxically obfuscating (c)/ all channels of genuine expression. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'obfuscating' with 'obfuscates/ is obfuscating'
Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai dikhaawe ka transparent mechanism hai employee feedback ko bharne ka yeh paradoxically rokta hai saare genuine expression ke channels ko', sentence mein action 'obfuscating' se aa raha hai, matlab yehi verb hai aur 'ing' form bina helping verb ke nahi aati, toh agar meaning dena hai 'rukawat paida karta hai', toh yahan isse present indefinite 'obfuscates' likhenge, verb singular aayegi kyunki 'mechanism' subject hai. aur 'rukaawat paida kar raha hai' continuity wala meaning chahiye toh 'is obfuscating' present continuous ka use hoga.

questions.question: Had he been knowing (a)/ about the regulatory changes (b)/ he would not have proceeded (c)/ with the merger deal. (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'been knowing' with 'known'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'been knowing' ki jagah 'known' aayega kyunki 'know' ek stative verb hoti hai matlab jiske 'ing' form nahi hoti. Agar tense 'continuous' hota hai 'indefinite' ki taraf chale jaate hai aur 'perfect continuous' hota hai toh 'perfect' ki taraf chale jaate hai, isliye yahan 'been knowing' ki jagah pe 'known' karna padega.
Note:-yeh conditional chapter ka structure hai 'if he had known = had he known'

questions.question: He made a quick shower before heading to the office.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) replace 'made' with 'took'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'made' ki jagah 'took' aayega jaise koi joke sunaaye toh 'tell' nahi balki 'crack a joke' bolte hai. jaise 'kisi ne galti kari' toh 'did a mistake' nahi 'made a mistake' bolte hai, waise he sentence ka matlab hai usne shower liya', toh iss meaning ke 'he took a shower' bolenge. Yeh phrase reading se ayenge.

questions.question: The teacher advised to listen attentively.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'to listen' with 'listening'
Explanation: 'advised' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai jiska structure 'advise somebody to do something' hota hai, toh yahan 'advised' ke baad object aaye jaise 'us, student etc' likh sakte hai, lekin 'advised' aur 'to listen' dono alag part mein hai, toh yeh pata nahi chal raha ki error kahan mark kare, isliye yeh nahi ho paayega. Lekin ek tarika aur hai ki 'advise' verb ke baad direct 'gerund' likhde 'advised listening attentively', toh direct baad gerund likhna bhi sahi hota hai. yeh dono structure sahi hote hai.

questions.question: She does not know to swim.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'know to swim' with 'know how to swim'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'know to swim' ki jagah 'know how to swim' aayega kyunki jab 'know, learn, practice etc' verb ke baad agar action likha ho toh inn verb aur action ke beech mein adverb ka use hota hai sahi meaning convey karne ke liye ki wo action kaise kiya jata hai, sentence ka sahi matlab hoga 'wo nahi jaanti ki swim kaise karte hai', isliye yahan 'she does not know how to swim' sahi hoga. eg. 'he does not know how/when to talk, he does not know what to say'.

questions.question: The children swinged happily (a)/ on the old tire hung from the tree (b)/ and laughed loudly (c)/ as the sun set in the evening.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'swinged' with 'swung'
Explanation:- 'swing' verb hoti hai jiski form 'swing, swung, swung' hoti hai, past ka sentence hai isliye 'swing' ki 2nd form 'swung' aayegi.

questions.question: The magistrate asked the accused what was he doing with his hand in the gentleman's pocket.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'was he' with 'he was'
Explanation:-Yeh sentence indirect speech mein likha hai aur indirect mein assertive mein likha hota hai jisme 'verb' subject ke baad aati hai, 'verb' subject se pehle interrogative, inversion sentence mein aati hai, lekin yeh interrogative nahi hai, isliye yahan 'he was' subject ke baad verb aayegi.

questions.question: The heavy rainfall and sudden drop in temperature (a)/ could effect not only (b)/ the crop yields but also the transportation of goods. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'effect' with 'affect'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'effect' ki jagah 'affect' aayega kyunki 'affect' verb hoti hai aur 'effect' noun hota hai, sentence mein 'could' ke baad verb ki base form ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'affect' verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: While I was preparing for my presentation in the library, (a)/ I suddenly listened to (b)/ a loud, unexpected crash from the upper floor. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'listened to' with 'heard'
Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai jab wo library mein presentation bana rahi thi, tabhi achanak upper floor se tez crash hone ki awaz sunai di, agar aap 'intentionally' sunte ho toh 'listen' ka use hota hai, lekin 'kuch sunai de jaaye' toh 'hear' ka use hota hai, matlab se pata chal raha ki 'awaaz sunai di', matlab intentionally nahi suni, isliye yahan 'heard' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The students who were prepared (a)/ the presentation on sustainable energy (b)/ were praised by the principal during the assembly. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'were' before 'prepared'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'the students who were prepared' se matlab hoga students jinhe prepare kiya gaya tha', lekin sentence ka matlab dena hai 'students jinhone prepare kari thi presentation', toh 'students' prepare karne ke doer hai, isliye 'were prepared' passive mein nahi balki 'prepared' active mein likhenge, jisse sahi matlab aayega, isliye yahan 'prepared' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Before the guests arrived for the evening party, (a)/ the homeowner carefully hanged (b)/ all the new curtains in the drawing room. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'hanged' with 'hung'
Explanation:- 'hanged' ki jagah 'hung' aayega kyunki jab matlab 'latkaane' wala dena hota hai, toh 'hang, hung, hung' form chalti hai aur jab 'faansi pe latkaane' wala meaning chahiye, toh 'hang, hanged, hanged' form chalti hai, sentence mein 'curtains' latkaane ki baat karni hai, isliye yahan 'hung' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi.

questions.question: While the tourist was walking through the dense jungle, (a)/ he suddenly wandered (b)/ how he would find his way back to the camp before sunset. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'wandered' with 'wondered'
Explanation:- 'wandered' ki jagah 'wondered' aayega kyunki 'wander' ka matlab 'idhar udhar ghumna' aur 'wonder' ka matlab 'sochna, kuch jaanna chahna', sentence ka matlab hai 'tourist jab ghane jungle se jaa rahe the, tabhi usne socha ki wapas camp jaane ke liye raasta kaise find karenge', toh sentence mein 'sochne' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'wondered' verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: The reporter had to ask several probing questions (a)/ in order to illicit (b)/ a confession from the corrupt official about his hidden assets. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'illicit' with 'elicit'
Explanation:- 'illicit' ki jagah 'elicit' aayega kyunki 'elicit' ka matlab 'kisi se koi information nikalwaana' aur 'illicit' ka matlab 'illegal', sentence ka matlab hai 'reporter ne bahut question kare usse confession ugalwaane ke liye', toh 'information nikalwaane' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'elicit' sahi hoga.

questions.question: When the temperature dropped suddenly, the water (a)/ got freeze inside the pipes and (b)/ caused them to burst, which (c)/ resulted in heavy damage to the building.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'freeze' with 'frozen'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'got' linking verb hai aur linking verb ke baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, 'freeze' toh verb hoti hai, isliye yahan iski third form 'frozen' past participle ke roop mein adjective kaa kaam karegi, isliye yahan 'got frozen' sahi hoga.
Eg. he got tired, he got injured'.

questions.question: The traffic signal on the main highway intersection (a)/ suddenly malfunctioned last evening, and several collisions were occurred (b)/ within a span of just fifteen minutes. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) remove 'were' before 'occurred'
Explanation:- 'occurred' se pehle 'were' nahi aayega kyunki 'occur' apne aap mein happening verb hoti hai jiska matlab hee hota hai 'hona', isliye isse passive mein use nahi karte, isliye yahan simple past tense 'occurred' ka use hoga.

questions.question: During the sudden thunderstorm, the villagers fleed to higher ground to avoid the rapidly rising water and waited anxiously until the rain stopped.
options: (c) to avoid the rapidly rising water
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'fleed' with 'fled'
Explanation:- 'flee' verb hoti hai jiski form chalti hai 'flee, fled, fled', sentence mein past ki baat karni hai, isliye yahan verb ki 2nd form 'fled' sahi hoga. 'fleed' jaise koi word nahi hota.

questions.question: I trust him a lot because he (a)/ has always and will (b)/ support me in future too(c)/. No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'has always and will' with 'has always supported and will support'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'and' conjunction se 'has' aur 'will' helping verb ko joda hai, do helping verb ke liye ek main verb se kaam chal sakta hai, lekin 'has' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai aur 'will' ke baad base form, isliye yahan 'has' ke sath verb ki 3rd form 'supported' ka use karna padega, isliye 'has always supported and will support' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The captain carefully examined (a)/ the sunk ship (b)/ at the bottom of the bay, hoping to recover some valuables. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'sunk' with 'sunken'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'ship' subject hai aur isse pehle adjective ki jarurat hai, lekin 'sunk' toh verb hoti hai, 'sink' verb ki form 'sink, sank, sunk' hoti hai aur adjective past participle 'sunken' hota hai, isliye yahan 'sunken ship' sahi hoga.

questions.question: During the storm, the river overflew (a)/ its banks and flooded (b)/ several nearby villages, causing extensive damage. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) replace 'overflew' with 'overflowed'
Explanation:- 'overflow' verb hoti hai jiski form 'overflow, overflowed, overflowed' hoti hai, kyunki sentence mein past ke action ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'overflowed' verb ki 2nd form sahi hogi. 'overflew' word he galat hai.

questions.question: She asked to him (a)/ to explain the procedure clearly (b)/ before starting the experiment. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) remove 'to' after 'asked'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'asked' ke baad 'to' nahi aayega kyunki 'asked' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai jisme indirect object 'him' hai aur direct object 'to explain' hai. toh 'ask, advice, order' yeh di-transitive verb ke baad agar human being likhte ho toh indirect object ke sath preposition ka use nahi hota, isliye yahan 'asked him to explain' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The mechanic warned the driver that the front right wheel of the truck was [very lose] and needed immediate tightening to prevent an accident.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'lose' ek verb hoti hai jiski form 'lose, lost, lost' hoti hai, lekin sentence mein 'was' linking verb hai aur inke sath subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, 'loose' adjective hota hai jiska matlab 'dheela' hota hai, toh sentence ke meaning aur grammar ke according 'very loose' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The lionesses, after a long and exhausting chase across the savanna, usually [prey] on the slowest member of the herd to conserve their energy.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'pray' ka matlab 'prathna karna, prayer karna', aur 'prey' ka matlab 'sikaar', 'praise' ka matlab 'tareef karna', sentence mein 'lionesses' plural noun hai jiske liye plural verb aayegi, 'prey' plural verb hai aur 'preys' singular. Isliye yahan 'no substitution' hoga.

questions.question: The main speech of the political leader at the massive rally [were telecasted] live on all major news channels last night.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:-Kuch verb jaise 'wed, cost, set, bet, bid, thrust, telecast, forecast, overcast, broadcast etc.' yeh kuch aise verb hai jinki 'v1,v2, v3' form same hoti hai, isliye yahan 'telecast' aayega aur 'main speech' singular subject hai, isliye yahan singular verb 'was telecast' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Dr. Harris welcomed the members of the committee and went on _______ the subject of the meeting.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:-sentence ke meaning ke according 'to introduce' sahi hoga jisse sentence ka matlab hoga 'Dr. Harris ne committee members ka welcome kiya aur meeting ke subject ko introduce kiya', isliye yahan 'to introduce' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The chief guest stepped onto the stage and began [waiving] vigorously to the huge crowd gathered at the convention center.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'waive' verb hoti hai jiska matlab 'chhod dena, tyag dena' hota hai. Aur 'wave' ka matlab 'haath hilana', sentence mein 'haath hilaane' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'waving' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The intern should [take a right choice] in choosing the right job for her.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:-Jaise 'bathing' ke 'made a shower' nahi 'took a shower' bolte hai, joke sunane ko 'tell a joke' nahi 'crack a joke' bolte hai waise he sahi decision lene ke liye 'make a right choice' phrase ka use karte hai, yeh kuch fix phrase hai jo reading se hee ayenge.

questions.question: The teacher [described about the historical events] of the revolution in detail during the lecture.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'describe' ek transitive verb hoti hai jiske baad verb ko object chahiye hota hai, agar preposition likh denge toh wo object preposition ka object ban jaayega, isliye yahan 'described the historical events' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The businessman [is owning] multiple companies across Asia, and he [is believing] that his investments will continue to grow despite the market fluctuations.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'own, believe, think, consider, possess, look, seem, appear, consist, contain, comprise, feel, smell, taste etc' yeh stative verbs hoti hai inki 'ing' form nahi hoti, sentence mein kahi gayi baat ek fact ke tarah hai jaise 'businessman ke pass multiple companies hai, aur wo manta hai uski investment humesha badhegi', isliye inhe present indefinite mein likhenge, isliye 'owns, believes' option (a) sahi hoga.

questions.question: It is the responsibility of all of us to invest time and effort in verifying information and [not follow victim] to fake news.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'fall victim to something' yeh ek phrase hota hai jiska matlab hota hai 'sikaar ban jana', sentence ka matlab hai 'information verify karein aur sikaar naa ban jaaye fake news ka', toh sentence ke meaning ke accoding 'not fall victim' option D sahi hoga. yeh kuch phrases hote hai jo reading se hee ayenge.

questions.question: The art history teacher was sacked after [she were thought] taking school supplies.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation: Sentence ke meaning ke according 'teachers ko job se nikal diya gaya kyunki wo school supplies ko chori karti pakdi gayi'. Iss meaning ke liye C option 'she was caught' aayega.

questions.question: Despite her busy schedule, she _______ to complete all the household chores and _______ for the cleaning service to come in the following week.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'insure' ka matlab 'insurance', sentence mein insurance jaise koi baat nahi karni, isliye option A aur B galat honge, sentence mein 'she' subject ke baad 'verb' chahiye aur verb ke baad 'to complete' infinitive likha hai, aur next 'dash' mein bhi infinitive aayega kyunki 'and' conjunction se do infinitive ko jod rahe hai, agar 'and' conjunction se do infinitive jodte hai, toh baad wala infinitive bare form mein aata hai. Khud kuch kaam kare toh 'arrange' ka use karte hai, lekin jab yeh kehna ki yeh 'arrange kara dunga' toh 'arrange for' phrasal verb ka use hota hai, sentence mein likha ki 'cleaning service aayegi agle hafte', matlab usse 'arrange karwa di', isliye 2nd dash mein 'arrange' aayega, isliye 'managed, arrange' sahi hoga. Sentence ka matlab hoga 'usne ghar ke saare kaam poore kar diya, aur agle hafte ke liye arrange kar diya'.

questions.question: You _______ take a break if you feel tired; working continuously is harmful to your health.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:-Option C galat hoga kyunki 'have' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aayegi. Option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'need' jab main verb hota hai, toh iske baad infinitive aata hai, 'you need to take' hota. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'might' se meaning aayega 'tum le sakte hai', lekin sentence mein 'chahiye' wala meaning chahiye, sentence ka matlab hoga agar tum tired feel kar rahe ho toh tumhe break lena chahiye', toh 'chahiye' waale meaning ke liye 'ought to' option A sahi hoga.
Note:- ought to waise toh moral cheezon ke liye use hota hai, lekin 'chahiye' waale meaning ke liye bhi use hota hai.

questions.question: He realized that his reckless driving (a)/ should have been (b)/ the cause of that serious accident. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'should have been' with 'could have been'
Explanation:-Model verb ke error jyadatar meaning based hote hai. Sentence mein 'reckless driving should have been' se matlab hoga 'reckless driving kaaran hona chahiye tha', toh 'chahiye' wala meaning galat hai, sentence ka matlab hona chahiye 'reckless driving kaaran ho sakti thi serious accident ka', toh 'ho sakti thi' waale meaning ke liye 'could have been' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Even if the heavy fog continues all through the night, (a)/ the rescue team will ready (b)/ to begin the search operation early in the morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'will ready' with 'will be ready'
Explanation:- 'will' model hai 'ready' adjective hai, 'ready' verb bhi hota jab iska maltab kisi aur ko taiyaar karna hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'prepared (taiyar rehne)' wala meaning chahiye, toh 'will' model ke baad 'be' linking verb ka use hoga jisse 'ready' subject complement banega 'be' linking verb ke liye, isliye yahan 'will be ready' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She said that she can finish (a)/ the project before the deadline (b)/ if she got enough support from her team. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (a) replace 'can' with 'could'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'said' aur 'got' se pata chal raha ki sentence past mein hai, isliye 'can' verb ki past form 'could' likhna padega.

questions.question: After we receive the advanced payment for the consignment, (a)/ the client need not to worry (b)/ about any further financial formalities until the final delivery. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'need not to worry' with 'need not worry'
Explanation:- 'need, dare' ke baad agar 'not' laga hota hai, toh 'need, dare' model ban jaate hai, aur model ke baad verb ki base form ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye yahan 'to worry' infinitive nahi 'worry' verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: This retired couple has now become (a)/ used to walk (b)/ ten kilometers every morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'to walk' with 'to walking'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'couple' subject hai, 'has' helping verb hai 'become' 3rd form main verb (linking verb) hai, aur 'used' adjective hai subject complement hai linking verb ke liye, 'to' preposition hai aur preposition ke baad preposition ke object chahiye hota hai, lekin 'walk' toh verb hoti hai, isliye isse 'walking' gerund mein change karna padega jisse yeh object banega 'to' preposition ka, isliye yahan 'to walking' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I will inform you immediately should (a)/ he arrives late for the meeting (b)/ tomorrow morning. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'arrives' with 'arrive'
Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai mein tumhe haal inform kar dunga agar wo kal subah meeting mein late aaya', yahan 'should' mein koi dikkat nahi hai kyunki 'should' ko kind of conjunction jaisa bhi use mein le lete hai condition baatane ke liye, isliye yahan 'should' galat nahi hai, balki 'arrives' ke jagah 'arrive' aayega kyunki 'model' ke baad verb ki base form aati hai. Eg. 'should you need any help = if you need any help'.

questions.question: During my college days in Bangalore, (a)/ I used to woke up (b)/ very early to catch the first bus to the university campus every single morning. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'woke up' with 'wake up'
Explanation:-Sentence mein past ki habit ki baat ho rahi hai, aur past ke habit ke liye 'used to' model ka use hota hai, toh yahan 'used to' model hai aur model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'woke up' past tense nahi balki 'wake up' base form mein use hoga.

questions.question: Even with all the evidence against Roshan, (a)/ no one dare believe (b)/ that he could commit such a heinous crime. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'dare believe' with 'dares to believe'
Explanation:-Sentence mein 'no one' singular subject hai aur 'dare' main verb hai aur iske baad ek aur verb 'believe' galat hai, aur jab 'dare' main verb hota hai toh iske baad infinitive aata hai, isliye yahan 'to believe' hoga, aur singular subject ke according singular verb 'dares' ka use hoga, isliye 'dares to believe' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Whenever the weather changes suddenly, (a)/ the old gardener uses to complain (b)/ about severe pain in his knee joints. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'use to complain' with 'complains'

Explanation:- Sentence mein do clause 'semi colon(;) + conjunctive adverb + comma(,)' se jude ho, toh isse bhi 'compound sentence' kehte hai. conjunctive adverb 'nevertheless, however, accordingly, furthermore, consequently etc.'

questions.question: The dog barked loudly at the stranger.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Correct answer is 'Simple'
Explanation:- Ek clause ke sentence ko 'simple sentence' kehte hai.

questions.question: She washed the dishes, and he cleaned the table.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'Compound'
Explanation: Sentence mein do clause FANBOYS waali conjunction 'and' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'compound sentence' hoga.

questions.question: Because the movie was interesting, we stayed until the end.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Correct answer is 'Complex'
Explanation:- Sentence mein do clause subordinate waali conjunction 'because' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'complex sentence' hoga.

questions.question: The students clapped loudly after the speech, and the teacher smiled proudly because they had shown good manners.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'Compound-Complex'
Explanation:- Sentence mein teen clause hai jo ek coordinate conjunction 'and' aur ek subordinate conjunction 'because' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'compound-complex' sentence hoga.

questions.question: The cat slept peacefully under the warm sunlight.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Correct answer is 'Simple'
Explanation:- Ek clause ke sentence ko 'simple sentence' kehte hai.

questions.question: She is an excellent singer; moreover, she plays the piano beautifully.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'Compound'
Explanation:- Sentence mein do clause 'semi colon(;) + conjunctive adverb + comma(,)' se jude ho, toh isse bhi 'compound sentence' kehte hai. conjunctive adverb 'moreover, however, accordingly, furthermore, consequently etc.'

questions.question: She didn't join the trip because she had an important exam.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Correct answer is 'Complex'
Explanation: Sentence mein do clause subordinate waali conjunction 'because' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'complex sentence' hoga.

questions.question: He finished his homework quickly, and then he went to play football because his friends were waiting for him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'Compound-Complex'
Explanation: Sentence mein teen clause hai jo ek coordinate conjunction 'and' aur ek subordinate conjunction 'because' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'compound-complex' sentence hoga.

questions.question: The flowers in the garden are blooming beautifully.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Correct answer is 'Simple'
Explanation:- Ek clause ke sentence ko 'simple sentence' kehte hai.

questions.question: She wanted to buy a dress, but the shop was closed.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Correct answer is 'Compound'
Explanation: Sentence mein do clause FANBOYS waali conjunction 'but' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'compound sentence' hoga.

questions.question: If you work hard, you will achieve success, and people will admire your dedication.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) Correct answer is 'Compound-Complex'
Explanation:- Sentence mein teen clause hai jo ek coordinate conjunction 'and' aur ek subordinate conjunction 'if' se jude hai, isliye yeh 'compound-complex' sentence hoga.

questions.question: The ancient manuscript was so fragile that the historian handled it with _______ care.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) utmost
Explanation: 'Utmost' ka matlab hota hai atyadhik ya sabse zyada. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki manuscript bahut fragile (bahut nazuk) thi, isliye historian ne use bahut hi zyada saavdhani se handle kiya. Isliye option (a) 'utmost' correct hoga.

questions.question: The abstruse philosophical treatise delved _______ the very essence of existentialism.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) into
Explanation: "delve into" ek fixed preposition hai jiska matlab hota hai gehraai se kisi cheez ko explore karna / investigate karna. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki "abstruse philosophical treatise" (yaani ek mushkil philosophical kitab) existentialism ke core ya essence ko deeply explore kar rahi thi. Isliye option (a) 'into' correct hoga.

questions.question: Despite initial optimism, the second attempt at the experiment was _______ successful than the first.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) less
Explanation: 'Less' actually 'little' ka comparative form hota hai, aur yahan iska use second attempt ki success ko first attempt se compare karne ke liye kiya gaya hai. Sentence clearly dikhata hai ki second attempt me success ka level pehle se kam tha (reduced level). Isliye option (b) 'less' correct hoga.

questions.question: You can either submit your research paper today _______ by the end of the week.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) or
Explanation: 'Either...or' ek fixed conjunction pair hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'or' correct hoga.

questions.question: The venerable professor, _______ lectures always captivated his students, announced his retirement.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) whose
Explanation: 'Whose' ek relative adjective hai jo kisi person ya cheez ke liye possession (yaani "kiska") dikhata hai. Is sentence me "lectures" professor ke hain (professor ke lectures). Isliye option (c) 'whose' correct hoga.

questions.question: The incessant debate began to _______ the enthusiasm of even the most dedicated participants.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) enervate
Explanation: 'Enervate' ka matlab hota hai kisi ki energy ya strength ko kam kar dena, ya use weak/thaka hua feel karana. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki lagataar chal rahi debate ne even sabse dedicated participants ka enthusiasm bhi dheere-dheere kam kar diya. Isliye option (c) 'enervate' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: bolster → support dena / strong banana | invigorate → energy dena / fresh aur active feel karana | dislodge → jagah se hata dena / hila dena

questions.question: So intricate _______ the machinery that even experts took hours to assemble it.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) was
Explanation: Yeh sentence inversion (emphasis ke liye) ka example hai, jahan verb subject se pehle aati hai. Subject "machinery" ek singular (uncountable noun) hai, isliye iske saath singular verb 'was' use hoga.

questions.question: His explanation was _______ than confusing; it was a tangled mess of ideas.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) more
Explanation: Yahaan word 'more' ka use emphasis dene ke liye hua hai ki explanation sirf confusing hi nahi, balki usse bhi zyada messy, aur unclear thi. Matlab ideas itne uljhe hue the ki properly samajh nahi aa rahe the. Isliye option (b) 'more' correct hoga.

questions.question: The leader's speech, meant to inspire unity, instead managed to _______ further division among the already fractured factions.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) foment
Explanation: "foment" ka matlab hota hai bhadkana ya badhava dena, especially negative cheezon ko (jaise conflict ya division). Sentence me leader ka speech unity (ekta) lane ke liye tha, lekin usne ulta aur zyada division create kar diya. Isliye option (b) 'foment' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: assuage → kam karna | mitigate → reduce karna | appease → shaant karna / satisfy karna

questions.question: Hardly ever _______ the opportunity to witness such a rare celestial event.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) do we have
Explanation: "Hardly ever" ek negative adverbial phrase hai. Jab sentence ki shuruaat aise negative words se hoti hai (jaise hardly, rarely, scarcely, seldom, never), tab inversion lagta hai, yani auxiliary verb subject se pehle aata hai. Isliye option (b) 'do we have' correct hoga.

questions.question: The detective's unwavering commitment to justice often led him to pursue cases with unbridled _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) zealotry
Explanation: 'Zealotry' ka matlab hota hai bahut zyada bhakti ya extreme devotion/junoon.
