Is sentence me yeh bataya gaya hai ki justice ke liye detective ki unwavering commitment usse aksar cases ko unbridled zealotry (bina control ke junoon) ke saath pursue karne ke liye motivate karti thi. Isliye option (c) 'zealotry' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: zealot → andhi bhakti wala aadmi / over-extreme supporter | zealous → bahut hi enthusiastic / josh se bhara hua | zealand → ek place ka naam hai

questions.question: The constant dripping of water began to _______ the stone, eroding it slowly over centuries.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) abrade
Explanation: "Abrade" ka matlab hota hai ghisna ya friction (gharsan) ke through surface ko dheere-dheere rub karke khatam karna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki pani ke lagataar tapakne (dripping) se patthar ghisne laga aur sadiyon tak dheere-dheere uska erosion hota raha. Isliye option (c) 'abrade' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: strengthen → majboot banana | solidify → jamna/sakht banana | dilute → patla karna (liquid ke liye use hota hai, stone ke liye nahi).

questions.question: Although the expedition was fraught with peril, they encountered _______ challenges than anticipated.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) fewer
Explanation: 'Fewer' ek comparative degree hai jiska use plural countable nouns ke saath kiya jata hai. Yahan sentence me 'challenges' ek plural countable noun hai (kyunki ise count kiya ja sakta hai). Isliye option (a) 'fewer' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: "Less" uncountable nouns ke liye use hota hai. "Much" bhi uncountable ke liye use hota hai. "Many" countable ke liye use hota hai, lekin sentence me comparison hai ("than anticipated"), isliye comparative form 'fewer' use hoga.

questions.question: The new software promised to streamline operations; _______, initial implementation proved unexpectedly complex.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) however
Explanation: 'However' ek adverb hai jiska use kisi aise statement ko introduce karne ke liye hota hai jo pehle kahi gayi baat ke vipreet ya contradictory (opposite) ho. Is sentence me pehle bataya gaya hai ki software operations ko streamline (easy aur smooth) karega, lekin baad me likha hai ki uska initial implementation unexpectedly complex nikla. Yani dono parts ke beech clear contrast hai - expectation kuch aur thi, reality kuch aur nikli. Isliye option (c) 'however' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: therefore → result dikhata hai (isliye) | moreover → extra/additional point add karta hai | consequently → result dikhata hai (natija)

questions.question: If not for the early warning system, the city would have _______ significant damage from the tsunami.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) sustained
Explanation: 'Sustained' ka matlab hota hai kisi damage, injury ya loss ko jhelna / suffer karna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki agar early warning system nahi hota, toh city ko tsunami se kaafi nuksaan hota. Isliye option (a) 'sustained' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Avoided → bach jana/taal dena | Prevented → rok dena | Circumvented → chal se bach nikalna / bypass karna

questions.question: The constant criticism from his peers _______ him to rethink his approach.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) motivates
Explanation: Is sentence me "the constant criticism" ek singular subject hai, isliye iske saath singular verb 'motivates' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The diplomat was adept _______ negotiating complex international treaties.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) at
Explanation: "adept at" ek fixed preposition hai, jiska matlab hota hai kisi kaam me bahut skilled ya expert hona. Sentence me "negotiating complex international treaties" ek skill ko show karta hai, isliye option (a) 'at' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate verb to make the sentence grammatically and contextually correct.
By the time the rescue team _______ at the site, most of the villagers had already been evacuated to safer ground.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) arrived
Explanation: Jab past me do actions hote hain, to jo pehla action hota hai usko Past Perfect (had + V3) me likhte hain, aur jo dusra action hota hai usko Simple Past (V2) me likhte hain. Is sentence me 'evacuation' (villagers ka safe jagah par le jana) pehla action hai, jabki 'arrival' (rescue team ka aana) dusra action hai. Isliye option (d) 'arrived' correct hoga.

questions.question: The committee reviewed all the proposals, none of _______ met the required criteria.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) which
Explanation: "Which" ek relative pronoun hai jiska use non-restrictive clause ko introduce karne ke liye hota hai. Ye things ya animals ko refer karta hai. Is sentence me "which", "proposals" ko refer kar raha hai. Isliye option (b) 'which' correct hoga.

questions.question: Hardly _______ the team completed the report when the boss called them for a presentation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) had
Explanation: Agar koi sentence negative word se start hota hai jaise hardly / barely / scarcely / rarely / no sooner / not only / never / little, to usme inversion lagta hai. 'Correct structure: Negative word + Helping verb + Subject + Main verb'. Yeh sentence do past actions ko dikhata hai jisme ek action dusre se pehle complete hota hai. Isliye yahan Past Perfect (had + V3) use hoga. Isliye option (c) 'had' correct hoga.

questions.question: The scientist's conclusions were entirely _______ to the data presented in the report.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Contradictory
Explanation: "Contradictory" ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ke opposite ya uske against hona. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki scientist ke conclusions report ke data se match nahi kar rahe the, balki uske against ja rahe the. Isliye option (a) 'contradictory' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: conducive → helpful / favourable | conforming → follow karna / rules ya standards ke according hona | correspondent → related / aligned

questions.question: No sooner had the curtain fallen _______ the audience erupted into applause.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) than
Explanation: "No sooner...than" ek fixed pair (correlative conjunction) hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'than' correct hoga.

questions.question: _______ having been warned about the risks, she proceeded with the experimental procedure.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) In spite of
Explanation: "In spite of" ek prepositional phrase hai jiska meaning hota hai 'despite' / 'regardless of'. Yeh tab use hota hai jab do situations ke beech contrast ho. Is sentence me warning milne ke baad bhi aage badhna ek opposite situation dikhata hai. Isliye option (a) 'In spite of' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Due to → reason batata hai (because of). As / Since → yeh conjunctions hain, inke baad subject + verb aata hai.

questions.question: The committee recommended that the new policy _______ implemented immediately.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) be
Explanation: Sentence me "recommended that" use hua hai. Jab bhi aise verbs aate hain jaise recommend, suggest, demand, insist, tab hum subjunctive mood use karte hain. Subjunctive mood me verb ka base form (V1) use hota hai - chahe subject singular ho ya plural. Isliye option (c) 'be' correct hoga.

questions.question: The new manager promised to _______ the old and inefficient procedures.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) do away with
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'do away with' ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez se chhutkaara paana / usse hata dena. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki new manager ne purani, inefficient procedures se chhutkaara paane aur unhe zyada modern methods se replace karne ka promise kiya. Isliye option (d) 'do away with' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: do up → renovate ya decorate karna | do without → kisi cheez ke bina kaam chalana | do for → destroy kar dena / nuksaan pahunchana

questions.question: The party leader appealed to the electorate to consider the long-term implications _______ the proposed reforms.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) of
Explanation: 'Of' ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez se sambandhit (related to). Iss sentence me proposed reforms se sambandhit implications ki baat ki gayi hai. Isliye option (b) 'of' correct hoga.

questions.question: The new policy proved to be entirely _______ to the needs of the working class, exacerbating existing inequalities.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) detrimental
Explanation: 'Entirely' ek adverb hai jo uske baad aane wale adjective ko qualify karta hai. 'Detrimental' ek adjective hai aur iske saath preposition 'to' ka use hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'detrimental' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: harm → nuksaan, damage | hazard → khatra, risk ya danger | detrimental → nuksaan pahunchane wala, harmful | detriment → haani, nuksaan

questions.question: Not until the results were officially announced _______ the students celebrate.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) did they
Explanation: "Not until..." ek negative expression hai aur jab sentence negative expression se start hota hai, tab inversion lagta hai (yaani auxiliary verb 'did' subject 'they' se pehle aayega). Isliye option (b) 'did they' correct hoga.

questions.question: The scientist, _______ discovery changed the course of modern medicine, was awarded the Nobel Prize.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) whose
Explanation: "Whose" ek possessive pronoun hai, jo scientist ki discovery (khoj) ko dikhata hai. Yahan possession (kiski discovery?) batani hai, isliye 'whose' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The committee reached a _______ decision after hours of intense discussion.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) well-thought-out
Explanation: Sentence me hume ek aisa adjective chahiye jo "decision" ko describe kare. "well-thought-out" ka matlab hota hai achhi tarah se soch-samajh kar liya gaya (carefully planned or considered) decision. Isliye option (c) 'well-thought-out' correct hoga.

questions.question: The proposal, _______ was initially dismissed, later gained widespread approval.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) which
Explanation: Relative pronoun 'which' ka use non-living things (jaise proposal) ke liye hota hai. Aur comma (,) laga hua hai iska matlab non-defining relative clause hai. Is type ke clause me 'that' use nahi hota, sirf 'which' use hota hai.

questions.question: Had he arrived on time, he _______ the beginning of the presentation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) would have caught
Explanation: Yeh sentence Third conditional ka example hai aur "had + V3... would/could/might + have + V3" iska correct structure hota hai. Isliye option (b) 'would have caught' correct hoga.

questions.question: Despite ample resources being allocated, bureaucratic inefficiencies continued to _______ the project's progress.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) impede
Explanation: 'Impede' ka matlab hota hai kisi kaam ki progress me rukawat dalna ya usse slow kar dena. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki ample resources hone ke bawajood bureaucratic inefficiencies project ki progress me badha dal rahi thi. Isliye option (d) 'impede' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: accelerate → tez karna | catalyse → process ko fast/start karna | facilitate → asaan banana

questions.question: The health of an ecosystem is directly proportional _______ the diversity of species it supports.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) to
Explanation: 'proportional to' ek fixed preposition hota hai jo batata hai ki ek cheez badhegi to dusri bhi uske saath badhegi. Isliye option (c) 'to' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
After hours of discussion, they finally _______ a reasonable solution.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) came up with
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'came up with' ka matlab hota hai koi idea ya solution sochna ya nikalna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki bahut der discussion ke baad unhone finally ek reasonable solution socha / find kiya. Isliye option (a) 'came up with' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: went through → kisi process ya situation ko experience karna | took over → control ya responsibility le lena | fell back on → backup option use karna

questions.question: The scientist's theory was praised for its originality but criticized for the _______ of supporting evidence.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) paucity
Explanation: Word "paucity" ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ki kami ya kam matra. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki scientist ki theory ko uski originality ke liye praise kiya gaya, lekin supporting evidence ki kami ke liye criticize bhi kiya gaya. Isliye option (a) 'paucity' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Abundance → Zyada hona / prachur | Clarity → spashtata | Rigidity → sakhti ya kathorpan

questions.question: She had to _______ her previous statements after new evidence emerged.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) take back
Explanation: "Take back" ka matlab hota hai apni kahi hui baat ko wapas lena ya retract karna. Sentence me diya hai ki new evidence aane ke baad usse apne pehle wale statements wapas lene pade. Isliye option (a) 'take back' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: give away → free me de dena / secret reveal kar dena | hold off → delay karna/temporarily rokna | turn down → reject karna

questions.question:
Select the correct part of speech to fill in the blank:
Despite the unexpected challenges, the team remained _______ focused on their objective.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) resolutely
Explanation: Adjective 'focused' ko qualify karne ke liye ek adverb ki zarurat hai. 'Resolutely' ek adverb hai, jiska matlab hota hai dridh tareeke se / firmly. Isliye option (b) 'resolutely' correct hoga.

questions.question: Seldom _______ so many people interested in a poetry reading.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) have I seen
Explanation: "Seldom" ek negative-type adverb hai. Aur jab sentence Seldom, Never, Rarely, Hardly jaise words se start hota hai, tab inversion rule lagta hai, matlab auxiliary verb subject se pehle aata hai. Isliye option (a) 'have I seen' correct hoga.

questions.question: Not until the evidence was re-examined did the scientist fully _______ the implications of her discovery.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) apprehend
Explanation: "Apprehend" ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ka meaning samajhna ya usse properly grasp karna. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki scientist apni discovery ke implications (nateeje/asar) ko tab tak poori tarah samajh nahi paayi thi jab tak evidence ko dobara examine nahi kiya gaya. Isliye option (a) 'apprehend' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: improvise → bina planning ke kuch karna | invalidate → galat sabit karna | replicate → copy/reproduce karna

questions.question: Although the proposal appeared promising at first, further analysis revealed it to be _______ in logic.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) fallacious
Explanation: 'Fallacious' ka matlab hota hai galat belief ya assumption par based, illogical ya flawed. Sentence ka matlab hai ki proposal pehle dekhne me promising lag raha tha, lekin baad me jab detail me analysis kiya gaya, to uske logic me flaws (kami ya galti) nikal aayi. Isliye option (b) 'fallacious' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Impeccable → bilkul perfect | Pragmatic → practical | Coherent → logically clear aur well-connected

questions.question: The philosopher's discourse was so _______ that only a handful of scholars could fully comprehend its nuanced intricacies.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) recondite
Explanation: 'Recondite' ka matlab hota hai bahut zyada complex, obscure, jo easily samajh na aaye. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki philosopher ka discourse itna recondite (gehra aur jatil) tha ki sirf kuch hi scholars uski nuanced intricacies (bahut hi sukshm jatiltaayein) ko acche se samajh paaye. Isliye option (c) 'recondite' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: perspicuous → clear aur easily samajh aane wala | pellucid → bilkul clear, transparent | facile → easy / superficial

questions.question: The detective had to _______ many clues to solve the complex case.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) piece together
Explanation: "Piece together" ka matlab hota hai alag-alag clues ya information ke tukdon ko jodkar kuch samajhna. Sentence me detective ko complex case solve karne ke liye bahut saare clues ko jodna pada. Isliye option (c) 'piece together' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: put up → tolerate karna / kisi cheez ko sehna | break down → todna / detail me analyse karna | give in → haar maan lena / surrender karna

questions.question: Hardly had the train left the station _______ it started raining heavily.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) when
Explanation: "Hardly...when" ek fixed conjunction pair hota hai. Isliye option (a) 'when' correct hoga.

questions.question: The historian often alluded _______ ancient myths in his lectures, enriching the narrative.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) to
Explanation: "Allude" ka matlab hota hai indirectly refer karna ya ishara karna. Ye verb hamesha "to" ke saath use hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'to' correct hoga. Correct phrase: allude to something.

questions.question: The old factory will be _______ into a modern art gallery next year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) turned into
Explanation: 'turned into' ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ko dusri cheez me badal dena. Sentence ka matlab hai ki old factory ko next year ek modern art gallery me badal diya jayega. Isliye option (b) 'turned into' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: pulled down → girana / tod dena (demolish karna) | put off → postpone karna | brought up → kisi topic ko uthana / bachche ko palna

questions.question: If they _______ the warning, they wouldn't have made that mistake.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) had heeded
Explanation: Yeh sentence Third conditional ka example hai, jo past ki unreal situation ko show karta hai (jo hua nahi) aur "had + V3... would/could/might + have + V3" iska correct structure hota hai. Isliye option (b) 'had heeded' correct hoga.

questions.question: The artist's _______ brushstrokes captured the essence of the landscape.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) masterful
Explanation: Sentence me "brushstrokes" ek noun hai, aur usko describe karne ke liye ek adjective ki zarurat hai. "Masterful" ek adjective hai, jiska matlab hota hai kisi expert ki high level skill se kiya gaya kaam. Isliye option (a) 'masterful' correct hoga.

questions.question: The professor, _______ reputation for rigorous research was widely known, retired last year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) whose
Explanation: Yahan sentence me "professor ki reputation" batani hai (possession show karna hai). Isliye option (c) 'whose' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Choose the correct semantic fit:
The committee's decision was a major _______ in the company's expansion plans.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Setback
Explanation: "Setback" ka matlab hota hai progress me rukawat ya delay. Sentence ka matlab hai ki committee ke decision ka company ke expansion plans par negative impact pada. Isliye option (b) 'setback' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Impetus → aage badhane wali force / push | Stimulant → temporarily excite ya boost karne wali cheez | Leverage → fayda uthana / advantage lena.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the verb.
The prevalence of infectious diseases among vulnerable populations _______ a constant concern for public health organisations.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) remains
Explanation: Sentence ka subject "Prevalence" (singular) hai isliye singular verb 'remains' aayega. Prevalence ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ka failav ya widespread hona. "of infectious diseases among vulnerable populations" sirf ek prepositional phrase hai, jo extra information deta hai - yeh subject nahi hai.

questions.question: The ancient scroll, previously thought to be lost, _______ in a hidden chamber.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) was discovered
Explanation: Sentence me ek past ki event describe ki gayi hai jahan scroll mila tha. Kyunki 'The scroll' khud discover nahi kar raha, balki usse discover kiya gaya hai, isliye yahan passive voice use hogi. Correct structure: was + V3 (past participle). Isliye option (a) 'was discovered' correct hoga.

questions.question: The manager handled the crisis so _______ that everyone praised his calmness.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Efficiently
Explanation: Efficiently ka matlab hai "kaam ko sahi aur productive tareeke se karna." Is sentence me bataya gaya hai ki manager ne crisis ko kaise handle kiya, yahan verb "handled" ko qualify karne ke liye ek adverb ki zarurat hai. Isliye option (a) 'efficiently' correct hoga.

questions.question: Her calm demeanour in the face of chaos acted as _______ for the anxious team members.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) reassurance
Explanation: 'Reassurance' ka matlab hota hai kisi ko chinta se mukt karna / tasalli dena. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki chaos (afra-tafri) ke beech uska calm demeanor (shaant vyavhaar) team ke anxious members ke liye tasalli dene ka kaam karta tha. Isliye option (c) 'reassurance' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: provocation → bhadkana / gussa dilana | catalyst → koi cheez jo process ko fast kare | distraction → dhyaan hatana

questions.question: After a long journey, they decided to _______ for the night at a small inn.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) put up
Explanation: "put up" ka matlab hota hai temporary stay karna / raat guzaarna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki lambi journey ke baad unhone raat ke liye ek chhote inn (hotel) me rukne ka decide kiya. Isliye option (b) 'put up' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: set off → journey start karna | give in → haar maan lena | stand by → support karna / ready rehna.

questions.question: The journalist was praised for her _______ investigation into the corruption scandal.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) meticulous
Explanation: "Meticulous" ka matlab hota hai bahut hi dhyaan se, detail me kaam karne wala. Isliye sentence me "investigation" (noun) ko qualify karne ke liye "meticulous" adjective aayega. Sentence ka matlab hai ki journalist ka kaam bahut hi carefully, thoroughly aur detail me kiya gaya tha.

questions.question: Scarcely had the CEO signed the contract _______ the company announced the merger.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) when
Explanation: "Scarcely-when" ek fixed conjunction pair hota hai. Isliye option (a) 'when' correct hoga.

questions.question: He was remembered not for what he said but _______ he refrained from saying.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) for what
Explanation: Yeh sentence ek contrast dikhata hai matlab baat ho rahi hai ki usne kya bola aur usne jaan-bujh kar kya nahi bola. Yaha parallelism maintain karna zaruri hai. Isliye option (d) 'for what' correct hoga.

questions.question: _______ his rigorous training, the athlete struggled to complete the marathon.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Despite
Explanation: "Despite" ka matlab hota hai "ke bawajood" / "in spite of". Sentence ka matlab hai ki itni hard training ke bawajood bhi athlete marathon complete nahi kar paya. Isliye option (d) 'Despite' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: As a result of → ke result me | By dint of → ki madad se / ke bal par | Due to → ke kaaran

questions.question: This movie is not _______ interesting as the book it was based on.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) so
Explanation: Sentence me negative comparison diya hai. Isliye "not so...as" ka structure use hoga, jo do cheezon ke beech comparison dikhata hai jahan pehli cheez dusri se kam hoti hai. Yahan movie ko book se compare kiya gaya hai aur bataya gaya hai ki movie, book jitni interesting nahi hai. Isliye option (c) 'so' correct hoga.

questions.question: Not until the auditors had submitted their exhaustive report _______ the full extent of procedural lapses become evident.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) did
Explanation: Jab sentence ki shuruaat kisi negative expression jaise 'Not until, only after, never, hardly' se hota hai, tab inversion lagta hai (matlab auxiliary verb subject se pehle aata hai). Isliye option (a) 'did' correct hoga.

questions.question: The manager felt caught _______ a rock and a hard place when he had to choose between laying off staff and cutting salaries.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) between
Explanation: 'Caught between a rock and a hard place' ek idiom hai. Iska matlab hota hai do mushkil situations ke beech phas jaana. Is sentence me manager ke pass dono hi options bure the (staff ko nikaalna ya salary cut karna). Isliye option (b) 'between' correct hoga.

questions.question: The novel was _______ complex for young readers to understand fully.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) too
Explanation: Adverb "too" ka use tab hota hai jab kisi cheez me koi quality zarurat se zyada (excessive) ho aur uska result negative aaye. Sentence me novel ki complexity itni zyada hai ki young readers usse fully samajh nahi pa rahe hain. Isliye option (b) 'too' correct hoga.

questions.question: The generous severance package was commensurate _______ his long and dedicated service to the company.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) with
Explanation: "Commensurate with" ek fixed phrase hota hai, jiska matlab hota hai 'kisi cheez ke proportion ya level ke according hona'. Sentence ka matlab hai ki Severance package uski long aur dedicated service ke hisaab se (proportion me) tha. Isliye option (b) 'with' correct hoga.

questions.question: Hardly had the game started _______ the rain began to pour.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) when
Explanation: 'Hardly...when' ek fixed conjunction pair hota hai. Isliye option (a) 'when' correct hoga.

questions.question: _______ the sun set, the temperature began to drop.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) When
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai: "Jaise hi sun set hua, temperature girne laga." Yahan specific time point bataya ja raha hai. Isliye option (a) 'when' correct hoga.

questions.question: The minister addressed the issue _______, ensuring no misunderstanding remained.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) unambiguously
Explanation: Adverb "unambiguously" ka matlab hota hai 'bilkul clear aur bina confusion ke'. Sentence ka matlab hai ki minister ne issue ko clear aur definite tareeke se address kiya taaki koi misunderstanding na rahe. Isliye option (b) 'unambiguously' correct hoga.

questions.question: No sooner had the referee blown the whistle _______ the match officials intervened.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) than
Explanation: 'No sooner... than' ek fixed conjunction pair hota hai. Isliye option (b) 'than' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Select the correct noun form of the word to fill in the blank.
The detective's brilliant _______ led him to the solution of the complex crime.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) ratiocination
Explanation: "Ratiocination" ka matlab hota hai logical reasoning ya soch-vichar karke conclusion tak pahunchna. Isliye option (a) 'ratiocination' correct hoga.

questions.question: While the students _______ on their research projects, the professor entered the lab.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) were working
Explanation: Sentence ek aise action ko batata hai jo dusre action ke progress me hone ke dauran hua. Jo action past me chal raha hota hai, use Past Continuous me likhte hai. 'Students' ek plural subject hai, isliye plural helping verb 'were' ka use hoga. Isliye option (b) 'were working' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Fill in the blanks with the appropriate article.
In _______ event of a system failure, employees must follow _______ protocol established by the IT department.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) an, the
Explanation: 'an event' kyunki 'event' ek singular countable noun hai aur vowel sound se start ho raha hai, isliye 'an' use hoga. 'the protocol' kyunki yahan specific protocol ki baat ho rahi hai (jo IT department ne already define kiya hai), isliye 'the' use hoga.

questions.question:
Fill the correct degree of comparison:
Of all the remedies suggested, this treatment seems the _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) most effective
Explanation: Jab kisi cheez ka comparison baaki sabhi cheezon se ki jaati hai, tab hum superlative degree ka use karte hain. Sentence me "of all the remedies suggested" diya hai, jo 2 se zyada cheezon ke beech comparison ko show karta hai. Isliye option (b) 'most effective' correct hoga.

questions.question: The team performed _______ well that they broke all previous records.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) so
Explanation: "So... that" ek correlative conjunction hai jo reason aur uska result (cause-effect) batane ke liye use hota hai. Isliye option (b) 'so' correct hoga.

questions.question: She wants to buy _______ new dress for _______ party next week.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) a, the
Explanation: 'a new dress' new dress ek singular countable noun hai aur pehli baar introduce kiya ja raha hai, isliye 'a' use hoga. 'the party next week' yahaan 'party next week' ek specific party ko refer karta hai (jo already known/decided hai). Isliye 'the' use hoga.

questions.question:
Choose the correct article:
She wants to become _______ engineer and work on renewable energy projects.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) an
Explanation: "Engineer" vowel sound se start hota hai. Isliye option (b) 'an' correct hoga.

questions.question: The teacher advised revising the entire syllabus _______ than focusing on a single topic.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) rather
Explanation: "rather than" ka matlab hota hai 'iske bajay' / 'instead of'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'teacher ne bola ki sirf ek topic par focus karne ke bajay poora syllabus revise karo'. Isliye option (b) 'rather' correct hoga.

questions.question: The archaeologist unearthed _______ ancient artefact, providing _______ invaluable glimpse into _______ prehistoric civilization.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) an, an, a
Explanation: 'an ancient' kyunki ancient vowel sound se start hota hai. Isliye 'an' use hoga. 'an invaluable' kyunki invaluable bhi vowel sound se start hota hai. Isliye 'an' use hoga. 'a prehistoric civilization' kyunki yahan kisi specific civilization ki baat nahi ho rahi. General sense me use ho raha hai. Isliye 'a' use hoga.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate collocation:
The CEO _______ a speech at the annual conference.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) delivered
Explanation: 'Deliver a speech' sahi collocation hai. Isliye option (d) 'delivered' correct hoga.

questions.question: The ancient city, _______ ruins lay buried beneath centuries of sand, was once a thriving metropolis.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) whose
Explanation: 'ruins' ko 'ancient city' se jodne ke liye ek possessive relative pronoun chahiye, jo yeh bataye ki ruins us city ke hain. Ownership (adhikaar) dikhane ke liye 'whose' sahi relative pronoun hai.

questions.question:
Choose the correct tense:
By next week, they _______ launched the new product.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) will have
Explanation: Sentence me Future perfect tense ka use kiya gaya hai, jo yeh batata hai ki future me ek specific point (by next week) se pehle koi action complete ho jayega. 'Correct structure: will have + past participle (V3)'. Isliye option (a) 'will have' correct hoga.

questions.question: After weeks of resistance, the smaller company had to _______ to the demands of the larger corporation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) knuckle under
Explanation: 'Knuckle under' ka matlab hota hai pressure me aakar haar maan lena ya kisi ke demands ko accept kar lena. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki hafton ke resistance ke baad, chhoti company ko badi company ki demands ko maanna pada. Isliye option (d) 'knuckle under' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: knuckle down → seriously kaam shuru karna (mehnat se kaam karna)

questions.question: Scarcely had the alarm sounded _______ the building was evacuated.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) when
Explanation: 'Scarcely...when' ek fixed conjunction pair hai. Isliye option (b) 'when' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb:
She tried to _______ the sensitive information during the meeting.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) play down
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'play down' ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ki importance ya seriousness ko kam dikhana ya minimize karna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki usne sensitive information ke importance ko kam dikhane ka try kiya. Isliye option (a) 'play down' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: phase out → dheere-dheere kisi cheez ko band karna | hand off → kisi ko responsibility ya kaam transfer karna | come across → achanak milna ya kisi tarah appear hona

questions.question:
Complete the sentence by using the correct collocation.
Due to his family connections on the board, John seemed to _______ in the promotion race, leaving other qualified candidates at a disadvantage.
options: (c) lay his cards on the table
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) hold all the cards
Explanation: 'Hold all the cards' ek idiom hai jiska matlab hota hai poori power, control ya strong advantage hona kisi situation me. Sentence me diya hai ki John ke family connections board me hain, jis wajah se usko promotion race me unfair advantage mil raha hai. Iska matlab John strongest position me hai aur baaki candidates disadvantage me hain. Isliye option (a) 'hold all the cards' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: play by the rules → rules follow karna | lay his cards on the table → openly sab sach batana | deal a raw deal → kisi ke saath unfair behave karna

questions.question:
Choose the correct phrasal verb:
After hours of discussion, the committee _______ a decision regarding the budget allocation.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) arrived at
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'Arrive at' ka use tab hota hai jab hum kisi decision, conclusion ya result tak pahuchte hain. Sentence me committee budget allocation ke sambandh me ek decision par pahunchi. Isliye option (b) 'arrived at' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: arrived in → kisi city ya country ke liye use hota hai (e.g., arrived in Delhi), arrived on → specific day/date ke liye use hota hai (e.g., arrived on Monday)

questions.question: The government's new policies sought to _______ economic growth, not stifle it.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) stimulate
Explanation: 'Stimulate' ka matlab hota hai badhaava dena, growth ko increase karna. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki government ki new policies ka purpose economic growth ko badhaava dena tha, na ki use dabana (stifle). Isliye option (c) 'stimulate' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: hinder / impede → rukawat dalna / slow karna | curtail → kam kar dena / reduce karna.

questions.question:
Choose the most appropriate option to fill the blank in the given sentence.
The tiny deer stood looking at them with _______ eyes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Luminous
Explanation: 'Luminous' ka matlab hota hai chamakdar ya glowing. Sentence ka matlab hai ek chhota deer quietly khada tha aur apni chamakti hui aankhon se unko dekh raha tha. Isliye option (c) 'Luminous' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Stationary → Sthir, Arid → sookha, Transparent → paradarshi

questions.question:
Choose the most appropriate option to fill the blank in the given sentence.
Radium _______ rays that can damage the eyes.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) gives off
Explanation: Yahan sentence ka matlab hai ki radium harmful rays emit karta hai. "Gives off" ka meaning hota hai emit karna / nikalna. Isliye option (c) 'gives off' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: gives over → kisi cheez ko handover karna, gives away → free me de dena ya secret reveal karna, gives up → haar maan lena

questions.question: Vinod had a _______ escape in the car accident.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) narrow
Explanation: Phrase "narrow escape" ka matlab hota hai bahut badi danger situation se mushkil se bachna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki Vinod car accident me baal-baal bach gaya. Isliye option (c) 'narrow' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: comfortable → aaramdayak, full → "full escape" koi correct phrase nahi hai, wide → "wide escape" bhi galat hai

questions.question: The group of travellers was wonderstruck by the _______ of the coin.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) weight
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai ki travellers ka group coin ke weight (wajan) ko dekhkar kaafi zyada surprise ho gaya tha, yani woh wonderstruck the. Isliye option (d) 'weight' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: wait → rukna / intezaar karna, white → rang (colour), wide → chaurai (width)

questions.question: Two of the fugitives managed to remain free by adeptly avoiding the _______ of the police.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) pursuit
Explanation: 'Pursuit' ka matlab hota hai kisi ko pakadne ke liye uska peecha karna (chasing). Sentence ka matlab hai ki do fugitives (bhagode) chaturai se police ke talash se bachkar bhagne me safal rahe. Isliye option (c) 'pursuit' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: following → peecha karna, (police context me "pursuit" zyada sahi hai), repression → dabaav/control karna, discovery → khoj

questions.question: We have postponed this movie outing too many times, so we are going tomorrow, come _______ or shine.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) rain
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai ki humne iss movie outing ko bahut baar postpone kiya hai, isliye kal hum zaroor jayenge chahe barish ho ya dhoop (koi bhi situation ho). Isliye option (a) 'rain' correct hoga. Aur "come rain or shine" ek idiom hota hai jiska matlab 'chahe kuch bhi ho jaye / har haal me' hota hai. Baaki options ka meaning: mountain → pahad, hail → ole padna, thunder → badal ki garaj / zor ki awaaz

questions.question: He had _______ the _______ into smaller clips.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) clipped, clipping
Explanation: 'Clipped' ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ko saaf-suthre tareeke se chhote pieces me kaat dena, aur 'clipping' ka matlab hota hai newspaper ya magazine se kata hua hissa (article ya piece). Sentence ka matlab hai ki usne clipping ko chhote-chhote tukdon me kaat diya tha, isliye yahan Past Perfect ke according "had + V3 (clipped)" use hoga aur object ke liye 'clipping (gerund)' ka use hoga. Isliye option (d) 'clipped, clipping' correct hoga.

questions.question: After years of fights with his neighbour Ram, Shekhar decided to hold out the _______ and invited Ram for tea.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) olive branch
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai ki Shekhar ne apne neighbour Ram ke saath saalon ke jhagde ke baad peace karne ka decision liya aur usse chai par bulaya. "Hold out the olive branch" ek idiom hai, jiska matlab hota hai dosti ya shanti ka haath badhana / patch-up karna. Isliye option (d) 'olive branch' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: poker face → bina emotion dikhaye serious face rakhna, comparing apples to oranges → do bilkul alag cheezon ki comparison karna, chip on shoulder → bina wajah gussa ya grudge rakhna

questions.question: To _______ the ticket, Amit had to visit the travel agency many times.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) confirm
Explanation: 'Confirm' ka matlab hota hai sunishchit karna. Sentence ka matlab hai ki Amit ko apni ticket confirm karwane ke liye kai baar travel agency jana pada. Isliye option (b) 'confirm' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: contract → agreement ya samjhauta, conform → kisi rule ya standard ko follow karna, convention → ek formal meeting ya parampara

questions.question: Kamal is not willing to purchase a house on the 12th floor of a sea-side apartment, as she is fearful of heights. She is suffering from _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) acrophobia
Explanation: Sentence me clearly likha hai ki Kamal ko heights se dar lagta hai (fear of heights). Heights ka dar jo hota hai, usse acrophobia kehte hain. Isliye option (d) 'acrophobia' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: heliophobia → sunlight se dar, claustrophobia → band jagah (closed spaces) se dar, sociophobia → logon ya social situations se dar

questions.question: Ram went to _______ an ice cream.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) buy
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai ki Ram ice cream kharidne gaya tha. Isliye yahan verb ka base form 'buy' use hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: byre → gaushala (cow shed)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank.
They _______ their house for the past two months, and it's finally starting to look fantastic.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) have been renovating
Explanation: Sentence me "for the past two months" diya hua hai, jo ek time duration batata hai (kaam past me start hua aur abhi tak chal raha hai). Aise cases me hum Present Perfect Continuous Tense use karte hain. Isliye option (d) 'have been renovating' correct hoga.

questions.question: The US _______ building was built in the year 1800.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) capitol
Explanation: 'Capitol' ka matlab hota hai wo building jahan legislature (jaise US Congress) baithti hai - jaise U.S. Capitol Building in Washington, D.C.. Ye building 1800 ke aas-paas establish hui thi. Baaki options ka meaning: capital → desh ya rajya ki Rajdhani, cannibal → aisa vyakti jo insaan ka maans khata hai, captain → kisi team ya ship ka leader

questions.question: Sharat is always _______ about showing up for work because he believes that tardiness gets us nowhere.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) punctual
Explanation: 'Punctual' ka matlab hota hai kisi kaam ko sahi ya fix time par karne wala. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki Sharat hamesha kaam par aane ke mamle me time ka paband rehta hai, kyunki uska maanna hai ki late aane (tardiness) se kuch bhi hasil nahi hota. Isliye option (d) 'punctual' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Selective = chuninda cheezein choose karne wala, Patient = dhairyavaan, Drowsy = neend aane wala / sleepy

questions.question: Raj is very interested in studying human psychology, so he decided to pursue his master's degree in _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) Psychology
Explanation: Sentence me Raj ki human psychology (yaani insaan ke dimaag, behavior aur emotions) ke study me interest ke baare me baat karta hai. Isliye option (c) 'Psychology' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Archaeology → Purane samay ki cheezon (artifacts, monuments) ka study karta hai | Philosophy → Life, knowledge aur existence ke deep questions ka study karta hai | Anatomy → Body ke physical structure (jaise organs, bones) ka study karta hai.

questions.question: The mother couldn't _______ such an insult from her son in front of the others.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) bear
Explanation: "Bear" ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ko sehna ya bardasht karna. Sentence ka meaning hai ki Maa apne bete se sabke saamne aisa insult seh nahi paayi. Isliye option (d) 'bear' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: bier → dead body rakhne ka stand/platform (funeral me use hota hai), bare → nanga / uncovered / khula hua, beer → ek alcoholic drink

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank.
Akshaya _______ hard for the entrance exam and received a high score.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) studied
Explanation: Sentence past tense me hai, isliye yahan simple past tense ka use hoga. Isliye option (d) 'studied' correct hoga.

questions.question: I like bread made up of corn _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) flour
Explanation: Flour ka matlab hota hai aata (powder form me pissa hua anaj), jaise corn flour (makke ka aata). Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki mujhe makke ke aate se bani bread pasand hai. Isliye option (b) 'flour' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: flower → phool, floor → zameen / farsh, failure → asafalta

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank.
The team _______ the championship before their star player got injured.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) had won
Explanation: Agar sentence me do actions past me hue ho, tho jo pehla action hota hai use Past Perfect Tense (had + V3) me likhte hain, aur jo baad wala action hota hai use Simple Past (V2) me. Yahan par: 'Championship jeetna = pehla action', 'Player ka injured hona = baad wala action'. Isliye option (b) 'had won' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The blueberries in the basket are blue.
The denotation of the word 'blue' is _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) a colour
Explanation: "Denotation" ka matlab hota hai kisi word ka literal ya direct meaning, jo dictionary me diya hota hai. Yahan sentence me "blueberries are blue" me "blue" ka use colour ke sense me hua hai. Isliye option (d) 'a colour' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank.
Rabindranath Tagore, _______ poet, was famous for his poetical work, Gitanjali.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) the
Explanation: Rabindranath Tagore ek well-known, specific personality hain. Isliye yahan "the poet" use karenge.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
This is the _______ book that I have read till now.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) most interesting
Explanation: Sentence me "that I have read till now" diya hai, jo clearly comparison dikha raha hai - matlab jitni bhi books ab tak padhi hain, un sab me ye wali sabse zyada interesting hai. Isliye hume superlative degree ka use karna hoga, aur option (c) 'most interesting' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Complete the dialogue for Person B using the correct idiom.
Person A: We are all going to the club this weekend. Do you want to come?
Person B: Thank you for asking. But I don't like clubs. It's _______.
options: (c) not my cup, not my tea
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) not my cup of tea
Explanation: "Not my cup of tea" ek idiom hai jiska matlab hota hai koi cheez pasand na hona ya interest na hona. Sentence me Person B bol raha hai ki usse clubs pasand nahi hain. Isliye option (a) 'not my cup of tea' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
Prescription safety glasses provide the _______ tailored protection for individuals with vision correction needs.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) finest
Explanation: Jab "the" ke saath comparison hota hai aur kisi cheez ko sabse best dikhana hota hai, tab superlative degree use hoti hai. Isliye option (c) 'finest' correct hoga.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
The comedian's jokes were so funny that the entire audience erupted in _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) laughter
Explanation: Sentence ka matlab hai ki comedian ke jokes itne funny the ki poori audience zor-zor se hans padi. "Erupted in laughter" ek phrase hai jiska matlab hota hai achanak se bahut zor-zor se hasne lagna. Baaki options ka meaning: loiter → idhar-udhar bina purpose ke ghoomna | latter → do cheezon me se second wali | later → baad me

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.
A lot of people are still _______ over the GDP issue.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) sitting on the fence
Explanation: "Sitting on the fence" ek idiom hai jiska matlab hai neutral rehna ya kisi issue par clear decision na lena. Sentence me bola gaya hai ki GDP issue par bahut log abhi bhi decide nahi kar pa rahe hain ya apni side clear nahi kar rahe isliye ye idiom perfectly fit hota hai. Baaki options ka meaning: breaking a leg → good luck wish karne ke liye use hota hai (mostly performance se pehle)

questions.question: She is _______ a peacock in the blue satin saree.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) as beautiful as
Explanation: 'As...as' ka use do cheezon ke beech comparison dikhane ke liye hota hai. Sentence me uski khoobsurti ki tulna peacock se ki gayi hai. Isliye option (c) 'as beautiful as' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: (b) so beautiful as → 'So...as' negative sentences me use hota hai. Eg. She is not so beautiful as her sister.

questions.question: She reminds me always that I _______ to be a little more careful.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) have
Explanation: Verb 'reminds' present tense ko show karta hai. Jab hume 'I/you/we/they' ke saath kisi general duty ya obligation ko batana hota hai, tab hum 'have to' ka use karte hai. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki mujhe careful rehna zaruri hai. Isliye option (b) 'have' correct hoga.

questions.question: Kiran had a short _______ as a writer.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) career
Explanation: 'Career' ka matlab hota hai Pesha, rozgaar, professional life. 'Short career' ka matlab kisi profession me kam samay tak kaam karna. Sentence me kaha gaya hai ki Kiran ne writer ke roop me kam samay tak kaam kiya tha matlab writer ke roop me Kiran ka career chhota tha. Baaki options ka meaning: caress → pyar se sehlana, thapki | carer → dekhbhaal karne wala, caretaker | carrier → le jaane wala (mail carrier) / Rogvaahak (disease carrier)

questions.question: The patient looked _______ and tired.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) pale
Explanation: 'Pale' ka matlab Peela, safed, fika. Beemari ya kamzori ki wajah se chehre ya twacha ka rang feeka pad jana. Sentence ka matlab hai mareez ka rang halka dikh raha tha aur woh thaka hua lag raha tha. Baaki options ka meaning: pail → baalti | pall → tabeet ka kafan / udaasi ki leher / bezaar kar dena | peel → chhilka utarna

questions.question: The police were on high alert on account of the _______ convict who had killed many people.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) runaway
Explanation: 'Runaway' ka matlab hirasat se bhaag jana. Sentence ka matlab hai ki uss bhage huye apradhi ki wajah se police high alert par thi jisne bahut logon ki hatya kar di thi. Isliye option (d) 'runaway' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: run after → peecha karna | walk away → chalkar chale jana | eloped → prem sambandh ke karan ghar se bhaag kar shaadi kar lena

questions.question: Payments can be made by _______ or in cash.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) cheque
Explanation: 'Cheque' → Bank ka cheque, jisse payment karte hain. Sentence ka matlab hai payment cheque ya cash dwara kiya ja sakta hai. Baaki options ka meaning: chick → chooza, murgi ka bachcha / slang me ladki | cheek → gaal | cheeky → Gustakh, badtameez

questions.question: You are the _______ to the throne and should behave in such a manner.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d) heir
Explanation: 'Heir' → Vaaris, uttaradhikari. Jo raja ke baad singhasan/gaddi sambhalta hai use 'heir to the throne' bolte hai. Sentence ka matlab hai ki tum singhasan ke uttaradhikari ho aur tumhe usi tarah behave karna chahiye. Baaki options ka meaning: hair → baal | here → yahan | hare → Khargosh

questions.question: As cattle are to herd so are birds to _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) flock
Explanation: Herd → Pashuon ka jhund, khaaskar cattle, elephant, deer ka. Flock → pakshiyon ka jhund. Sheep aur bakri ka bhi jhund 'flock' kehlata hai. Baaki options ka meaning: litter → billi, kutte ke ek saath paida hue bachche / kachra | pack → bhediyon, kutton ka jhund / cards ka 'pack' bhi hota hai | streak → lakeer, dhabba / tigers ka group bhi 'streak / ambush' kehlata hai | pride → lions ka group | school/Shoal → fish ka group

questions.question: They are playing songs so _______ that the entire neighbourhood is disturbed.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) loud
Explanation: Loud → Tez awaaz me, shor wala. Sentence ka matlab hai ki veh gaane itni tez awaaz me baja rahe hain ki sabhi padosi pareshan ho gaye. Baaki options ka meaning: lord → prabhu, bhagwan / zamindar | loved → pasandida, priy | laud → Prashansa karna
Note: Vaise tho yaha par sabse accha adverb hota loudly, but vo option main nahi hai, loud generally adjective hota hai but informal main loud ko adverb ke roop main bhi use liya jata hai isliye yaha par ye hi option best hai.

questions.question: There are rows of chairs on either side of the _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) aisle
Explanation: Aisle → do panktiyon ke beech ka raasta jaise theatre, plane, church ya classroom me kursiyon ke beech chalne ki jagah. Sentence ka matlab hai galiyare ke dono taraf kursiyon ki panktiyan hain. Baaki options ka meaning: ail → beemar karna, takleef dena | isle → chhota dweep

questions.question: 'Habitual' may be replaced by _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Continual
Explanation: Habitual → aadat se juda hua, baar-baar hone wala, niyamit | Continual → lagaatar, baar-baar hote rehne wala | Stagnant → ruka hua, thahra hua | Temperate → madhyam / not excessive or extreme | Holistic → sampurn roop se

questions.question: The match schedule was disturbed due to _______ rains.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) incessant
Explanation: Incessant → lagaatar, bina ruke. Sentence ka matlab hai lagaatar baarish ke karan match ka schedule disturb ho gaya. Isliye option (b) 'incessant' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: detestable → nafrat ke layak, ghinona | venerable → aadarniya, sammaanit | soothing → sukhdayak, aaraam dene wali.

questions.question: Don't take the wind out of my _______ and tell me I'm going nowhere with my life.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) sails
Explanation: Idiom 'Take the wind out of someone's sails' ka matlab kisi ka hausla tod dena, demotivate kar dena. Sentence ka matlab hai mera hausla mat todo aur ye mat bolo ki main life me kahin nahi pahunchunga. Isliye option (c) 'sails' correct hoga. Idiom 'Clip my wings' ka matlab aazadi rokna.

questions.question: The doctor _______ two tablets per day.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) prescribed
Explanation: Prescribed → Doctor dwara dawa likhkar dena. Sentence ka matlab hai doctor ne roz do tablet lene ko kaha / likh kar di. Baaki options ka meaning: advised → salah dena. 'Doctor advised rest' bol sakte hai, lekin tablets ke liye 'prescribed' zyada sahi hai | ordered → aadesh dena | proposed → prastaav rakhna

questions.question: I find that students nowadays are not interested in _______ letters by hand.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) writing
Explanation: Writing → Likhna. Sentence ka matlab hai mujhe lagta hai ki aajkal students ko haath se chitthiyan likhne me koi ruchi nahi hai. Baaki options ka meaning: righting → theek karna, seedha karna | rioting → danga karna | rating → rating dena, moolyankan karna

questions.question: Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagar fought hard against _______ practices which affected Indian society of his time.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) many evil
Explanation: 'Practices' plural countable noun hai, aur plural countable ke saath 'many' use hota hai. Sentence ka matlab hai ki Eshwar Chandra Vidyasagar ne apne samay ke Bharatiya samaj ko prabhavit karne wali kai buri prathaon ke khilaaf kathin sangharsh kia. Isliye option (a) 'many evil' correct hoga.

questions.question: The young one of a lion is called a _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) cub
Explanation: Cub → Sher, bhalu, cheete, lomdi jaise maansahaari janwaron ka bachcha. Lion ka young one 'lion cub' kehlata hai. Baaki options ka meaning: colt → ghode ya gadhe ka nar bachcha. Male horse ka bachcha 'colt', female 'filly' | chick → chidiya, murgi ka bachcha | calf → gaay, haathi, whale, deer ka bachcha | puppy → dog ka bachcha | kitten → cat ka bachcha

questions.question: Mohan _______ the charge of the Centre for Life Skills from Mustafa.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) took over
Explanation: 'Take over' ka matlab kisi ka kaam, zimmedari ya pad sambhal lena. Jab ek vyakti doosre se charge ya control leta hai tho 'take over' use hota hai. Sentence ka matlab hai Mohan ne Mustafa se 'Centre for Life Skills' ka charge sambhala. Isliye option (d) 'took over' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: took out → bahar le jana / nikalna | took through → kisi ko step-by-step samjhana | took off → kapde utarna / plane ka udna / achanak successful ho jana | Phrasal verb: Take over the charge/responsibility/control from someone.

questions.question: The sermon of the priest was very short and _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) concise
Explanation: Concise → sankshipt aur spasht vivaran. Sentence ka matlab hai priest (pujari) ka updesh bahut sankshipt aur spasht tha. Isliye option (c) 'concise' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: coned → shanku ke aakar ka (ice cream cone), conveyance → saadhan / sawaari | consisted → bana hua tha / shamil tha

questions.question: Tibet is our _______ country. Its people are called 'Tibetans'.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) neighbouring
Explanation: Neighbouring → padosi, bagal wala. Adjective (neighbouring) ka use noun (country) ko describe karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Sentence ka matlab hai tibet hamara padosi desh hai. Yahan ke logon ko 'Tibetans' kaha jata hai. Isliye option (b) 'neighbouring' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: neighbour (noun) → padosi vyakti | neighbour's (possessive case) → padosi ka. Eg. neighbour's car | neighbourhood → pados, mohalla

questions.question: The Princess firmly held the _______ in her hands.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) rein
Explanation: Rein → Ghode ki lagaam. Ya kisi cheez par niyantran. 'Take/hold the reins' ka matlab control apne haath me lena. Sentence ka matlab hai Princess ne lagaam ko apne haathon me mazbooti se pakad rakhi thi. Isliye option (d) 'rein' correct hoga. Idiom 'Free rein' ka matlab poori aazadi dena. Baaki options ka meaning: rain → baarish | ran → dauda | reign → shasan kaal, raaj

questions.question: The details were _______ from one person to the other within no time.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) passed down
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'passed down' ka matlab ek se doosre tak pahunchana, aage badhana. Sentence ka matlab hai details kuch hi samay me ek vyakti se doosre vyakti tak pahunch gayi. Isliye option (c) 'passed down' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: passed away → mar jana | passed out → behosh ho jana / course complete karna | passed on/passed around → ek se doosre ko batana

questions.question: The room was very _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) quiet
Explanation: Quiet → Shant, jahan awaaz na ho. 'Very quiet' ka matlab bahut shant. Sentence ka matlab hai kamra bahut shant tha. Isliye option (c) 'quiet' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: quit → chhod dena | quilt → rajai, lehaaf | quite → poori tarah se, kaafi.

questions.question: Raghav had a good _______ for stage plays.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) troupe
Explanation: Troupe → kalakaron ka samooh, mandali. Jo ek team ke roop me ek saath kaam karte hai. Sentence ka matlab hai Raghav ke paas stage plays ke liye ek achhi mandali thi. Isliye option (d) 'troupe' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: trip → yatra / thokar khana | trope → sahitya me baar-baar use hone wala theme ya idea | troop → sainikon ka dal / scout ka group

questions.question: Hundreds of firms went bankrupt during the _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) recession
Explanation: Recession → aarthik mandi. Jab desh ki economy girne lagti hai, GDP kam hota hai, companies band hoti hain, berozgari badhti hai. Sentence ka matlab hai aarthik mandi ke dauran saikdon companies diwaliya ho gayi. Isliye option (d) 'recession' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: recission → sahi spelling 'rescission' hota hai aur iska matlab kisi contract ya agreement ko khatam karna hota hai | revision → sanshodhan, dobara dekhna | remission → beemari ka kam hona / saza maaf karna

questions.question: I take my _______ off to our freedom fighters for their service to our country.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) hat
Explanation: Idiom 'Take one's hat off to someone' ka matlab kisi ki izzat karna, salaam karna, samman dena. Sentence ka matlab hai mai apne swatantrata senaniyon ko hamare desh ke prati unki seva ke liye salaam karta hoon. Isliye option (b) 'hat' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Take one's boots off → joote utarna | Knock your socks off → bahut impress karna

questions.question: _______ droplets settled on top of leaves.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Dew
Explanation: Dew → Subah ke time patton/ghaas par jama hone wali paani ki boondein (oos). Sentence ka matlab hai patton ke upar oos ki boondein jam gayi thi. Isliye option (d) 'dew' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Due → baaki/kaaran | Doe → mada hiran | Do → karna

questions.question: Stories of dolphins' saving human lives _______ throughout history.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) have been told
Explanation: 'throughout history' → itihas bhar me, yaani past se lekar ab tak. Aise action ko dikhane ke liye present perfect use hota hai. Aur 'Stories' subject hai, Stories khud nahi bolti, stories ko bataya/sunaya jata hai isliye 'passive voice' bhi chahiye. Structure: has/have + been + V3. 'Stories' plural hai isliye 'have been told' correct hoga.

questions.question: _______ are words which have the same spelling or pronunciation but not the same meaning.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) Homonyms
Explanation: Homonyms → Aise words jinki spelling ya pronunciation same ho, lekin meaning alag ho. Homonyms 2 type ke hote hai: (a) Homophones: pronunciation same, spelling alag. Eg. 'whole/hole', 'vain/vein', 'dose/doze'. (b) Homographs: spelling same, pronunciation ya meaning alag. Eg. 'lead (metal) / lead (guide)', 'tear (aansu) / tear (phaadna)'. Baaki options ka meaning: Acronyms → short form jo initials se bana ho. Eg. NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration | Synonyms → same meaning wale words | Antonyms → opposite meaning wale words | Examples of Homonyms: Bat - cricket ka bat / chamagadar | Bank - nadi ka kinara / paise wala bank | Right - sahi/daaya

questions.question: We _______ off old clothes and bought new ones for Diwali.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) cast
Explanation: Cast off → purani cheez ko utaar dena, phenk dena, discard kar dena. 'Cast off old clothes' ka matlab purane kapde hata dena. Sentence ka matlab hai humne purane kapde hata diye aur Diwali ke liye naye khareede. Isliye option (d) 'cast' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: cost → keemat | coast → samundar ka kinara / bina mehnat ke aage badhna | caste → jaati | cast a vote → vote daalna | movie cast → film ke kalakar | cast a spell → jaadu karna

questions.question: Anita keeps on repeating that she is innocent, but there is _______.
options: (b) no pulling up of the socks
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) no smoke without fire
Explanation: Idiom 'no smoke without fire' ka matlab agar kisi baat ki charcha ho rahi hai, afwah fail rahi hai, to usme kuch na kuch sachchai zaroor hoti hai. Sentence ka matlab hai Anita baar-baar bol rahi hai ki wo begunah hai, lekin kahin na kahin kuch to gadbad hai, tabhi us par ilzaam lag raha hai. Isliye option (a) 'no smoke without fire' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: no pulling up of the socks → sahi idiom hota hai 'pull up one's socks' → mehnat karna, sudharna | no rubbing of the shoulders → sahi idiom hota hai 'rub shoulders with' → bade logo ke saath uthna-baithna | no love lost between → Do logon ke beech nafrat/dushmani hona

questions.question: Shakuntala Devi was born on 4th November 1929. In her childhood she _______ to school.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) had never been
Explanation: 'In her childhood' past ka time hai. 'Born on 4th November 1929' se pata chal raha hai ki poora context past me hai. Isliye past perfect (had + v3) sahi hai aur adverb of frequency (never) generally helping verb aur main verb ke beech me use hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'had never been' correct hoga. Sentence ka matlab hai Shakuntala Devi ka janam 4th November 1929 ko hua tha. Apne bachpan mein wo kabhi school nahi gayi thi.

questions.question: Soon after the doctor gave her the next _______ of the medicine, the patient began to _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) dose, doze
Explanation: Dose → dawa ki ek khuraak. Doze → halki neend lena, jhapki lena. Sentence ka matlab hai jaise hi doctor ne dawa ki agli khuraak di, patient ko neend aane lagi. Isliye option (c) 'dose, doze' correct hoga.

questions.question: The actress is very _______ and takes pride in her appearance all the time.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) vain
Explanation: Vain → Apni khoobsurti ya appearance par bahut zyada garv karna, ghamandi. Sentence ka matlab hai actress bahut ghamandi hai aur har waqt apne looks par naaz karti hai. Isliye option (d) 'vain' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: vein → rag/nas | wane → dheere-dheere kam hona | vane → weathervane - hawa ki disha batane wala yantra jo chhat par lagta hai | vain → 'vyarth' bhi hota hai.

questions.question: The termites were just the tip of the _______, but the house was near collapsing in reality.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) iceberg
Explanation: 'tip of the iceberg' ka matlab aisi situation jahan jo cheez dikh rahi hoti hai, woh kisi bahut badi aur hidden problem ka sirf chhota sa hissa hoti hai. Sentence ka matlab hai termites problem ka sirf chhota sa part the, jabki asal me ghar girne ke kareeb tha. Isliye option (b) 'iceberg' correct hoga. Idiom 'Achilles' heel' → kamzor nas

questions.question: _______ in population is a hindrance to a country's growth.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) Increase
Explanation: Increase ka matlab kisi cheez ka quantity, size ya level me badhna. Sentence ka matlab hai population me badhotri kisi desh ki growth ke liye rukawat hai. Isliye option (d) 'increase' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: contract → sikudna | decrease → ghatna | reduce → kam karna

questions.question: He is rich and famous and expects everyone to _______ on him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (d) dance attendance
Explanation: Idiom 'Dance attendance on someone' ka matlab kisi ki khushamad karna, har baat maan-na, ji-hazoori karna. Sentence ka matlab hai wo ameer aur famous hai aur chahta hai ki sab log uski khushamad karein / uski seva me lage rahein. Baaki options ka meaning: dead duck → aisi situation ya person jiske bachne ki ummeed na ho | give a song and dance → Lamba-choda bahana banana ya kisi cheez ko explain karne me unnecessary drama karna.

questions.question: A _______ is a female horse.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) mare
Explanation: Mare → adult female horse | Baaki options ka meaning: vixen → female fox | fox/dog fox → male fox | doe → female deer, rabbit, hare | buck/stag → male deer | rooster → male chicken | hen → female chicken | ewe → female sheep | ram → male sheep | male horse is called a 'stallion' if it is uncastrated, and a 'gelding' if it is castrated. 'Castrated' ka matlab hota hai kisi male animal ki reproductive ability ko surgery ke through hata dena, yani uske testicles remove kar dena.

questions.question: She could easily eat the _______ biryani by herself.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) whole
Explanation: Whole → poora, entire. Sentence ka matlab hai voh akele hi poori biryani aaraam se kha sakti thi. Baaki options ka meaning: haul → kheench kar le jana / maal dhona | hall → bada kamra/sabha-kaksh | hole → chhed / gaddha

questions.question: Keats and Shelly were poets of the same period; in other words, they were _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) contemporaries
Explanation: Contemporaries → voh log jo ek hi time period me rahe hon / same era ke hon. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki Keats aur Shelley aise poets the jo same time period me rahe the. Isliye option (a) 'contemporaries' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: co-writers → saath me likhne wale | colleagues → ek hi jagah kaam karne wale | associates → business ya kisi kaam me jude hue log

questions.question: The driver very subtly _______ the traffic violation he committed.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) ironed out
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'ironed out' ka matlab kisi problem, difficulty ya disagreement ko solve karna, settle karna. Sentence ka matlab hai driver ne jo traffic violation kiya tha, us problem ko usne efficiently handle/solve kiya. Isliye option (c) 'ironed out' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: ironed in → permanent crease banana ya kisi cheez ko pakka karna.

questions.question: By this time tomorrow, I _______ the work assigned to me.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) will have done
Explanation: future perfect tab use karte hai jab kisi kaam ke complete hone ka time future me diya ho. Sentence me deadline 'by this time tomorrow' dia hai, jo future ka ek specific point batata hai. Isliye option (c) 'will have done' correct hoga.

questions.question: _______ that thought. It will be a great idea someday.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (a) Hold onto
Explanation: Phrasal verb 'hold onto' ka matlab kisi cheez ko sambhal kar rakhna. Sentence ka matlab hai uss thought ko sambhal kar rakho, kyunki voh kabhi na kabhi ek bahut achha idea ban sakta hai. Isliye option (a) 'Hold onto' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: Hold onto → kisi cheez ko pakad ke rakhna, yaad rakhna, sambhal kar rakhna | Hold on → ruko, intezaar karna | Hold against → Kisi ke khilaaf baat rakhna, dosh dena

questions.question: Robin watched as the smoke _______ steadily from the chimney.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (b) rose
Explanation: Rose → upar ki taraf uthna yaa badhna. Sentence me bataya gaya hai ki Robin ne dekha ki chimney se dhuaan lagataar upar uth raha tha. Isliye option (b) 'rose' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: hung → latka hua | left → chhod kar chala gaya | went → gaya

questions.question: The girl was _______ as she was drenched in the rain.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) cold
Explanation: Cold → thandi, normal se kam temperature hona. Sentence ka matlab hai ladki baarish me bheeg gayi thi, isliye use thand lag rahi thi. Isliye option (c) 'cold' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: bolt → bijli ka girna / kundi / tezi se bhaagna | gold → sona | tight → kasa hua

questions.question: You use an _______ to steer a boat.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans: (c) oar
Explanation: Oar → Chappu, patvaar. Ek lambi lakdi jiske end par flat blade laga hota hai, jiska use boat ko chalane ya direction dene ke liye kiya jata hai. Sentence ka matlab hai boat ko steer karne ke liye oar ka use hota hai. Isliye option (c) 'oar' correct hoga. Baaki options ka meaning: ore → kachcha loha, mineral

questions.question: Vishal is going to read the story _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) Aloud
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yahan Sahi meaning ke according humein yhan fill karna hoga Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'Vishal Story padne baala hai' yaani iske liye humein Option mein se Option(c) Aloud ko select karna hoga kyuki 'aloud' jiska Use 'Jor se padne/bolne' k liye hota hai, baaki Options ka Meaning: load → iska meaning bhar / weight, allow → Permission / izzajat, allowed → izzajat / anumati de dena. lekin Option(c) aloud ka use karne par Sentence ka meaning "Vishal jor se Story padne bala hai" ho jayega jo sahi Meaning dega.

questions.question: The friends decided to play cards to _______ time while waiting for the cab.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Kill
Explanation: Sentence mein bola gya ki 'Dosto ne Cab ka wait karte huye Time-pass / samay guzarne ke liye Cards khelne ka Decide kiya' yaani iss Sentence ko sahi meaning dene ke liye humein yhan ek Correct Idiomatic Phrase likhna hai jo ki diye Options mein se sirf Option(b) Kill ko select karne par hoga jisse yahan ek idiomatic Phrase 'to kill time' banega jiska meaning 'Time-pass / samay guzarna' hota hai jab ham kisi cheez ka wait karte hai.

questions.question: The management wants to _______ restrictions at the workplace.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Impose
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yaani Sahi meaning ke according humein yhan fill karna hoga Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'Management workplace par Restrictions lagana chahta hai' jiske liye diye Options mein se hum Option(b) Impose ko select karenge kyuki iska meaning hota hai 'jabardasti koi Rule / Law thopna / lagana'. Jo ki iss Sentence ko sahi meaning de raha. Baaki Options ke Meaning: Break - Todna, Settle - Suljhana, Encourage - protsahit / Motivate karna |

questions.question: The wind _______ so powerfully that the door closed.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Blew
Explanation: Sentence mein 'hawa ke chalne ki baat ho rahi hai' aur iske Sub-Clause se humein pata chal raha hai ki iska Action past mein hua tha yaani yhan Past Form of Verb Use hogi iske Main-clause mein bhi, jiske liye humein diye Options mein se Option(b) Blew ko select karna hoga. Meanings: blow - V1 hawa ka behna, Blew - V2 Hawa ka behna, blues - ek type ka Music / Dukh ki Bhawana, blue - Neela.

questions.question: Mentally strong people do not _______ to suicide over trivial issues.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Give in
Explanation: Sentence mein bola gya ki 'Mentally strong log Choti-moti baton par Suicide nahi kar lete' diye Sentence ko sahi meaning dene ke liye hum yhan Diye Options mein se sahi Phrasal Verb "Give in" ko Select karenge jiska Meaning hota hai (Surrender kar dena / haar maan lena) jisse Sentence ko sahi meaning milega jo ki hai "Mentally strong log Choti-moti baton se haar maan kar Suicide nahi kar lete". Make up - iss Phrasal Verb ke kai Meanings hai jaise (make up a story/excuse) manghadhant kahani/bahana banana, (make up with someone) kisi se sulaha karna/rista theek kar lena, (make up for) kami ya nukshaan ki bharpai karna, Conceive on - ye koi Phrasal verb nahi hai, iska meaning hai 'naya idea/plan banana' ya 'Pregnant ho jana', Fall in - ka matlab hai 'line mein lagana' ya 'shamil hona'.

questions.question: Rahul is _______ Coding.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) experienced in
Explanation: Ye ek Option based fill in the blank hai jisme options mein se sahi Phrase fill karna hai jo Grammatically Correct ho Aur sahi meaning de Sentence ko. Skilled on - Sentence mein Skill ke saath Preposition 'at' ya 'in' ka Use hota hai par yhan 'on' Use hua jo ki galat hai. Strong of - Generally Strong ke sath Preposition 'in/on' use hoti hai but Preposition 'of' bhi kuch context mein sahi hoti hai, jese "strong of Heart" but yhan diye Sentence ke Context mein Preposition 'of' galat hai. Experienced of - Experienced ke saath Preposition 'of' ka use galat hai. Option(d) Experienced in - sentence mein jab kisi Specific skill/activity ko Refer karna ho tab Experienced ke Saath 'in' preposition bilkul sahi hoti hai. Sentence mein Phrasal verb Option(d) Experienced in ko fill karne par sahi Meaning ban raha jo ki hai "Rahul ko Coding ka experience hai".

questions.question: The farmers grow _______ in their fields.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) Maize
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yaani Sahi meaning ke according humein yhan fill karna hoga Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'Kissan apne kheton mein makka ugate hai' jiske liye diye Options mein se hum Option(d) Maize ko select karenge, Kyuki iska meaning hota hai - "makka". Maze - bhul bhulaiyya, Mays - Ye koi Common English word nahi balki ek part hai Corn ke Scientific Name (Zea mays) ka, Mase - Ye koi English Word nahi jiska Farming ya Crops se koi relation ho.

questions.question: The athlete's _______ was badly injured due to a fall on the track.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Toe
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yaani Sahi meaning ke according humein yhan fill karna hoga Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'Athlete ka pair buri tarah ghayal ho gya track par girne ki bajah se' jiska Sahi meaning dene ke liye hum diye Options mein se Option(b) Toe ko select karenge, kyuki iska Meaning "pair ka agla hissa / panjja" hota hai. Toad - ek type ka Frog / mendhak, Tow - Kisi gaadi / Vehicle ko kheech kar le jana, To - ye ek Preposition hai |.

questions.question: When the victim narrated his version of the incident, the jury was _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) Completely satisfied
Explanation: Sentence mein bola gya ki 'jab Victim ne ghatna ke baare mein bataya to judge uski baat par puri tarah satisfied ho gya tha' ye baala Meaning dene ke liye humein Diye Options mein se Option(c) Completely Satisfied ko fill karna hoga, kyuki iska Meaning "puri tarah se satisfied hona bina koi Doubt ya Confusion k" hota hai. Honestly Satisfied - (Imandari se santusht hona) lekin isse sirf satisfaction ka Manner pata chal raha But Judge kitta satisfied hai bo nahi kyuki yhan Degree ko badane baali Adverb use nahi hui. Perfectly Satisfied - (Puri tarah satisfied) bilkul sahi tarah santusht hona, Ye Option bhi yhan sahi meaning de sakta hai par yhan usse Better Option available hai jo ki "Completely Satisfied" hai agar ye na hota to "Perfectly satisfied" he Fill kiya jata. Excruciatingly satisfied - (bahut jyada santusht hona) (bahut dard / peeda se santusht hona) Sentence ke context ke according ese satisfied hona ek Jury ke liye Fit nahi bethta, to iska Use karna yhan galat hoga. |

questions.question: Ram was praised for his _______ leadership.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Visionary
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yhan bola jaa raha ki 'Ram ko apni leadership ke liye Praise kiya gya tha' Sentence mein Leadership ke Context ke according yaha sahi meaning dene ke liye hum diye Options mein se Option(b) Visionary ko Fill karenge jiska Meaning hota hai "durdarshi (Future ke liye Clear Idea ya Plan rakhne bala ya dikhane bala)" aur 'Visionary Leadership' ka meaning hai esi leadership jisme ek better Future ko sochte huye aur usko Reality banana ke liye dusron ko Inspire, Empower aur Ekjut karna. Baaki Options ke meanings hai: Imaginary - kaalpanik, Magical - jaadui, Broad - wide / chauda.

questions.question: The monster trucks have very _______ engines, they can probably pull a train coach without any problem.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) Powerful
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai, yaani Sahi meaning ke according humein yhan fill karna hoga. Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'Monster truck ke Engines bahut damdar hai ki bo bina kisi pareshani ke Train ke ek Coach ko bhi kheech sakte hai' to yhan sahi meaning dene ke liye diye Options mein se hum Option(d) Powerful ko fill karenge jiska Meaning "takatbar / damdaar" hota hai. Baaki Options ke Meanings hai: Dominant - Pramukh / Prabhabsaali / haavi, Forceful - jordaar / balsaali, Impressive - Shaandaar / bhavya(Grand) |

questions.question: The contingent managed to _______ successfully.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Close the deal
Explanation: Sentence mein bola gya ki 'Group (Contingent) ne Successfully Deal ko pura kiya' jiske liye humein diye Options mein se Option(b) Close the deal ko Select karna hoga jo ki ek Idiomatic Expression hai jiska Meaning hota hai "Successfully koi Business Negotiation ya Business Transaction ko Complete karna." Jo yahan Sentence ko Complete kar raha ek sahi Meaning ke saath. Baaki diye Options koi Idiomatic expression nahi bana rahe na he bo koi Valid Meaning de rahe.

questions.question: The interviewees were slowly becoming impatient as they were left to _______ in the waiting room for hours.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) cool their heels
Explanation: Diye Sentence mein humein Options mein se ek Idiomatic Expression fill karna hai jo yhan sahi meaning de.
