Yhan Sentence mein bola gya ki 'Interviewees dheere-dheere Impatient ho gaye jaise he unhe waiting room mein ghanto tak intezaar karne ke liye chhor diya gya' Sentence ko sahi Meaning dene ke liye yhan hum Diye Options mein se Option(b) Cool their heels ko Fill karenge jiska Meaning hota hai "jaanpuch kar kisi ko intzaar karbana jisse bo Bore ya besabar(Impatient) ho jaay". Baaki options ke Meaning hai: Draw the long bow - badi badi baatein karna. Hold Water - satya hona ya Uchit hona (to be true or reasonable). Flog a dead Horse - vyarth ka Pryash / Mehnat karna.

questions.question: When there are negative and toxic thoughts _______ your mind, you can never think positively.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) Clouding
Explanation: Diye Sentence mein humein bola gya ki 'jab Negative ya Toxic Thought hamare Mind mein hote hai tab aap kabhi Positively nahi soch sakte' to iske liye humein diye Options mein se Option(c) Clouding ko fill karna hoga jiska meaning yhan "gher lena (to surround) ya dhundhlapan" hai jisse Meaning banega ki 'Jab Negative aur Toxic Thoughts hamare Dimag ko Gher lete hai tab hum kabhi Positively nahi soch sakte' jo ki ek Correct Meaning de raha. Baaki Options ke Meaning hai: Plotting - Secretly koi Plan banana khuch galat / Negative karne ke liye, Shouting - Chillana / pukarna, Persuading - kisi ko manana ya fuslana |

questions.question: The little boy demanded colourful balloons, ribbons at the village fair. When the father didn't pay heed to his demands, the boy made a _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) wry face
Explanation: Diye Sentence mein bataya gya ki 'jab chote bacche ke Father ne uski demand nahi suni tab usne apna moo bana liya' iss Sentence ko sahi meaning dene ke liye humein yhan se Sahi Phrase Select karna hoga jo ki Facial Expression ka sahi meaning de, to uske liye Sirf hum Option(b) wry face ko Fill kar sakte hai kyuki uska Meaning "moo bichkana ya Teda-meda moo banana hota hai" jab aap kisi se naraz hote ho. Baaki options ke meaning hai: cloven hoof - Shaitan ka panja ya Gaay/bakree ka khur jo do bhaag mein bata hota hai, a far cry - ek dam alag (jab do chezzon mein bahut jyada difference ho tab iska use karte hai usse batane ke liye), jaundiced eye - Nakaratmak nazariya (Negative view towards someone).

questions.question: Be it a chaat or a refreshing lemonade, lemon is the need of the hour in _______ summers.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) scorching
Explanation: Ye question Vocab based hai jiske liye yhan bola gya ki 'Nimbu ki jarurat padti hai garmiyon ke time mein' to iske sahi Meaning ke liye hum diye Options mein Option(c) Scorching ko fill karenge jiska meaning "jalane bala ya Jhulsane bala" hota hai jisse Sentence mein sahi Meaning banega 'Scorching Summer' yaani 'Jhulsaaney baali Garmi'. baaki Options ka Meaning: banging - jor se peetna / khat khatana, Freezing - jamna, Alleviating - kam karna / halka kardena ya Fhir rahat pahunchana.

questions.question: We decided to _______ as we were missing him a lot.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) pay him a visit
Explanation: kisi Sentence mein jab hum kisi ko Miss karte huye usse Milne jaate hai tab hum Idiom "Pay a Visit" Use karte hai, Sentence mein bhi yahi baat batani hai ki 'hamne decide Kiya tha usse Milne Jane ka kyuki humein uski bahut yaad aa rahi thi' to iss Meaning ko dene ke liy hame diye Options mein se Option(d) Pay him a Visit ko fill karenge yhan. Baaki diye Options koi sahi Idiom nahi bana rahe unka Use karna galat hoga.

questions.question: Our school had decided to take us to the Himalayas for an excursion. I _______ to convince my mother to give consent.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) Left no Stone Unturned
Explanation: Diya Sentence Options mein diye Idioms ke sahi Meaning ko samjh kr Fill karne par based hai, yhan Sentence mein bola jaa raha ki 'School Trip par jaane ke liye maine puri kosis kari ki Mother apni sehmati(consent) de de' ye Meaning dene ke liye hum diye Idioms mein se Option(d) Left no Stones Unturned ko Fill karenge jiska Meaning hota hai 'Har ek mumkin prayas(try) karna' jo Sentence ko sahi Meaning de raha, Baaki Options ke Meaning hai: fought fire with fire - jaise ko taisa jawab dena, Brought home the bacon - Ghar chalane ke liye Paisa kama kar lana, Made waves - mushibat khadi karna.

questions.question: He has experienced _______ abuse.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) Physical
Explanation: Diye Sentence mein bola gya ki 'Usne Experience kiya hai yatna(abuse) ka' iss Sentence ke Context mein hum diye Options mein se Option(c) Physical ko yhan Fill karenge Jo yhan ek sahi Meaning dega Jo ki hai (Physical Abuse) 'Sharirik Yatna', jo ki yhan bata raha ki "Usne sehan (Experience) kiya hai Sharirik yatna ko". Baaki Options ke Meaning hai: Palpable - saaf / chune layak, Visible - saaf / dekhne yogya, Intangible - Na chune yogya.

questions.question: They supplied the required human resource _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (a) Faultlessly
Explanation: Diye Sentence mein yhan ek Adverb ki Jarurat hai jo bataye ki kaam kese hua yaani ek Adverb of Manner ki Requirement hai yhan to uske Liye hum Options mein se Option(a) Faultlessly ko Fill karenge jiska meaning hota hai "Bina kisi galti k" jisse Sentence ka Meaning ho jayega "Unhone jarruri Human Resources ki supply kari thi Bina koi galti kare". Baaki diye Options hum Use nahi kar sakte kyuki bo sab Adjectives hai aur humein yhan ek Adverb Fill karna tha.

questions.question: I listened to him with _______ attention.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) rapt
Explanation: Diya Sentence Vocab based hai isme Bola gya ki 'Maine uski baat suni Attention ke saath' Sentence mein humein Attention ke Context ke according yhan diye Options mein se Option(c) Rapt ko fill karenge kyuki 'rapt Attention' ka Meaning hota hai "Dhyan magan hokar / pure dhyan se" jo Sentence ko sahi Meaning de raha. Baaki Options ke Meaning hai: Hefty - hatta katta, Massive - bada aur Vishalkay, Vast - bahut bada.

questions.question: They hired her to increase sales, but her strategies failed to _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (a) Move the needle
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai isme Options mein diye Idiom ka Meaning pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya jaay, Yhan Bola gya ki 'Unhone usse Sale ko badhane ke liye naukri par rakha tha par uski strategies fail ho gai thi' iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum diye Options mein se Option(a) Move the needle ko Fill karenge kyuki iss Idiom ka Meaning hota hai "kisi situation mein Positively bada badalav lana", jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Unhone use Sale ko badhane ke liye naukri par rakha tha par uski strategies koi bada badalav nahi laa pai aur fail ho gai thi." Baaki options ke meaning hai: burn bridges - rishte iss tarah khatam karna ki dubara judna sambhav na ho, Spill the beans - chugali karna / secret reveal kar dena, Get a second wind - thakaan ke baad phir se urjaabaan (energetic) feel karna.

questions.question: He booked the tickets for the show _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) in advance
Explanation: Diye gaye Sentence mein 'Show ke liye Ticket book kar dene' ki baat ko bola jaa raha hai. Yhan 'Ticket book karne' ke Context mein sahi Meaning ke liye Options mein se hum Option(d) In advance ko fill karenge kyuki 'Ticket book karne ka kaam Advance mein he hota hai' jab bhi kisi Show / Train etc. ke liye Booking karni ho. Jisse Sentence ko ek Correct Meaning mil rahi. Baaki Options ke Meaning hai: in demand - kisi cheez ka Demand mein hona, yahan Show ke demand mein hone se usse Book kar dena Justify nahi ho raha, in common - kisi cheez ka aam hona. Ex- In common use (aam istemal mein). In depth - gehrai se (detailed/comprehensive). Ex- In-depth Study (gehrai se adhyayan).

questions.question: This drama is extremely informative _______ life in Roman times.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) About
Explanation: Sentence Grammar based hai isme Preposition ka sahi use pata hona chahiye taaki Sentence grammatically aur meaning wise correct ho sake, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Ye drama Roman samay ke jeevan ke baare mein bahut informative hai." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum diye Options mein se Option(c) About ko Fill karenge kyuki "Informative about" ka use kisi cheez ke baare mein jaankari dene ke sense mein kiya jata hai, jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Yeh drama Roman times ki life ke baare mein bahut jaankari deta hai." Baaki options ke meaning hai: On - kisi topic/surface ko show karta hai, Of - sambandh ya belonging show karta hai, For - kisi purpose yaa benefit ko show karta hai.

questions.question: Arun and his wife were _______ a baby boy after 18 years of their marriage.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) blessed with
Explanation: Sentence Phrase based hai isme Options mein diye Phrase ka Meaning pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya jaaye, Yhan Bola gya ki "Arun aur uski wife ko shaadi ke 18 saal baad ek baby boy hua" iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum diye Options mein se Option(d) blessed with ko Fill karenge kyuki iss Phrase ka Meaning hota hai "kisi achchi cheez ka prapt hona / vardaan ke roop mein milna", jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Arun aur uski wife ko shaadi ke 18 saal baad ek baby boy ka sukh prapt hua." Baaki options ke meaning hai: delighted with - kisi cheez se bahut khush hona, prepared with - kisi cheez ke saath taiyaar hona, provided with - kisi cheez ko uplabdh karwana / provide karna.

questions.question: The company's profits were low and they were forced to _______ staff.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) lay off
Explanation: Sentence Phrasal Verb based hai isme Options mein diye Phrasal Verb ka Meaning pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya jaaye, Yhan Bola gya ki "Company ka profit kam tha aur unhe majbooran staff ko hataana pada" iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum diye Options mein se Option(b) lay off ko Fill karenge kyuki iss Phrasal Verb ka Meaning hota hai "employees ko naukri se nikaal dena / temporary ya permanent roop se hata dena", jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Company ka profit kam tha isliye unhe staff ko naukri se nikaalna pada." Baaki options ke meaning hai: lisp off - yeh koi standard phrasal verb nahi hai, lay on - arrange/provide karna, lie on - kisi cheez par nirbhar hona ya upar tikna.

questions.question: We ensure that you will get a _______ chauffeur with the right car for your day.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Uniformed
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai, isme Options ke Words ka Meaning pata hona chahiye. Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Hum ensure karte hain ki aapko sahi car ke saath ek _______ chauffeur milega." Sentence ke Context ke according Option(b) Uniformed sahi hoga kyuki iska yhan Meaning hota hai "uniform pehne hua", jo Sentence ko sahi Meaning deta hai. Baaki Words ke Meaning hai: Novice - nausikhiya, Dabbler - kisi kaam ko thoda bahut karne wala, Riotous - hungama karne wala.

questions.question: She rubbed her hands over her arms, and then _______ her purse, headed inside the convenience store.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (d) Grabbing
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai isme Options mein diye gaye Words ka Meaning pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya ja sake, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Usne apne haathon ko baahon par ragda / malla aur phir apna purse _______ convenience store ke andar chali gai." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(d) Grabbing ko Fill karenge kyuki "Grabbing" ka Meaning hota hai "jaldi se pakad lena / jhapatna ya hanth mein le lena", jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Usne apne purse ko pakda aur convenience store ke andar chali gai." Baaki diye gaye Words ke Meaning hai: Snapping - jhatke se todna / tez awaaz karna, Slaying - maar dena, Pinching - chutki kaatna / dabaana.

questions.question: The judge directed the advocate general to _______ an enquiry on the case.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (c) Hold
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai isme Options mein diye gaye Words ka Meaning aur unka sahi Usage pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya ja sake, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Judge ne advocate general ko case par enquiry _______ karne ka nirdesh diya." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(c) Hold ko Fill karenge kyuki "Hold an enquiry" ek correct phrase hai jiska Meaning hota hai "jaanch karna / enquiry conduct karna", jo Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai. Baaki options Meaning hai: Make - banana / karna, Produce - utpadan karna / prastut karna, Get - paana / prapt karna.

questions.question: Brady straightened, the _______ baton in hand.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Wooden
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Brady seedha hua, haath mein _______ baton (danda / chhadi) tha." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(b) Wooden ko Fill karenge kyuki "Wooden" ka Meaning hota hai "lakdi ka bana hua", jo "baton (danda / chhadi)" ko sahi tarah describe kar raha hai ki "lakdi ka danda / chhadi" aur Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai. Baaki options ke Meaning hai: Charge - aakraman / daam, Swing - jhulna / ghumana, Open - khula hua.

questions.question: A faint mist _______ over the valley.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (a) Hung
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai isme, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Ek halka sa kohra (mist) _______ valley ke upar tha." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(a) Hung ko Fill karenge kyuki "Hung" ka yhan Meaning hota hai "latakna ya hawa mein isthir(stable) rehna", jo "mist" ke saath naturally fit hota hai aur Sentence ko Correct Meaning de raha hai ki "Ek halka sa kohra valley ke upar bana hua tha." Baaki options ke Meaning hai: Swung - jhulna/ghoomna, Swayed - hilna / dolna, Dangled - latakna (usually kisi chiz ki pakad ke niche jhulna).

questions.question: The _______ weapons which are easily available in the market are a big threat to the security of some nations.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (b) Deadly
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based, Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Market mein aasani se milne wale _______ weapons kuch deshon ki security ke liye bada khatra hain." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(b) Deadly ko Fill karenge kyuki "Deadly" ka Meaning hota hai "jaanleva / bahut khatarnak", jo "weapons" ke saath perfectly fit hota hai aur Sentence ko Correct Meaning deta hai ki "Market mein aasani se milne wale jaanleva weapons kuch deshon ki security ke liye bada khatra hain." Baaki options ke Meaning hai: Heated - garm/garm kiya hua, Casual - friendly / Unofficial, Valuable - keemti.

questions.question: This year, orange prices are forecast to grow, despite an expected increase in global _______.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans. (a) Production
Explanation: Sentence Vocab based hai isme Options mein diye gaye Words ka Meaning pata hona chahiye taaki sahi Option Fill kiya ja sake. Yhan Bola gya hai ki "Is saal orange ke daam badhne ki sambhavna hai, jabki (dunia) global _______ mein vriddhi ki umeed hai." iss Sentence ke Context ke according hum Option(a) Production ko Fill karenge kyuki "Production" ka Meaning hota hai "utpaadan (production)", jo Sentence ke sense ke saath fit hota hai ki global production badhne ke baad bhi prices ka badna forecasted hai. Baaki options ke Meaning hai: Organisation - sangathan, Abduction - apaharan, Assumption - anuman
